gsal bshad/snga 'gyur grub dbang rgyal ba rdzogs chen pa'i gdan sa'i lte ba/ri dam dkar mo g.yang 'khyil du/ phran ra nyag dpal sprul nas lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba yongs kyi bsod nams kyi zhing sar dmigs te/ skyabs rje pad+ma skal bzang rin po che'i dag snang rang byung pad+ma rgyal po'i zhing bkod khyad mtshar pa gsar bzhengs legs grub byung ba'i dga' ston rjes dran du theg dgu'i rtse rgyal 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i chos tshan kha shas par du skrun pa 'di nyid rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams la gus pas phul ba dgyes bzhes thog /gsung rab spyi dang khyad par gdams zab 'di dag la gsan bsam lhod med dang 'brel/ nyams bzhes gnad smin gyis rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sa lam myur du bgrod de gzhan don rgya chen mdzad pa'i smon 'dun dang bcas spyi lo nyis stong bcu'i lo ste bod lcags stag zla tshes la ra nyag dpal sprul nas/

dkar chagathun mong gi sngon 'gro sems sbyong rnam pa bdun gyi don khrid thar ba'i them skas/ (1)rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying tig gi thun mong gi sngon 'gro khrid kyi lag len la 'debs lugs/ (97)rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'i khrid yig dran pa nyer gzhag (126)chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod/ (153)rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying tig gi gdod ma'i mgon po'i lam gyi rim pa'i khrid yig ye shes bla ma/ (203)klong chen snying gi thig le las/ rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol lam gyi rim pa las 'phros pa'i man ngag gi rgyab brten pad+ma dkar po/ (328)rdzogs pa chen po kun tu bzang po ye shes klong gi rgyud/ (375)man ngag rdzogs pa chen po rgyud phyi ma/ (391)kun tu bzang po'i dgongs nyams/ (397)rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad gsum shan 'byed/ (404)1

rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i gsang gtam/ /yid dpyod grub mtha' 'jig pa'i tho lum/ /snying phyung lag mthil bkram pa'i man ngag /gsang bdag dga' rab dpa' bo'i thol glu/ /kun mkhyen zhal lung bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ (408)snying tig sgom pa'i bya bral gyi gol shor tshar gcod seng ge'i nga ro/ (429)mkhas pa shrī rgyal po'i khyad chos/ (441)mthar thug rdzogs pa chen po sangs rgyas pa'i thabs zab mo bsgom pa rang grol/ (460)rtogs ldan rgan po rnams kyi lugs sems ngo mdzub tshugs kyi gdams pa mun sel sgron me/ (479)'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i khregs chod lta ba'i glu dbyangs sa lam ma lus myur du bgrod pa'i rtsal ldan mkha' lding gshog rlabs/ (485)'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lhun grub thod rgal gyi glu dbyangs ting 'dzin sgo 'phar brgya phrag gcig car 2

'byed pa'i lde'u mig (535)thod rgal gnad kyi zhal shes mgur dbyangs bdud rtsi'i bum bzang (585)'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i smon lam/ (597)gzhi lam 'bras bu'i smon lam/ (602)zangs mdog dpal ri'i smon lam dpal ri'i gsang lam/ (605)snga 'gyur bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam chos rgyal dgyes pa'i zhal lung / (609)

༄༅/ /thun mong gi sngon 'gro sems smyong rnam pa bdun gyi don khrid thar ba'i them mas zhes bya ba bzhugs/dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin shin tu rnam dag rgya chad phyogs su ma lhung zhing / /ma skyes mi 'gag spros pa kun bral ye babs gzhug ma byang chub sems/ /dus gsum dus med rnam kun mchog ldan 'pho med 'dus ma byas kyi sku/ /'khor 'das bdag med khyad chos drug ldan gdod ma'i mgon po de la 'dud/ /gang gi gzhi snang rol pa chu zla'i gar/ /srid mtshor bcud du smin pa'i dpal yon can/ /'od lus sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skur bzhengs pa/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas mchod/ / rkang gnyis gtso bo mi yi seng ge shākya'i rgyal dang de yi sras/ /shing rta gnyis sogs rgyan drug mchog gnyis 'jig rten mig gcig zhi ba 'tsho/ /sad mi bdun dang mar me mdzad dpal shāka shrī kun mkhyen lnga pa sogs/ /bstan pa'i gzhi rten tshul khrims gsum gyi bdag po rnams la cis mi dad/ /gsang bdag dpa' bos rgyal thabs spyi blugs dbang bskur byin pa'i theg mchog ston pa dga' 1

rab rje/ /dam pa'i rigs can drwa ma lnga dang tan+t+ra bco brgyad glegs bam dbang thob rgyal po dzaḥrnam gsum yo ga'i don brgyud bdag po bi ma la dang be+e ro la sogs nyi shu lnga/ /klong lnga'i mdzod nas zab rgya'i sgo 'byed bcu phrag bcu yi pha mthar brgal ba snying nas dad/ /brjod bya gsung rabs yan lag bcu gnyis dang / /brjod don rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa nyid/ /thub pa'i lung rtogs bstan pa gangs can 'dir/ /gsal mkhas kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang por nges / /mdo sngags chos rnams bstan pa yongs rdzogs su/ /stan thog gcig gis go na bstan pa'i mthar/ /bya rtsol med pa chos sku'i dgongs pa la/ /sbyor ba rdzogs pa chen po'i khyad nor yin/ /de'i phyir de yi 'khrid tshul rab 'byams kyi/ /thun mong sngon 'gro sems sbyong rnam pa bdun/ /rgyas bsdus gnyis ku'i phyogs su ma ltung bar//tshad ma gsum gyis gnyer khas bshad par bya/ /de la 'dir brgyud pa'i khyad par drug dang ldan pa'i sgo nas mdo sngags kyi chos tshul rab 'byams mtha' dag stan thog gcig tu 'chad nus pa'i theg pa'i rtse rgyal rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po la 'jug pa'i lam stegs thun mong gi sngon 'gro sems sbyong rnam pa bdun gyi don 'khrid ni ji skad du/ bdag gi bla ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i don gyi rgyal tshab kun mkhyen shān+ta pu ri pas/ mngon mtho sgrub byed rgyal ba'i gsung 2

rabs kun/ /don rnams skyes bu chung ngu'i lam dang ni/ /thar pa bsgrub pa'i thabs la brtson pa yi/ /chos kyi rnam grangs kun gyi brjod bya'i don/ /skyes bu 'bring gi lam gyi rim pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'di nyid sa bcad kyi dbang gis skyes bu 'bring man chad kyi lam du bzhag na'ang / dngos gzhir bstan bya'i lam gyi ngo bo theg pa'i mchog rab yin par yang ma zad theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed kyi 'phen pa lan re re'i nus stobs kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid la dpags nas lam gyi thog ma nyid nas sems bskyed khyad par ba yod pa'i phyir skyes bu chen po'i lam du bzhag kyang mi 'gal lo/ /de lta bu'i skyes bu gsum gyi rnam par bzhag pa ni tshe dbang rig 'dzin slar yang sde snod gsum gyi spangs rtogs kyi bstan pa spel ba'i slad du tshangs par mtshungs spyod kyi brdzu la zhugs pa lha gcig dī pam ka ras byang chub lam gyi sgron mar bstan pa ltar las/ don gyi sa zin zur pa med cing ngo bo la chos skad kyi 'jug ldog tsam yin pa la dgongs nas snga 'gyur ba'i phyogs la grags chung ba yin no/ /de lta na'ang rnam par shes bya 'byed pa'i blo gros dpyad gzod pa nyid dang sngon gyi lam ston chen po rnams nas srol btod pa'i phyir mdo sngags kyi bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer shes pas bka' lung rang dbang du 3

bkral ba'i nus pa 'jog phyir dang / mdo las/ 'jam dpal dam pa'i chos spong ba'i las kyi sgrib pa ni phra'o/ /'jam dpal gang de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i bka' la la ni bzang bar 'du shes / la la ni ngan par 'du shes pa ni chos spong pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bstan pa'i bar skabs su phyogs re'i mig can 'ga' zhig gis bstan pa rnam dag la rtog btags 'gal 'du'i rdzun phreng gis dri bcas su bsgrubs pas rkyen byas shin tu gsang ba chen po'i theg pa la lam gyi go rim tsam yang med par spyod phyogs khyad du bsad snyam pa'i btsan thabs nyid du chos thams cad rang bzhin med par bstan par go nas yang dag pa'i lam la chos ma yin par 'du shes te gshe zhing sdang ba'i nyes spyod chen po'i g.yang sa las skyob phyir yang yin no/ /de yang rten 'brel gyi sgo dang po ston pa dang chos la rim gro dang bkur bste bya bar rgyal ba'i yum dang sa'i snying po'i mdo sogs las rgya cher bshad cing de skad du kun tu bzang po'i tan+t+ra las/ dang por slob mas bla ma la/ /sdom chos zhu tshe 'di ltar bya/ /snga bar langs la kha lag bkrus/ /lus kyi chas rnams legs par gzabs/ /mched grogs dam tshig ldan mi ldan / /sta gon rnam dbyer legs par bya/ /chos rar chag chag byi dor bya/ /zhes pa ltar khrus bya zhing gos gtsang ma gyon/ mched dam 4

tshig dang mi ldan pa dag phyir bsal te thabs kyis spangs/ chos rar yul dus dang bstun pa'i byi dor bya ba sogs byi dor rnam pa gsum du nges par bya zhing / de nas bzhugs khri bla yol lda ldi dang //phyi nang mchod pa rgyas par bsham/ /bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa ni/ /ngag gi dang 'dren blo phebs bca'/ /de nas chos 'khor bskul ba'i sgra/ /chos kyi dung chen lan dgu po/ /bla ma'i phyogs su kha bltas 'bud/ /kun gyis gsol 'debs dung bar bya/ /bla ma spos dang rol mos bsu/ /bde ba'i stan la bzhugs su gsol/ /ces pa ltar brnyas stabs su ma song bar bla ma dang dkon mchog mnyes pa'i mchod pa dang khri stan mthon por bshams pa sogs bya/ chos la bskul ba'i dung 'bud pa'i tshe yang bla ma la kha bstan te bus pas mchod pa'i tshul du 'gro/ sgra de thos pa'i sems can mang po yang ngan song las thar bar bshad pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul dang thabs bsam gyis mi khyab par shes par byas la thun thams cad kyi brdar dung 'bud pa la yang gnad chen po de lta bu yod pa yin no/ /de'i tshe bla mas kyang gdul bya dang ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam la bslab dgos te klong gsal las/ slob ma'i mos gus che chung de/ /bla ma'i mdzad spyod legs nyes yin/ /'gro 'chag nyal dang za ba sogs/ /spyod lam thabs la legs par 5

bslab / /ces gsungs shing rgyud sde rgya mtsho nas dam tshig gi rnam bshad ston pa'i skabs su'ang / dpon gyis nyams na sbyang thabs med / /gnyis ka na rag chen por 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pas spyir rnam pa thams cad du shin tu rigs pa'i spyod lam la bslab cing khyad par chos ston pa la sogs 'di dag gi tshe sbom yor yom yugs su ma song ba zhig dgos te/ klong gsal las/ de ltar snod ldan slob ma la/ /zab chos bstan pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /bla ma'i spyod lam 'di ltar bya/ /bde ba'i stan la skyil krung bcas/ /rang nyid theg pa gang ston pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bor gsal btab la/ /'gro drug sems can ma lus kun/ /mdun du skad cig 'khod par bsam/ /rang rang skad dang blo 'tsham pa'i/ /theg chen chos ston sems kyang bskyed / /chos skyong dkar phyogs thams cad la/ /legs spel bar chad srungs shig ces/ /rang rang las kyi phrin las bcol/ /chos gral dbus su stong par gzhag /mi dang mi min dkar phyogs kun/ /mos pas dam chos nyan par bsam/ /mig gis slob ma kun la blta / /lag pa chos 'chad mnyam gzhag bya/ /ngag gis tshig gsal gdangs snyan pos/ /dpe don rtags gsum 'brel bar bshad/ /dbang po gang la 'tsham pa yi/ /chos sgo theg pa rim par bstan/ /zhes 'di lta bu'i chos 'chad lugs ni theg pa gang dang gang ston 6

pa thams cad kyi khog 'bubs kyang yin la/ de'i phyir lus kyi spyod la ma bag med pa 'gyel bub gzhogs snyes la sogs pa spangs/g.yon mnyam gzhag dang g.yas chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya bca' ba sngon du 'gro bas sngon 'gro'i tshe shwakya thub pa dang dngos gzhi'i tshe rgyud lung man ngag ji ltar du ston pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag por gsal btab nas sems can thams cad rnam byang la 'god pa'i sems bskyed kyis 'phen pas gzhi bzung / de'i tshe rig drug gi sems can thams cad rang gi mdun du chos nyan pa'i phyir 'khod par bsam zhing / khyad par chos ra'i dbus stong par bzhag pa la mi ma yin dkar phyogs pa kun kyang 'dus nas mos pas chos nyan par bsam zhing / bar chad zhi ba dang legs spel gyi phrin las bcol / 'dod lha sde bcas kyi gnyen por blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ bdud tshar gcod pa'i sngags bton na dpag tshad brgya tshun chad du glags lta bar mi nus par bshad pas de ltar 'don / ngag bul mgyogs ldab ldib la sogs pas thos 'dzin gyi tsher mar gyur pa spangs la gsal dag snyan pa'i sgras dpe don rtags gsum 'brel bar bshad cing / de yang nges don gyi tshig thog ma nyid nas 'chad pa dang tan gan gyi spyod pa zur 'phrig pa la sogs kyis gdul bya'i blo las su mi rung bar 'gyur phyir spang 7

bar bya la de skad du/ klong gsal nyi ma las/ bla mas slob ma gso ba'i tshe/ /slob ma gsar bu dad ldan de/ /thog mar thabs kyis 'khrid par bya/ /nges don snying po ma go'i bar/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis kyi chos rnams bshad/ /sgrung dang dpe dang bstan bcos dang / /mgur glu la sogs 'khor ba la/ /yid dbyung ngan song sdug bsngal dang / /sangs rgyas yon tan la sogs bshad/ /bla ma nyid kyang spyod lam gzabs / /gal te tan gan zur 'phrig na/ /blo chung dad log rdza mi dos / /de la byin rlabs gzhan mi 'go/ /zhes so/ /de'i phyir tshul 'di lta bu'i sems sbyong lugs ni las dang po pa blo sbyong ba'i thabs khyad par can yin par yang shes par bya la/ dngos gzhi'i tshe de nyid las/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang bgrol la bshad/ /rgyud dkrugs pa rnams bsdebs la bshad/ /lung gcus pa rnams brkyangs la bshad / /drang por dgongs dang ldem por dgongs/ /ma 'ongs 'jug don dgongs pa dang / /drang don nges don snying po'i don/ /gnyis su med pa'i don tshig rnams/ /rgyud lung man ngag phye la bshad / /mun nag 'dzub g.yug ma song bar/ /slob bu'i rgyud la thebs par gdab/ /dmus long mig phye ji bzhin du/ /lag len myong bas yid ches 'jug /ces pa ltar rdo rje'i tshig rkang rnams don brgyud kyi dgongs pas bkral zhing / de yang rgyud dkrugs pa 8

rnams mu tig bstar la brgyus pa bzhin du bsdebs/ lung gcus pa rnams sbrul gyi mdud pa brkyangs pa ltar bsrang / man ngag gab pa rnams nyi mas mun pa bsal ba bzhin mngon du phyung nas drang nges ldem dgongs kyi lung don rig pas 'byed pa la snga 'gyur bka' babs kyi chu bo bzhi dang mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bshad pa'i rgyun ma nyams pa kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos rgya mtsho lta bus bshad dgos pa nyid do/ /de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas lam gyi rim pa ji lta bu 'chad pa na'ang /chos mtshams le'u'am thun gyi mtshams so sor/ ji ltar bshad pa'i tshig thams cad don thog tu hril gyis bsdus la bsgom bya'i dmigs pa'i thog tu dril nas slob bu'i rgyud la 'dres nges par bya/skabs ci rigs par grub thob gong ma'i rnam par thar pa dang /dgos 'brel gnyis dang ldan pa'i sgrub rgyud ngo mtshar bas bying ba bsang zhing slob bu'i skyon mtshang 'don pa sogs thabs kyis 'dul ba'i man ngag la mkhas par byas pas bskos phor las sats+tsha 'byung ba bzhin du bla ma'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad slob ma'i rgyud la bsre nus pa yin no/ /khyad par thun so so'i mgor sems bskyed dang mjug tu dmigs pa med pa'i bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyor ba yang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i khyad chos yin la 9

de skad du/ klong gsal las/ chos mtshams le'u'i thun gyi dus/ /yas dril mas dril don kun bsdu/ /bsgom bya'i dmigs pa brtan du gzhug /bsam bya'i go ba len du gzhug /skabs su sgrung rgyud la sogs pa/ /ngo mtshar gtam gyis bying ba bsregs/ /slob bu'i skyon mtshang 'don pa'i phyir/ /sngon gyi sgrung rgyud lde'u chung brdeg /rjes su bsngo ba smon lam gdab/ /kun la byang sems brtse ldan gces/ /de ltar lag len ston mkhas na/ /bla ma sangs rgyas brkos phor la/ /dam pa chos kyi ri mo yod/ /slob ma snod ldan sgyi bhi bcug /bskos phor ri mo de la thebs/ /sku gsum tsha tshwar dgrong gis 'gyur/ /de ltar slob dpon lag len gces/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sta gon dang phyag len che phra mtha' dag la chos la dbang za ba'i rang bzo'i dri mas ma sbags pa nyid sngon du song nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhuganam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya ba'i phyir du/ ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong mtha' dag gi yang zhun theg pa'i rtse rgyal rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i 'bras bu don du gnyer ba'i lam la 'jug go snyam pa'i mos pa mi phyed pas gzhi bzung /de yang mdo las/ legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig 10

ces pa ltar snod kyi skyon gsum spangs te rang la nad pa chos la sman / ston pa la sman pa/ nan tan nyams su len pa la nad gso ba/de bzhin gshegs pa la skyes bu dam pa/ chos kyi tshul la rings su gnas pa ste 'du shes drug dang / kun tu bzang po'i rgyud las/bde ba'i sa la skyil krung bca'/ /sa gcig dag las gnas mi spo/ /zhwa mo yod na mdun du bzhag /skra lo yod na mdun du phab/ /lag pa thal sbyar mnyam gzhag bca'/ /lag gis 'du byed thams cad spang / /mig gis bla ma'i zhal la blta/ /rna bas bla ma'i gsung la nyan / /sems kyis tshig don gtan la 'bebs/ /the tshom dus su log la zhu/ /ngag tu shub bu'i tshig rnams spang / /rkang brkyang gzhogs snyes che bcos dang / /ma gnang khri dang stan stegs spang / /mi na ba la mgo g.yogs dang / /dgra med pa la mtshon thogs dang //ma rgas pa la dbyug thogs dang / /tshul dang mi mthun thams cad spang / /tshig don re re gzhag 'brel bya/ /chos thun mjug gi dmigs pa la/ /nan chags chen pos gong 'og mthud/ /tha mal spyod pa thams cad spang / /chos khrims lung bzhin bag yod spyad/ /ces gsungs pas kun slong dang kun spyod thams cad gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ skabs 'dir snying thig ya bzhi la sogs te man ngag gi gzhung gzhan gyis 'chad na/ chos kyi che ba dang 11

brgyud rim slob ma'i dbang po dang bstun nas dang ba 'dren par bshad rjes/ bu yig las/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag par bsam pa dang / zhes pas dang po lung la rjes su dpags nas bsam pa ni/ de yang rang re sngon gyi bsags pa phul du phyin pa'i mthu kho na la brten nas dpe grangs ngo bo'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob pa skal pa bzang ste / bsam na glo bur gyi rkyen mi zad pas do nub shi nas sang nangs par mal du ro la song na ji ltar byed/ /blun rmongs phal ni 'chi ba 'ong mi 'ong gi rtog dpyod tsam yang mi byed par snang ba gdong 'ded kho na'i ngang la thug ste 'chi/ 'ga' zhig 'chi ba 'ong snyam pa yod kyang ma rgas kyi bar la dga' rab yod re'i bsam pas rim gro dang thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas phyi tshig dang re dogs kho na lhur len cing tshe 'di'i 'dun ma 'ba' zhig gi dbang du 'gro / de ltar mi kun zla ba rting ma'i bya byed kyi gshom ra dang rgyags phye sogs 'ong grabs byed kyang de'i dus na rang re'i lus rten 'di 'dra min pa'i mgo dang kha la rwa co yod pa zhig tu skyes nas lus rten 'di'i rus pa tsam yang shul med du mi byed pa'i gdeng e 'dug /gdeng mi 'dug na de'i tshe thabs ni gang yang med de rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po/ dper 12

na phyogs bzhi nas ri sra ba/ brtan pa/ dpang mtho ba bzhi 'gyel nas rtswa dang / shing gel pa dang / srog chags thams cad phye mar 'thag cing rub rub byung na/ de la mgyogs par 'bros pa'am/stobs kyis bzlog pa'am/ nor gyis bslu ba'am/ rdzas dang sngags dang sman gyis bzlog sla ba ma yin no/ /de bzhin du sems can thams cad la/ na ba dang / rga ba dang / 'chi ba dang / rgyad pa zhes bya ba'i 'jigs pa chen po bzhi 'byung ste/ de la mgyogs pas 'bros pa'am/ stobs kyis bzlog pa'am/ nor gyis bsluba'am/ rdzas dang sngags dang / sman gyis bzlog par sla ba ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs la/ de'i phyir na rang cag rnams nges par 'chi ste/ mya ngan bsal ba'i mdo las/ ci ste sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i/ /rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag na/ /chu shing sdongapo lta bu yi/ /lus can rnams lta smos ci dgos/ /zhes pas skye 'chi la rang dbang thob pa'i 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya thub pa yang gdul bya rtag 'dzin can gdul ba'i phyir tha ma'i gzim khri la mnal bas yid skyo/ de bzhin du rgya bod kyi paṇa grub rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul de dag kyang byon nas bstan pa la bya ba 'di ltar mdzad ces pa'i gtam rgyud chos 'byung / deb ther/rnam thar sogs la bshad pa'i mdzub mo ri ston las de dag gcig 13

kyang ma bzhugs pa mngon sum tshad mas grub pas snying rlung ldang /rang gi gnyen bshes bar ma'i 'gro ba la sogs te ji snyed cig na ning dang / kha sang zla ba sngon ma phan chad yod pa 'jig rten pha rol du song ste ro med par zin pa dang ming tsam shul du lus pas rang re yang nges par 'chi/ da ni bskal pa'i snyigs ma la thug cing tshe tshad ji bzhin thub na'ang dbugs nyi khri cig stong rgyu ring la zhag gcig gi mi tshe thung du song ngo / /zhag sum cus zla ba/ zla ba bcu gnyis kyis lo 'dzad pas tshe 'dzad pa la tshegs med de/ /rgya cher rol pa las/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ku'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la blta dang mtshungs/ /'gro ba'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste/ /ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur mgyogs 'gro / /zhes skad cig kyang sdod dbang med pa la legs par bsam nas snying po len pa la mgo la me shor gyi brtson 'grus bskyed par bya'o / /gnyis pa de nyid man ngag gi sgo nas rgyud la sgom pa ni/ gang zag chos kyi go rtogs can la lung la dpags nas skyo ba bskul pa nyid rnam pa gtsang zhing rgyud la 'phrod/ las dang po pa rnam par shes pa shin tu lkog tu gyur pa'i rigs can 'ga' zhig la dpe chos dang sgrung rgyud dang / blo 'drid pa 'di gnad zab pa yin pas slob ma'i khams dang sbyar ro/ /de yang bdag nyid yid la med pa 14

zhig la ngo mi shes pa'i lung pa 'jigs su rung ba thang shin tu rgya che ba/ mi'i rgyu 'grul tsam yang med pa/ rlung si ri ri sgrog pa/ 'jag skya dbu ru zar ba'i sa cha zhig tu bslebs nas ci bya btol med cing yid slong slong por yod tsa na/ gang nas 'ong cha med pa'i skye bo pho mo kha dog dkar nag gnyis byung nas tshogs drug sgyu ma'i grong khyer bya ba na yid bzhin nor bu mching bu bya ba yod/ de len pa la chu bo chen po la gzings su zhugs nas 'gro dgos/ rang re gsum lhan du 'grogs par 'dod dam zhes zer/ de la rang nyid blo yid phyogs te khong gnyis kyi rjes su 'brangs nas song song ba las / ci zhig na rgya mtsho chen po gnam thang la bab pa 'dra ba/ rgya khyon blos mi chod pa/ dba' rlabs bar snang la 'phyo ba/ de'i nang na chu srin dang / nya bo che dang / chu mi dang / chu rta la sogs pa mdor na mig gis sngar ma mthong ba skyi g.ya' ba'i srog chags mgo lus mi mtshungs pa mang pos khengs shing / rlabs kyi gnyer ma la 'jug ldog byed pa zhig gi rtsar bslebs/ der rang nyid shin tu 'jigs shing bros 'tshal na'ang nor bu lon du re ba'i 'dod pas gdungs te khong gnyis kyis gtang ba'i gzings su zhugs te rgya mtsho chen po la brgal ba las mtsho chen po de'i dkyil tsam du bslebs pa dang / rlung dmar shin tu mi bzad pa zhig langs/ de'i 15

'jigs skrag gis ma bzod par skya ba shin tu dub cing rtsol bar brgyab pa las de gnyis kyi lag pa'i skya ba zung kyang dus gcig la thug ste chag /chu'i dba' rlabs nam mkha' la 'phyo ba lta bus res 'ga' gru gzings srid pa'i rtse mo la lding ba snyam byed/ res 'ga' chu bo bar snang la 'phyo zhing gru gzings rgya mtsho'i gting du chud pa snyam byed/ de'i tshe bros pas thar ba dang / ra mda' sbran pa dang /lag pa 'ju sa ni med/ 'chi ba 'chi ba zer ba'i 'jigs pa can de / dbugs 'byung 'jug tsam gyi khongs su btsan thabs su slebs/sngon chad 'chi ba ye ma dran pas chos byas pa'i gdeng ni med/ bu dang nor rdzas gnyen 'dun yul mi khyim mtshes dang / de ring nas bral zhing de dag gi phan pa ni til tsam med/ a tsi 'jigs pa la/da ci drag /a tsa ma/ kyi hud/ kyi hud kyi hud/ ces smre sngags dang 'o dod drag po 'don gyin yod pa'i tshe/ mdun gyi nam mkha' sku drin can gyi bla ma de nyid o rgyan chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi rnam 'gyur can du gar stabs ling ling byon nas/ kye khyod kyis 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin la yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur mthong ste 'chi chos ye nas ma dran pas lan/ khyod rang gi da lta'i snang ba a 'thas mngon zhen can 'di ni rgyu bdag nyid gcig pa'i ma rig pa las byung ngo / /bslu brid mkhan gyi skye bo pho mo gnyis ni 16

lhan skyes dang kun brtags kyi ma rig pa'o/ /rgya mtsho chen po ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' med pa'o/ /gru gzings ni dbu ba rdos pa lta bu'i zag bcas sgyu lus kyi phung po'o/ /skya ba gnyis thug gi chag pa ni nyin mtshan lteb bsnol gyi mi tshe bcar gyis zad nas bsabs thebs cis kyang med pa'o/ /kye rigs kyi bu/ da ni shi bas kyang mi chog shi tshar nas gcer bu rgyang 'phen pa'i 'dod pa bzhin khron pa'i nang du rdo 'phang pa bzhin song na de gas chog ste/ dkar nag gi las khra 'ur bsags pa thams cad gnam thig drang por btang pa bzhin du 'phyugs pa med par 'phab pas ji ltar bgyi/ zhes gsungs pas slar 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal shin tu cher song /bla ma la gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs shing ci bya gtol med par yod tsa na/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer ba thag 'dzings pa lta bu zhig skya nar gyis byung / rang gi snying gar zug pa dang gru gzings mgo mjug ldog pa dus mnyam ste bem rig bral/ sku gsum pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang du o rgyan chen po dang gnyis su med par sangs rgyas/ de lta bu'i rgyu mthun gyi 'jigs pas mnar ba'i sems can thams cad bdag gis 'dren nus pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag par bsams rjes dus gsum gyi rnam rtog thams cad rten med kha yan du glod la 'phro gnas so so'i thog tu dran pa'i byar 17

bzhag go/ /sems sbyong gnyis pa ni/ bu yig las/ byas pa thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgyur snang ba bsam pa dang / zhes pas/ dang po lung la rjes su dpag nas bsam pa ni/ mdo sde las brgya pa las/lus can rnams kyi bde sdug ni/ /las rnams yin par thub pas gsungs / /las rnams kyang ni sna tshogs la/ /de yis 'gro 'di sna tshogs byas/ /sna tshogs rnam par 'khyams shing 'jug /las kyi drwa ba 'di che'o/ /zhes gsungs pas rang re rnams kyi bde sdug bzang ngan legs nyes thams cad ni las kho na'i rjes su 'brang bar gdon mi za na/ de'i mi mthun phyogs tshe 'di'i bya bzhag dgra 'dul gnyen skyong so nam tshong khe/ khe drag lo 'dod chags sdang khong khro/ gzhan la sha tsha gros 'debs/ che thabs dang snyan grags bsgrub pa la sogs ci dang ci byas kyang yid brtan dang blo ltos rung ba mi 'dug /yo byad thabs sna tshogs kyis bsags kyang dgra rkun gyi 'dod pa bsgrubs pa yod/ zhim du re ba'i zas skom zos kyang nad ro slong zhing 'chi ba'i rkyen du gyur pa dang / phan du re nas gnyen bshes mdza' gcugs su btags kyang dgra'i dwangs mar gyur pa dang / gzhan la gnod pa la sogs ma byas kyang don med la ngan smras dang / 'phya tshig dang / skur 'debs zur zas shes rgyud bsregs pa sogs snang tshul thams cad sdug bsngal gyi 18

rang bzhin dang / sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i rgyu kho nar 'dug pas da lta phan de ltar ma go ba mtshang re che/ da legs par bsam na kha sang phan chad kyi bya byed thams cad kyang yid yul du dran pa tsam las rjes su mi 'brang bas mdang gi rmi lam dang 'dra/ de ring gi snang ba yang do nub kyi rmi lam dang mtshungs/ sang phan chad kyi bya byed rnams kyang sang nub kyi rmi lam dang 'dra ba zhig yin pa las rtag thub pa zhig mi 'dug kyang / don med mngon zhen gyi snang bas chags snang 'thab rtsod snyan mi snyan/ gsog 'jog /bde sdug /kha 'dzin gyi spyod pas dus 'da' ba 'di rang re skyon gyi gong bur 'dug /'jig rten gyi snang ba 'di kun bslu brid sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du 'dug pa la rtag brtan ther zug tu blta ba nga re 'gyod/ /da ni sang phan chad kyi bsam mno gang yang mi gtong bar bdag tu 'dzin pa la skyon du blta bar bya'o snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam mo / /gnyis pa blo brid de thabs kyis sgom pa ni/ yang rang nyid gang nas phyin cha med pa'i lung pa thag ring ngo mi 'tshal ba zhig tu slebs / gar 'gro'i gtad so med par thom thom yod tsa na/ ngo mi shes pa'i pho skyes gzhon nu brgyad byung nas de dag na re/ bdag cag ni kun gzhi mun pa'i gling bya ba nas 'ongs/ 'di nas phar la lo zla mang po brgal ba'i sa na yul rin po che'i gling bya ba na nor 19

bu'i rigs byed bsam gyis mi khyab pa mchis/ de dag len pa la ngal ba khyad du bsad nas 'gro ba yin/ khyod cag kyang de ltar mi bgyi'am zer bas blo 'gyur te de dag dang bsdongs nas bskyod de/res ni rdzi ngar can gyi rlung la 'gams/ res ni gcan gzan gdug pa'i 'phrang la bshar/ res ni chu bo chen po'i dpa' la bshams / rgyu stong rked par dkris/ mi tshe ring po la dus kyis tshad btsugs nas nyin mtshan bar med du shin tu thang chad pa'i ngang la phyin phyin pa las/ ci zhig na mi tshe yang phal cher zad/ skra dang kha spu yang dkar por song ba'i skabs shig na 'dod pa'i don grub ste rin po che'i gling nas nor bu'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob/dga' spro yang dpag tu med pa bcas rang gi yul du ldog nas yod tsa na/ zhag gsum gyis slebs rgyu'i sa'i cha 'du ba rnam bzhi'i thang bya ba der jag pa shin tu mi bsrun pa spun bdun dang phrad de/dka' bas btsal ba'i nor bu rnams phrogs/ lus la 'jags pa'i gos ni bshus/ yan lag thams cad sgrog dam pos bcings/mda' mdung ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha shin tu rnon po thogs nas brlang po'i ngag gis las ngan khyod la bla ma yod na gsol ba thob / yi dam yod na thugs rje bskul/ mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong yod na ra mda' sgron/ de dag gang yang med na 'chi ba zer ba'i 20

sgra bo che de sgom/ tshe 'di phyi zer ba'i mtshams su bslebs pa yin no / /zer ba thos pas snying rtse shum gyis song / a tsa ma/ bdag gis mi tshe kho na la tshad btsugs nas dka' ba de tsam zhig byas pa don med du song bas ma chog da ni rin chen srog dang bral ba la thug /bdag med kyi lung par gshed ma 'di lta bu dang 'phrad dus skyabs mgon dang dpung gnyen re sa ni med/ sngar dka' ba spyad pa'i las thams cad kyis phan pa ni ma byung / tshe zad long med par 'chi ba btsan thabs su bslebs nas gda'/ a tsa ma/ 'jigs pa la / kyi hud kyi hud/ ces smre sngags dang 'o dod drag po 'bod kyin yod pa'i tshe/ mdun gyi nam mkhar o rgyan chen po phyag rgya bzhi ldan gyi rnam par byon nas 'od zer spro bsdus mi rgod rnams rgyang ring par bskrad rjes/ kye las ngan gyi sems can khyod kyis 'khor ba'i bya ba btsan dug lta bu la ro brgya dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi lta bur chags pas len/ sngar ngo ma shes pa'i pho skyes brgyad ni rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi bzhon pas rig pa'i ye shes bslus pa yin/ rin po che'i gling gi nor bu ni tshe 'di'i bde skyid rmi lam lta bu rtag mi thub pa yin/ dka' ba sna tshogs spyad pa ni sdug bsngal dang du blangs pas bslu ba'i gzhi bsgrub pa yin/ skra dang kha spu mdog 'gyur ba ni/ sdug bsngal bde bar 'dzin pa la 'khrul bzhin pa'i 21

ngang du mi tshe 'dzad pa yin/ 'du ba rnam bzhi'i thang du jag pas srog la rgol ba ni bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kyis gtses te 'chi bdag gshin rjes dbang med du srog gtor ba yin/ kye khyod 'dra ba'i las ngan/ khyod kyis srid pa la zhen pa'i bya ba ji snyed cig byas kyang 'gag la thug na de dang 'dra ba yin zhes gsungs pa thos pas sngar byas la lhag par 'gyod/ tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad sdug bsngal kho na'i rang bzhin du shes nas/ o rgyan chen po la gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs pa'i snang ba shar ba na thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu zhig byung ba rang gi snying gar zug pa dang dus mnyam du pad+ma 'od kyi zhing du skad cig la skyes nas sems can thams cad 'dren pa'i ded dpon dam par gyur par bsam la shes pa rang babs su ngal bso bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/bu yig las/ rigs drug gi sems can la snying rje skye zhing / las su dkon mchog mchod cing dkar po dge ba'i las bskyed pa dang /zhes pas de ltar 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang byas pa thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du go ba tsam gyi blo yod kyang chos byed lugs kyi gnad 'gag ma go na/ chos kyi mthun rkyen du ming btags pa'i zas gos longs spyod srid pa'i phun tshogs la chog mi shes/ gcig zlar gcig dgos/ blo ngan lang shor gyi yo byad sna tshogs la thabs 22

du mas rtsol sgrub la rem/ chos brgyad kho nas mi tshe 'dzad pa mang bas de'i phyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam zhing rigs drug gi sems can la snying rje bskyed par bya/ de yang mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin / /zhes 'khor ba la sdug bsngal kho na las bde ba yod par ma gsungs / de'i nang nas kyang ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal ni slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ dmyal sogs sdug bsngal bsam byas na/ /'dod pa rnams la mtshon dang ni/ /dug dang me dang g.yang sa dang / /dag rnams kyis kyang dper mi phod/ /ces sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzad par gsungs pa ltar rang nyid kyang shi ba'i 'og tu mar me shi ba'am rtsa phung mes bsregs pa ltar shul med du song na de gas chog kyang / skye ba zhig mi 'dod kyang len dgos/ skye ba de yang bde 'gror len pa'i rgyu sngon chad rang gis blo bde sing nge ba byas pa'i rigs ni cher mi gda'/ tshe rabs snga ma rnams su'ang cher ma bsags pa'i rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bus da lta slebs gda' mod/ mi dge ba'i las ni rtsed mo'i zhor tsam du'ang bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsags tshar/ de'i 'bras bus ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal myong dgos pa byung na tshe 'di ka la byung ba dang / lus rten phyi ma la byung ba gnyis khyad par rdul tsam med/ 'di ltar dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 23

ni / bshes spring las/ dmyal ba bris pa mthong dang thos pa dang / /dran dang bklags sam gzugs su bgyis pas kyang / /sdug bsngal skye bar 'gyur na mi bzod pa'i/ /rnam smin nyams su myong ba smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal rang gi rgyud thog tu ma bsam na gzhan gyi sdug bsngal la ltad mo blta ba lta bus rang rgyud la mi skye/ las dang po bas rang mthun gyi sems can la snying rje yang skye dka' bas sdug bsngal de rang thog la byung bar bsam pa'i blo nang du bkug nas sgom dgos te rdzogs pa chen po'i 'das rjes las kyang / rigs drug sdug bsngal blo la blangs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i don bsam par bya ba ni/ gnas dben par song ste/ gang na phyin cha med pa'i gangs ri chen po'i stongs/ zhabs thams cad 'khyags sdug gis gang la/ char rlung shin tu mi bzad pas mun pa nog nog por byed pa zhig tu slebs pas shin tu grang ba'i snang ba shar te tsha ba don du gnyer ba'i bsam pa shar ba na skad cig la rmi lam 'khrul pa ltar tsha dmyal du skyes te 'og thams cad lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi/ 'khor yug thams cad kyang lcags bsregs kyi nga ba/ steng 'og go mtshams med pa me lce dmar lhab lhab bas khengs shing / 'khrug pa'i klong du yang sos kyi tshe tshad mi lo bye ba phrag 'bum drug khri nyis stong sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems 24

can rang dang rang 'dra dpag tu med pa de dag zhe sdang gi dbang las phan tshun gcig gis gcig la mtshon cha sna tshogs bdeg res byas pas lus tshal ba brgya stong du song bas na tsha ma bzod par res 'ga' dran med du brgyal zhing / shi ba snyam byed pa'i tshe nam mkha'i dkyil nas/ yang sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgra skad lhang lhang byung bas rkyen byas/ yang sngar ltar sos te sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzod pa khor yug tu myong ngo / /dmyal ba thig nag ni/ mi lo bye ba phrag sa ya nyis 'bum dgu khri drug stong bcu gnyis / dmyal srung 'jigs su rung bas rang lus la thig brgyad btab ste sog le rnon pos gshags/ de'i na tsha shin tu ma bzod nas 'o dod 'bod cing 'bros pa'i snang ba shar ro/ /de nas bsdus 'joms mi lo bye ba phrag gsum 'bum phrag drug khri brgyad stong rtsa gcig sgom ste/ri bo glang ser ra lug lta bu'i gdong dbyibs can gyi bar du tshud/lus de dag gi bar du sgong lpags gcar ba ltar btsir bas ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad nas khrag gi rgyun chi li li 'bab/ na tsha dang sdug bsngal ma bzod par de nas 'bros pa'i snang ba shar ro/ /dmyal ba ngu 'bod ni/ mi lo bye ba phrag sa ya gnyis dang bye ba phrag dgu 'bum bzhi khri stong bye ba bdun/ lcags kyi khang pa'i nang du slebs pa dang sgo dbyer med du 'grig /phyogs mtshams thams cad nas me 'bar 25

bas lus rdul phran lta bur bsreg go/ /da ni 'bros sa yang mi 'dug snyam nas ngu skad lhang lhang 'bod pa'i tshe/ ngu 'bod chen po mi lo bye ba phrag sa ya gsum dang bye ba phrag lnga 'bum lnga khri nyis stong drug cu rtsa drug /zhes lcags khang de la slar yang lcags khang rim pa gcig gis gtums pa'i nang du tshud pas da ni nang ma nas thon kyang phyi ma nas mi thon snyam pa'i sdug bsngal snga ma las nyis 'gyur gyis che ba myong zhing shin tu nyam thag go/ /tsha ba ni mi lo bye ba phrag sa ya brgyad dang bzhi 'bum bye ba phrag khri drug stong lnga brgya sum cu'o/ /lcags kyi gsal shing me 'bar bas 'phongs nas spyi bo'i bar tal mar phug ste dbang po'i sgo thams cad nas me lce dmar lhab lhab 'bar ba dang / res 'ga' lus ril po khro chu khol ma'i nang du btsos nas sha rus skya khrol gyis 'brel ba'i sdug bsngal myong ngo / /yang rab tu tsha ba'i dmyal ba tshe tshad bar gyi bskal ba phyed de mi'i lo grangs kyi gzhal ba'i yul las 'das/ gsal shing rtse gsum gyi dbus ma spyi bo dang logs gnyis po phrag pa g.yas g.yon du tal mar phug pa dang / lcags bsregs leb mos lus la snam bu ltar dkri ba dang / khro chu khol ma'i nang du sha rjen la btsos pas sha lpags rnams 'thor keng rus ltar skya khrol gyi 'gro bar skyes nas snga ma'i sdug bsngal las brgya 'gyur gyi che bas zug rngu ma bzod par/ a ra dang / u khyu dang / kyi hud kyi sgra drag pos 26

'bod cing de nas 'bros pa'i snang ba shar ro/ /mnar med pa'i dmyal ba phyogs 'jig rten chags 'jig gnas stongs te bskal chung bzhir bar bskal gcig ste de'i tshe tshad yin no/ /mtshams dang mu med par rab tu tsha ba'i me 'bar bas lus dang me gnyis su med par bsreg cing ngu ba'i skad lhang lhang thos pa tsam las lus kyi dngos po 'di zhes mi mngon pa'i sdug bsngal bzod blag med par myong zhing / a tsa ma/a ra ra/ u khyu/ kyi hud kyi hud/ zhes 'o dod dang smre sngags drag po 'don gyin yod par sgom/ slar mdun gyi nam mkhar o rgyan bde chen rgyal po skad cig la byon nas/ kye ma las ngan gyi sems can/khyod kyis rgyu zhe sdang gis kun nas bslangs pa'i las rngam po che bsags / yul khyad par can la khong khro drag po byas pas 'bras bu dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal de lta bu myong ba yin/ da mi dge ba'i las rnams 'gyod pa drag pos bshags/ rang dang rigs mthun pa'i sems can thams cad la snying rje drag po bsgom/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal yang rang gis len pa'i snying stobs bskyed na 'di las thar ba srid de/ sngon shākya thub pa dmyal ba'i gnas su gyad pak+shi ta bya bar skyes nas shing rta 'dren pa la/ grogs ka ma ru pas shing rta ma 'drongs nas dmyal sung khros te mgo la lcags kyi tho lum bsnun pas grogs po la snying rje tshad med par skyes/ 'di'i shing rta'i thag 27

pa yang bdag gi gnya' bar thogs shig ces bde sdug brje bar thugs bskyed pas/ dmyal srung na re rang rang gi las la spyod pa sus ci bya zhes dbu la tho bas brdegs pa skad cig la tshe 'phos nas sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes te sdug bsngal las grol lo/ /zhes gtam rgyud dang bcas gsungs pa thos pas/ rang 'dra'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal 'di las thar na bdag da dung 'di kur gnas na'ang bzod par bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed ma thag o rgyan chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po lcags kyu lta bu zhig skya tal gyis byung / de dang gnyis su med par sangs rgyas don gnyis lhun grub kyi mthu can du gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngar ltar 'od zer spros pas sems can de dag skad cig la 'drongs te dmyal ba'i gnas stongs par bsam mo/ /zhar la dmyal ba de dag gi tshe tshad ni/ thun mong gi mdo sde dran pa nyer gzhag dang / las rnam 'byed/ mngon pa mdzod la sogs las bgrang byar gsungs kyang / 'dir gnyen pos zin pa'i dbang du byas te nges pa med par bshad pa ste/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ gnyen po drag po rgyud la skyes pa la sogs pas glo bur du'ang 'pho ba dang / rdo rje slob dpon la brnyas pa la sogs pas bskal chen du mar gnas dgos par bshad pas las kyi sgrib pas phye ba yin no/ /zhes dang / gong du 28

bshad ma thag pa'i gyad pak+shi ta dang / mdza' bo'i bu mo'i gtam rgyud la sogs pas kyang shes so/ /de nas grang dmyal bsam pa ni/ yang rang nyid gang na phyin cha med pa'i sa gzhi thams cad bye tshan gyi rang bzhin la bsil bu'i rlung tsam yang mi 'gul zhing / nyi ma'i tsha gdung gis shin tu dub pa'i lung pa zhig tu slebs/ shes pa lung ma bstan du thom thom 'gro zhing 'di las cung zhig bsil ba zhig yod na snyam pas rkyen byas/tsha gdung gi snang ba 'gags nas skad cig la grang dmyal brgyad du skye ba sgom ste sa gzhi thams cad kha ba'i rang bzhin/ gcong rong dang ngam grog thams cad 'khyags ram gyis gang ba mtha' thams cad gangs ri chen pos bskor zhing / steng nas kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa mun pa nag thum thum byed cing rlung gi ngar sgra 'u ru ru sgrog pa'i nang du/ chu bur can gyi dmyal ba kha ba'i bu yug dang rlung gi reg byas lus la btab pas skad cig skad cig la lus la chu bur mi bzod pa 'char zhing sha lpags thams cad 'khums nas skyi bung byed pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa dang / de las chu bur de dag brdol nas rnag khrag chi li li 'dzag pa dang / de bas sdug bsngal cher song ste a chu zhes skad kyi gdangs drag por 'don pa dang /da dung sngar bas sdug bsngal je cher song bas skad kyi zungs kyang 29

chag ste kyi hud ces rkan gyi phyugs nas 'don pa dang / de bas kyang je cher 'phel bas skad kyang ma thon par so tham tham byed pa dang / de la rlung chen po'i ngar gyis btab pas kha dog kyang sngo lhang gis song zhing ut+pal ltar ser kha phra mo drug tu gas pa dang /da dung grang zug gis pags pa rnams kyang bshus te sha'u dmar hu re pad+ma ltar tshal ba bcur gas pa dang / slar ser kha de bas kyang mang du song ste pad+ma ltar cher gas nas snga ma rnams kyi sdug bsngal las brgya 'gyur gyis che ba myong zhing / sdug bsngal de yang grong khyer ma ga dha'i bra bo che'i khal brgyad cu shong ba'i til gyi gang ba nas lo brgya brgya'i mtshams su til rdog re phyung bas de zad pa'i tshe chu bur can gyi tshe tshad du bshad pa sogs go nas shin tu yi mug cing sgyid lug par sgom/ slar mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid o rgyan chen po'i cha lugs su byon nas bu rang gi sdug bsngal las su shes par gyis la zad pa'i dga' ba sgom/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal snying rje drag po'i bsam pas da dung bsnon mar long la gnyen po khyad par can brten cig ces gsungs thos pa tsam gyis/ bdag lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong ba'i grang dmyal gyi sems can thams cad snying re rje/ bdag gi de dag gi skal ba myong nas 'di bas sdug bsngal 'bum 'gyur gyis che ba byung yang bzod par bya'o/ /sems 30

can de dag sdug bsngal las thar bar shog cig ces pa'i sems bskyed ma thag las ngan skad cig la zad de o rgyan chen po'i thugs kur yer gyis 'phos nas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon dam par gyur par bsam la/ bde sdug gang shar gyi rang ngo la lta zhing shes pa rnal du dbab bo/ /de nas yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ bshes pa'i spring yig las / yi dwags na'ang 'dod pas phongs pa yis/ /bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal rgyun chags mi 'chos la / /bkres skom grang dro ngal dang 'jigs pa yis/ /bskyed pa shin tu mi bzad bstan 'tshal lo/ /zhes yi dwags la rigs gsum du yod par bshad pa'i sdug bsngal rags pa tsam blo la blang ba ni/yang rang nyid zas gos dang dngos po la chags sred zhen pa'i dbang gis yul khyad par can mchod pa dang bkur sti lta bu la ser sna skyes pa'i bsam pas rkyen byas skad cig la yi dwags phyi'i sgrib pa can du skye ba bsgom ste/ ljon shing gi 'bras bu dang / chu klung sogs la longs spyod pa'i bsam pas thag ring por thang chad chad phyin pa na/ skye bo mtshon cha thogs pas bsrungs ba dang / rnag khrag la sogs yid du mi 'ong par song nas shin tu skyengs shing bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal bzod mi phod pa dang / yang nang gi sgrib pa can gong khyer ser skya chu dang rtsi shing sogs 'dod pa'i dngos po 31

ci yang med pa'i mya ngam gyi gnas der zas skom lo zla'i bar du mi rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal/ gal te sman tsam rnyed kyang kha khab mig tsam gyi nang du mi shong / cung zad shong yang mgrin pa rta rnga tsam gyi sbubs la mi thar/ thar kyang lto ba ri rab tsam pa mi khengs shing yan lag 'jag ma tsam gyis lus mi theg pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal shin tu nyam thag pa myong / spyi mthun gyi sgrib ba can zas skom lto ba'i nang du tshud pa dang de dag kyang me 'bar nas lus tshig /rang rang gis za ba dang / bshang gci za bas nyam thag /sos ka drod dang ldan pa'i tshe zla ba'i reg bya grang ba de yang tsha bar 'gyur/dgun grang ba'i ngar dang ldan pa'i tshe nyi ma'i 'od zer yang bsil bar gyur nas tsha grang khod mi snyoms/ chu klung gi rigs bltas pa tsam gyis skams te ngam grog nyams mi dga' bar 'char ba sogs bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong / de lta bu'i sdug bsngal yang yun thung ngus mi chog par mi lo tshig khri lnga stong myong dgos par shes pas yi mug cing sgyid lug par sgom/ slar mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid o rgyan chen po'i cha byad can du byon nas/ kye khyod kyis ser snas bsags pa'i sdug bsngal rang thog tu 'phyug pa med par babs pa la dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis kyang skyob par dka'/ rgyal ba shākya thub pas rgyal po gzugs can 32

snying po la gsungs pa ltar las bdag gir byos la las ngan zad pa'i dga' ba sgom/ rang 'dra'i sems can gyi sdug bsngal snying rje'i bsam pas/ rang gi sdug bsngal gyi kha bsnon la len pa'i snying stobs bskyed la gnyen po brten cig /ces gsung thos pa tsam gyis a tsa ma/ bdag 'dra ba'i sems can gces 'dzin kho nas da lta phan 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams shing sdug bsngal 'di lta bu myong / bdag dang rigs mthun pa'i yi dwags gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi rdul grangs dang ldan pa dag me'ang sdug bsngal 'di kho na yod pas shin tu snying rje/ da ni rang gi sdug bsngal bzod par byas nas sems can gzhan gyi sdug bsngal yang dang du blang bar bya/ yi dwags kyi grong khyer rmang nas stongs par shog cig bsam pa'i mod las ngan skad cig la zad de o rgyan chen po'i dgongs pa dang gnyis su med par sangs rgyas/ sems can de dag kyang bdag gi thugs ku'i 'od zer gyis drangs par bsam la 'phro gnas kyi mkhan po la brtag go/ /de yang gong gi dmyal ba la ji skad du/'dul ba lung las/ de nas mo'u gal gyi bus rgya mtsho'i mthar phyin pa las/ nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba gtun lta bu dang / phyags ma lta bu dang / ljon shing lta bu rab tu mang po sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa mthong ste/ zhes dang / nye 'khor ba ni brgyad tshan gnyis 33

kyi khongs na yod pa so so'i gnas ni theg mchog mdzod du/ nyi tshe ba ni sa chu me rlung sna tshogs na nges pa med par yod la/ nye 'khor ba ni brgyad tshan gnyis kyi 'khor na yod do/ /zhes rigs gcig gis bsdus pa dang / bshad ma thag pa'i yi dwags la'ang kun mkhyen chen pos/ yi dwags dbyings mkhar rgyu ba'i dbyings gnas pa / /zhes pa'i dbyings na gnas pa snga ma'i gsum po yin la/mkha' la rgyu ba'am phran tshegs pa ni shing rta rtsa bar/ mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags 'dre rnams dang / /gnod sbyin srin po btsan dang rgyal po sogs/ /zhes pa la sogs pas bstan pa ltar slob ma dbang po rnon po la spros nas 'chad dge ba gsum gyi don khrid nang /shes par bya zhing gzhan du ni dkyus su bshad pas don 'grub bo/ /de nas dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam zhing blo sbyang ba ni/ bshes spring la sa/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang gsod pa dang / /bcing dang brdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa/ /zhi gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni/ gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzad pa/ /zhes dud 'gro la byings dang kha 'thor ba ste rnam grangs gnyis su rigs bsdus te sa sde las bshad pa'i sdug bsngal bsams shing blo la blang ba ni/ yang rang nyid gti mug mun pa lta bu'i nyon mongs pas rkyen byas te skad cig nyid la phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du byings na 34

gnas pa'i dud 'gro nya dang / dung dang chu srin la sogs pas go mtshams med pa chang 'gag gi spang ma ltar lcig cig yod pa'i nang du skyes par sgom/ res 'ga' rang nyid che bar gyur pa'i tshe chung ba rnams kyis lus tal mar phugs nas snying la mda' rdzog pa lta bu'i na tsha/ res 'ga' chung bar gyur pa'i tshe che ba rnams kyis khyur mid du zos nas lus lcags kyi par bur bcug pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal/gling 'di dang gling gzhan gyi phyi mtha'i lcags ri gnyis kyi go dbar nyi zla'i snang ba med pa'i mun nag gi khrod rang gi lag pa brkyang bskum tsam mi mthong ba'i khrod du sdug bsngal du bro ba dang / kha 'thor ba'i dud 'gro bya ri dwags 'bu sbrang gcan gzan la sogs te bdag tu ma bzung ba rnams la rang bzhin gyi sdug bsngal tsha grang bkres skom gcig gis gcig za bas do nub da lta se gol gtogs yun tsam gyi ring la tshe 'di phyi'i mtshams su yod cing mi sogs mig gis mthong tshad gshed ma khong lag can du mthong nas snang ba thams cad dogs par 'char bas lto kham re za ba'i ring la mgo bo phyogs mtshams brgyad du bya rar g.yeng ba dang / khyad par du rngon pa dang / nya ba dang / bya gshor ba dag gis brtse ba med pa'i 'jigs pa du mas skad gcig la gsod pa dang / bdag tu bzung ba'i dud 'gro/ rta nor dang / ra lug /ba glang la sogs pa 35

thams cad kyang / kha la lcags kyi sgrog g.yogs te zhon nas rgyang ring por mnar ba dang / 'ga' zhig lus gnam sa bsgyur te brang dron mo'i kha gri rnon pos gshags nas lto lag btang ste srog dbugs kyi rgyu ba gcod pa dang / gzhan dag sna 'bigs pa dang /bya gcod pa dang / brdeg pa dang / gson khrag 'byin pa dang / khal theg tshad 'gel ba dang / de bzhin du klu rnams la yang bye tshan dang —/ nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang / rigs sngags dang /gcig gis gcig spong ste gyur mi tshud cing grogs med pa dang / spyi mthun du rmongs pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang tshe tshad ma nges pa myong ba sogs dud 'gro de dag thams cad kyang blang dor mi shes pa'i rang bzhin can te de dag gi sdug bsngal re re nas bsam ste 'khor ba la skyug log gi 'gro bar bya dgos te/ kun mkhyen gyis/ 'di dag bsams nas byol song 'jig rten las/ /thar 'dod rnams kyi phan bde bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mngon mtho nges legs lam bzang srol gtod la/ /nyin mtshan brtson pas dge la gzhol bar mdzod/ /ces gsungs so/ /de dag kyang mthar chags su sdug bsngal myong zin pa'i mthar rang nyid klur skyes pa/ nam mkha' lding gis bar snang la khyer nas da ni dbugs phyi nang gang gi mtshams kyang tshe 'di phyi'i so mtshams su slebs pa a re 'jigs/36

stobs ldan gyi 'dab chags 'jigs pa can 'di lta bus bdag nyid gson zas byed pa a tsi/ 'jigs pa la/ 'jigs pa la/ kyi hud / kyi hud/ ces dran pa 'thor ba tsam gyis 'jigs skrag gi ro myong / slar steng gi nam mkha' la rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid o rgyan chen po'i cha lugs su byon nas/ kye las ngan gyi sems can 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal dang 'jigs skrag myong dgos pa'ang 'khor ba mtha' med du bdag gces 'dzin kho na lhur blangs pas lan/ da ni bdag bas gzhan gces kyi byang chub kyi sems khyad par can sgom na 'di las grol ba'i thabs yin te/ sngon bstan pa'i bdag po shākya seng ges byang chub kyi spyod pa la bslabs pa'i tshe mdza' bo'i bu mo zhes bya bar skyes nas mas bsrungs kyang ma nyan par ma'i mgo la 'gongs nas rgya mtshor nor bu len du phyin pas gru gzings zhig /shing leb gcig la 'jus pas/ mtsho gling zhig tu 'thon/ de nas rim par phyin pa'i ci zhig na lcags kyi khang pa zhig tu mi zhig gi mgo la lcags kyi 'khor lo bskor nas klad pa'i dkyil du 'bugs cing 'dug /ci byas pa yin dris pas ma'i mgo la 'gongs pa'i rnam smin yin zer/ 'o na nga yang las kyis 'dir 'khrid pa yin snyam pa dang / nam mkha' las sgra byung ste bcings pa gang yin pa grol bar 'gyur ro/ /grol ba gang yin pa bcings par 37

'gyur ro zer nas 'khor lo rang gi mgo thog tu byung ste bskor bas bzod thabs med pa'i sdug bsngal byung ngo / /de'i rkyen gyis rang 'dra'i sems can rnams la snying rje drag po skyes/ 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can mang po yod pas snying re rje/ de dag gi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal bdag la 'byung bar shog cig snyam du dgongs pa dang de ma thag 'khor lo nam mkha' la 'phur te sdug bsngal las grol lo/ /des na bdag bas gzhan gces kyi bsam pa 'di nus pa shin tu che ba yin pas rang 'dra'i sems can dpag tu med pa yod pa de dag la snying rje chen po bskyed do/ /de dag gi sdug bsngal khyod rang gi 'di'i bsnon mar longs la dga' ba sgoms shig /ces gsung thos pa tsam gyis rang 'dra'i sems can la snying rje drag po bskyed cing bde sdug gtong len gyi snying stobs bskyed pa tsam gyis las ngan skad cig la zad/'jigs pa la rmi lam gyi snang ba ltar bden med du yal nas o rgyan chen po dang gnyis su med par sangs rgyas/ dud 'gro'i rigs kyi sems can thams cad la 'od zer spros pas de dag gcig kyang ma lus pa bya khyu la 'ur rdo 'phangs pa ltar rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i gral du drangs par bsams la rtogs pa'i spun thag bcad nas dran shes kha yan du glod par bya'o/ ༈ de nas bde 'gro 38

la'ang bde ba med par bsam pa ni/ 'o na ngan song gsum la skyes na de ltar yin kyang bde 'gro thob na sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba 'ba' zhig go snyam na ma yin te bshes spring du/ mtho ris na yang bde chen de dag gi/ /'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal nyid ni de bas che/ /zhes dang / lha yi 'jig rten dag na 'phos pa la/ /gal te dge ba'i lhag ma 'ga' med na/ /de nas dbang med dud 'gro yi dwags dang / /dmyal bar gnas pa gang yang rung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang /mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las/ mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams/ /lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ /lha min 'thab cing rtsod pas nyams//'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mtho ris mi'i bde 'gro thob kyang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal brtsegs mar 'byung ba pha shi ba'i thog tu ma yang 'das pa lta bur 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal da lta bde ba ltar yod 'phro kho na la glo bur gyi sdug bsngal dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas zos pa'am/rtsed mo'i ched du chu brgal bas bying ste skad cig la srog 'dor ba lta bu khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni zas gos dang spyod lam nyes pas shin tu dos drag pa'i nad myong ba'am/ mi btsan po la rgol ba byas pas phyis gnod pa'i lan 'du byed pa lta bu ste/ rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal chen po gsum/ de skad du 'dul ba lung las/39

'khor ba sdug bsngal can phung po/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal 'du byed dang / /'gyur ba nyid gsum brgyad rnams kyis/ /mi rnams shin tu sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal gsum gyi steng du skye ba dang / rgas pa dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / dgra mi sdug pa dang 'phrad pa dang / gnyen byams pa po dang bral ba dang /'dod pa thog tu ma khel bas phongs pa dang / nyer len gyi phung po lngas sdug bsngal gtan du 'dzin pa ste rnams pa brgyad kyis mnar bas shin tu sdug bsngal lo/ /de'i phyir kun mkhyen chen pos/ de ltar mi yis 'jig rten mtha' dag na'ang / /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras nyid phyir bde ba med/ /de las thar phyir legs pa'i chos bsam ste / /'khor ba'i gnas las thar pa'i thabs 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du 'dod lha'i gnas na'ang sdug bsngal tshad med de/ 'di ltar rgyal chen rigs bzhi dang / aṅgi rnams ni mi'i lo grangs te/ lha gnas so so'i zhag re yin la/ de'i lo zla'i 'gyur gyis brtsis nas rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lo lnga brgya la yang sos kyi zhag gcig /sum cu rtsa gsum pa nas rim par lo stong dang / nyis stong dang / bzhi stong dang / brgyad stong dang / khri drug stong rnams thig nag dang / bsdus 'joms dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba rnams kyi zhag re yin la/ rab tu tsha ba dang mnar med pa ni gzhal bya des ma yin te gong du bshad / sum cu rtsa gsum dang 100/ mtshe ma dang 200/ dga' ldan dang 400/ 'phrul dga' dang 800/ gzhan 'phrul dbang 40

byed 1600kyi bar de dag bde ba ltar snang yang / 'gyur ba dang /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal kho nas mnar/ 'chi ba'i tshe lus kyi mdog mi sdus pa dang / me tog rnying pa dang / nyams mi dga' ba dang / lha zla bos spong zhing 'du shes 'khrugs pa dang / phyi ma gang du skye ba'i gnas lha'i mig gis mthong bas rkyen byas skrag ste brgyal ba na lha pha ma'am/ mdza' bshes la sogs pas rgyang ring po nas bos te/'dzam bu'i gling du mi rnams kyi nang du skye bar shog cig /der yang dge ba bcu spyad nas phyis kyang lha'i gnas 'dir skye bar shog cig /ces yid smon khar bton/ me tog gtor nas rgyang ring por 'bros pa de lta bu'i sdug bsngal lha'i zhag bdun du spyod pas nyam thag /'o skol mi rnams 'chi ba'i tshe gnyen bshes kyis mal mtha' bskor nas de'i 'dod pa thabs du mas skong na'ang shin tu sdug bsngal cing yi mug na lha dag 'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal lta ci smos/gzhan yang tshangs ris nas 'bras bu chen po'i bar te gzugs khams bsam gtan gyi lha gzi byin gyi dpal dang ldan pa de dag kyang 'chi ba'i tshe/ da lta'i bde ba de nyid 'gyur nas srid pa phyi mar 'jug pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med de 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis / tshangs ris la sogs bsam gtan lhun grub kun/ /'od dang kha dog gzi brjid mthong bas kyang / /bdag rtog bag la nyal ba 41

ma gzigs nas/ /shi nas dmyal bar skye ba cha med dam/ /zhes gsungs la/ de bzhin du gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i nye rgyu ma yin pa'i lung ma bstan gyi bsam gtan nyi tshe bar 'byams/ ci zhig na 'chi 'phos nas srid pa phyi ma'i sdug bsngal nam mkha' la 'phur ba'i 'dab chags nges par sa la babs pa bzhin nges med du myang na gnas skabs kyi bde ba la yid brtan par byed pa ni mtshang re che ste/ slob spring las/ sdug bsngal me tshogs phung pos 'jigs pa'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /skye bo bde snyoms mngon pa'i nga rgyal byed pa gang / /de ni gshin rje'i kha yang 'byed pa byed pa ste/ /de ni skye ba phyi ma'i ljon shing sa bon yin / /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang 'di ltar lha min rnams la ni sdug bsngal de bas kyang dpal tsha ste/ bshes spring las/ lha min dag na'ang rang bzhin lha yi/ /dpal la snang phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal che / /de dag blo dang ldan na'ang 'gro ba yi/ /sgrib pas bden pa mthong ba ma mchis so/ /zhes sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i skyid pa dang 'byor pa mthong nas/ khong khro dang phrag dog gi mes gdungs nas lha dang 'thabs pa'i tshe g.yul ngor/ rdo rje dang / mda' dang /'khor lo la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs pas mgo dang yan lag gcod cing / srog 'gag /lus shin tu snad pa dang / 'chi ba la thug 12

pa'i sdug bsngal shin tu ma bzad pas mnar ro/ /gal te blo dang ldan pa dag yod kyang sgrib pa'i dbang gis nyan thos rang gi mthong lam mi thob pas bden pa mi mthong zhes bshad la theg pa chen po'i lugs su ni de ltar ma yin par dkon mchog brtsegs pa las gsungs pa kun mkhyen chen pos lung 'dren mdzad mod/ ji ltar yang der srid pa spong ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos pa ni kun mkhyen gyis / lha min pa dag shin tu sdug bsngal na/ /de bas dge las zhi ba'i 'gro ba dag /myur ba nyid du dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' med cing dos drag pa gcig nas thar kyang gcig tu 'dzud pa zo chun 'khyud mo'am/ bum nang gi bung ba bzhin sdug bsngal kho na'i rang bzhin can te/ slob spring las/ gang zhig 'khor ba'i 'khor lor rtag tu 'khor 'gyur ba'i/ /nang du zhugs nas bste ba tsam la bder sems pa/ /de ni nges par dbang med rim gyis brgya phrag tu / /'gro ba mnyam dang mi mnyam kun tu 'khyams par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na ngan 'gro'i gnas dang rigs drug thun mong gi sdug bsngal thams cad sangs rgyas kyis skyobs pas a'u tsi mod snyam na/ de ltar ma yin te/ 'dul ba lung las/ ngas ni khyod la thar pa'i lam bstan gyi/ /thar pa rang la rag las brtsen par 43

gyis / /zhes gsungs pas rang cag rnams blang dor la rmongs pa'i phyir bde bar gshegs pas thabs du ma'i sgo nas thar pa'i lam bstan pa tsam las/ 'khor ba dang ngan song las thar ba ni rang gi brtson pa kho na yin pas dper na gnyid kyis myos pa'i tshe rmi lam sus kyang dgag mi nus pa bzhin no/ /gal te de lta min na sangs rgyas thugs rje can de dag gcig gi thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis kyang srid pa 'di dpag tu med pa'i snga rol nas stongs par mdzad zin nges so/ /de bas na 'o skol 'khor ba'i dong du ni lhung / gzung 'dzin gyi sgrog dam pos ni bcings/ nyon mongs pa'i mtshon gyis ni bsnun/ da lta'i sdug bsngal la spyod cing phyi ma'i sdug bsngal 'dren pa las 'os med pa 'dir legs par bsams nas rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la snying rje dpag tu med par bskyed/sems can de dag thams cad thar pa'i lam la bkri ba'i ched du nyi ma de ring nas bzung yon tan thams cad 'byung gnas dkon mchog gsum thabs du ma'i sgo nas mchod pa dang / mi dge ba'i bsam pa skad cig ma yan chad la gnyen po drag pos gcun nas bshags sdom bya ste/ 'dul ba lung las/ sdig pa chung ngu dag la yang / /mi gnod snyam du brnyes mi bya/ /me stag phra mo dag gis kyang //rtsa phung ri tsam sreg par byed/ /ces gsungs la/ dge ba'i bsam 44

pa cha shas phra mo tshun chod nas bsag cing dkar po dge ba'i las 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar byed dgos/ 'ga' zhig bdag shes rab chung bas thos bsam mi nus snyam pa dang / 'ga' zhig bdag longs spyod dman pas zag bcas zang zing gi mchod sbyin mi 'grub snyam pa dang / 'ga' zhig bdag na so rgas pas chos mi yong snyam pa sogs smra zhing sems pa'ang gtso bor sems kho nas ma nus pa yin te brtson 'grus dang spobs pa bskyed na dud 'gros kyang thar pa bsgrub nus par gsungs na mi yis lta ci smos te/ shān+da de bas/ bdag gi byang chub ga la zhes/ /sgyid lug par ni mi bya ste/ /'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /bden par gsungs pas bden 'di gsungs/ /sbrang bu sha sbrang bung ba dang / /de bzhin srin bur gang gyur pa/ /des kyang brtson pa'i stobs bskyed na/ /byang chub thob dka'i bla med thob/ /bdag lta'i rigs kyi mir skyes la/ /phan dang gnod pa ngo shes nas/ /byang chub spyod pa ma btang na/ /bdag gis byang chub cis mi thob/ /ces dang / mdo sde rgyan las/gal te sems can mir gyur pa/ /tshad med skad cig re re la/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob de'i phyir/ /zhum pa dang du blang mi bya/ / rizhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang dge ba'i las ji snyed pa la'ang chog tshod dang / rtsis grangs kyis khrigs su bcad par mi bya 45

ste / sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig la chags par ma byed cig /chos kyi sgo gcig dang / spyod pa gcig yongs su rdzogs pas chog par ma 'dzin cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpas ni dge ba'i rtsa ba tshad med pa yongs su bsdu bar bya dgos so/ /zhes gsungs/ da lta 'o skol gyi dge ba ci tsam zhig 'bad kyang de nyid sdig pa mi dge ba'i las dang ma 'dres pa'ang rnam par dpyad na 'ong mi thub pa'i phyir dang / gal te re re tsam srid na'ang yid can phal cher blo mig ma dag pas sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis zin pa'i dam pa gsum dang 'brel ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gsog pa shin tu dkon la/ de'i phyir bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge 'bras lan gcig smin nas zad par gyur pa dag ni dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab tsam yod par rlom yang ston ku'i sprin dang 'dra ste shin tu ya ma brla bas lag pa brkyang bskum tsam gyi bsam pa'ang dge ba'i las 'ba' zhig tu 'gro bar bya dgos so/ /sems sbyong bzhi pa ni/ bu yig las/ bla ma'i gdams ngag gcig ci nas kyang thob par bya zhing / thabs gang gi sgo nas kyang thob par bya dgos snyam pa dang / zhes pas/ de ltar sngar bshad ma thag pa'i rigs drug gang du 'khor kyang sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las bde ba khab kyi rtse tsam ma mchis par shes pa dang /46

bo ba tsam yod kyang de la yi mug byes pa gcig pus sdug bsngal de las thar ba ma yin te/ de la phan pa'i thabs kho nar lhur len dgos / de gang yin na/ gsal rgyal la gdams pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po de'i tshe/ de'i dus na dam pa'i chos ma gtogs mgon dang skyabs med do/ /dam pa'i chos ni de'i tshe mgon dang skyabs dang rten dang gling dang dpung gnyen yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing de yang yig nag klog pa tsam ni ma yin te dper na 'o ma las mar dang / me las du ba 'byung ba ltar lam gyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen kho na bsten nas snying po len par bya ste/ sdud pa las/bla ma mkhas pa rnams ni rtag tu bsten bya ste/ /ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung / /nad pa'i tshogs kyis gso phyir sman pa bsten pa ltar/ /g.yel ba med par dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa de la bsten bya bla ma'i mtshan nyid ni / rin po che phung po'i mdor/ byams pas gsol pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji lta bur bsten par bgyi/ bka' stsal pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni chos ci dang ci ston pa thams cad chos kyi dbyings don dam pa'i bden pa 'ba' zhig sems te ston par byed gsal bar byed pa de ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen lam drang po nas 'khrid par bya ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa de gzhir bzhag nas mdo sde 47

rgyan las gsungs pa ltar lhag pa'i bslab pa gsu ma gyis rgyud legs par dul ba phyogs re tsam ma yin par mang du thos pa lung gi yon tan/ de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi bslab pa slob ma rnams las ches lhag pa'i khyad par gyi yon tan/ lung don rig pas 'byed pa la rnam dpyod kyi mthu phun sum tshogs pas gdul bya'i rna bar 'jibs shing don dam pa'i lam la bkri bar mkhas pas / rnyed pa dang bkur sti sogs la mi gzigs par 'gro ba nyam chung ba la brtse ba'i snying rje can/ gzhan don bsgrub pa la skyo dub med pa'i brtson 'grus/ yang yang 'chad pa la skyo ngal med cing log sgrub bzod pa'i snying stobs can gyi bla ma dam pa zhig bsten dgos / de la nang gses su dbye na spyi mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa las / phyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa la mkhas pa'i bla ma/ nang gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag ston pa drin can gyi bla ma/ gsang ba sems nyid skye ba med pa ston pa rtsa ba'i bla ma/ rang bzhin gzhi'i bla ma/dag pa rang sems kyi bla ma/ snang ba brda'i bla ma/ gang zag brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la 'dus pa'o/ /zhar la slob ma'i mtshan nyid kyang / rgyud klong gsal las/ snod dang mi ldan slob ma ni/ /shes chung kha gsags gdong ltas che/ /kha mkhas lag dam g.yo rgyu che/ /bla ma'i gsung bcag drin la rtsod/ /yon tan mi mthong skyon la rtog /rigs 48

brgyud ngang brgyud ngan pa dang / /bka' drin khyad gsod rang la bstod / /don dam dam tshig nyams len 'chal/ /slob ma ma brtags slob dpon dgra/ /ces gsungs pa la brtags pa sngon du 'gro bas bstan bya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ni/ 'od gsal gyi rgyud rig pa rang shar las/ dad pa'i stobs dang brtson 'grus che/ /shes rab che zhing 'dzin chags med/ /phu dud che zhing gsang sngags spyod/ /rtog med sems la g.yeng ba med/ /dam tshig ldan zhing sgrub la brtson/ /zhes gsungs pa kho na las/ gzhan du ma yin la/ de lta bu'i dpon slob zung du 'brel na gshog pa gnyis ldan gyi 'dab chags mkha' la 'phur ba la tshegs med pa bzhin byang chub bsgrub pa la de tsam gyi dka' las med pas slob mas kyang bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsten zhing / rang nyid la'ang lung dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa'i skyon gang che/ ngos tsir gyis bzung nas gnyen pos rgyud bsdams rjes bshes gnyen bsten pa dngos la bsam pas bsten pa'i tshul dang / sbyor bas bsten pa'i tshul gnyis kyi snga ma ni dkon mchog ta la'i gzungs las/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed/ /dogs pa sel zhing chu bo rnams las sgrol/ /dad pa bde legs grong khyer mtshon byed yin / /dad pa rnyog pa med cing sems dwangs byed/ /nga rgyal spong 49

zhing gus pa'i rtsa ba yin/ /dad pa nor dang gter dang rkang pa'i mchog /lag pa bzhin du dge sdud rtsa ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen de la mnyam 'grogs ma yin par zhe thag pa nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa 'phags pa rtag tu bus byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi yon tan mthong ba lta bu zhig nges par dgos/ 'o skol las ma dag pa'i dbang gis bla ma mtshan ldan la'ang de dag gis drang nges ldem dgongs rnam pa bzhi'i mdzad pa sna tshogs bstan pa'i gnad ma go bar skyon yon 'dres mar snang ba srid pas de'i tshe skyon rtog shar ba'i blo de dgag dgos/ de dgag nus na ci mdzad legs mthong ngang ngam shugs kyis 'ong ba las 'os med/ de'i phyir 'di ltar bla ma de'i mdzad pa skyon ltar snang ba thams cad la ched du gnyer nas gnyen po'i gsal 'debs bya ba ni/ bla ma de'i mdzad pa legs nyes/gsung bgros gnang lugs/ tha na na bza' bzhes lugs lta bu zhig gi mtshams su yang 'di ltar ma legs snyam pa'i bsam pa zhig thur gyis shar byung na/ de ma thag rnam rtog de la bdag 'dzin rjes gcod mi bya bar bdag lta bu'i las ngan gyi sems can/ 'di lta bu'i bla ma khyad par can la de 'dra'i nyes skyon yod pa mi srid/rang nyid thog ma med pa nas goms pa'i las nyon gyi mthus skyon 50

du shar bar 'dug /thang phrom zos pa'i rgan mo'i mig sngar nam mkha' nas skra shad 'dzag pa dang / mkhris nad kyis gdungs pa'i mig shes la dung gi kha dog kyang ser bor snang ba dang khyad par ga la yod/ rang re 'dod pa'i mda' lngas snying phugs pa'i 'gro ba dag gi spyod tshul dang stun kyin dgongs pa can gyi tshul du ma dag pa'i mdzad pa de dag ched du ma bstan pa'i nges pa ci cha/ skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs kyi 'dren pa shākya thub pa la'ang dge slong legs skar dang lhas byin mu stegs kyi ston pa drug la sogs pa dag gis skyon gyi gong bur mthong ba dang / sngon gyi paṇa grub mkhan slob rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' de dag la'ang / bon dang sdig blon ma rungs pa de dag gis nyes pa'i gong bur mthong ba dang / 'phags pa thog med kyis mi pham mgon po khyi mo khog smad 'bus g.yeng bar gzigs pa dang khyad par med/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las bde bar gshegs pas bdud du sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad par yang gsungs pa'i phyir na sangs rgyas la bdud du mthong ba'ang rang gi snang ba ma dag pa kho na las yul de dag la skyon ye nas med par nges shes bskyed yang yang bsams nas skyon du lta mkhan gyi kun rtog de zil gyis gnon dgos te/ rgyud don mdor bsdus las/ bla ma'i mdzad pa thams 51

cad la/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa nyid du bsams/ /gal te gzims sam bzhengs pa ni/ /'od gsal sgyu mar snang bar blta/ /phyag dang bskor ba gang mdzad kyang / /sangs rgyas rol pa nyid du ston/ /gar dang rnam 'gyur bzhad pa na/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa'i mdzad pa can / /khro dang chags pa cir ston yang / /sangs rgyas byang chub nyid du bsams/ /mi brgya dus gcig bsad na yang / /sangs rgyas 'gro la phan mdzad nyid/ /btsun mo brgya dang rol na yang / /bde chen ye shes phyag rgya che/ /'dod pa 'dun pa cir snang yang / /sangs rgyas 'dod pa bral ba yin/ /thams cad sangs rgyas mdzad pa ste/ /ci mdzad mthong ba legs pa'i lam/ /ci gsungs thos pa dam pa'i chos / /ci dgongs thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal/ /bla mar 'khrul pa srid mthar yang / /'byung ba med kyi gal te na/ /mthong snang 'khrul pa ltar snang ste/ /rang snang bsam pa ma dag pas/ /mig skyon can gyis gangs nyid la/ /rgyun du nag por mi srid kyang / /nag por dngos su mthong dang mtshungs/ /mkhris nad can gyis dung nyid la/ /rgyun du dkar po nyid yin kyang / /ser por mthong ba nyid dang mtshungs / /log sred can gyis chu nyid la/ /khrag rnag mtshon cha med na yang / /rnag khrag mtshon char mthong dang mtshungs/ /de phyir bla ma'i rnam thar la/ /log lta skyes na thar lam 'gag /'gro 'dul 52

thabs mkhas spyod pas te/ /brda dang thabs su shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i phyir nges pa'i don du dam pa de la skyon ye nas mi mnga' bar nges shes gting tshugs pa zhig skyes phyin chad legs pa'i yon tan thams cad ngang ngam shugs la 'byung ba ni/ slob dpon nā ga rdzu nas/ ri dbang rtse nas 'ga' zhig lhung gyur na/ /lhung bar mi 'gyur snyam yang lhung bar 'gyur/ /bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob nas/ /grol bar mi 'gyur snyam yang dgrol bar 'gyur / /zhes gsungs so/ /gus pa chen po bskyed par byed pa la bka' bkyon yang chos bshad pa dang / brdung btsog mdzad kyang byin gyis brlab par mthong ba zhig dgos te/ lung gis dbye bar/mdor na brdung btsog bka' bkyon dang / /drag sngags g.yul sprod mtshon phugs bdeb/ /ci ltar mdzad kyang rang skyon gyi/ /dri ma sel ba'i thabs yin gyi/ /de la ma gus spang bya ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa ni/ /ci ltar mdzad kyang sangs rgyas kyi/ /gar gyi cho 'phrul rol pa las/ /gzhan du ci yang bsam mi bya/ /byas na dngos grub rgyab kyis phyogs/ /mos gus log pas bdud kyis 'dzin/ /nad mang tshe thung ngan 'gror ltung / /zhes so/ /de'i phyir 'di ltar bdag gi bla ma 'di skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs/ spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang khyad par med kyang / rang 53

re bsod nams dang skal pa dman pas bla ma 'di'i sku gsum gyi snang cha ji bzhin pa rang ngor snang dbang ma mchis pas tha mal gyi tshul bstan pa ste/ rig 'dzin 'dus rgyud las/ sangs rgyas rnams dang de yi sras/ /gang gis gdul bya de nyid la/ /de dang mthun pa'i gzugs ston to/ /zhes so/ /de'ang 'di ltar sangs rgyas chos kyi sku nang gsal gzhon nu bum pa'i sku kun gzhi'i steng nas khyad chos drug gis 'phags pa'i gdod ma'i mgon po de ni/ spangs rtogs phul du phyin pa'i ye shes kyi mthong ba las gzhan gyis spyod yul du ma gyur/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nges pa lnga dang kha spyor yan lag bdun ldan de ni thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya sa bcu'i dbang phyug kho na las gzhan la mi snang / sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku stobs bcu mi 'jigs rnam bzhi la sogs pa'i rtsal mnga' ba de ni nyan rang gi ston par gyur kyang de dag las bka' drin nod pa'i bsod nams kyis phongs/ de'ang sku gsum ston pa de dag la nye ring mnga' nas rang re rnams ched du dor ba ma yin kyang / brag phug kha byang bstan la nyi ma'i snang ba mi 'char ba bzhin rang nyid las dang skal pa dman pas sangs rgyas de dag mjal ba dang gsung thos pa'i snod du ma gyur pas da lta phan mtha' med kyi 'khor ba btson dong lta bur ltung ba 'di tsam du zad/ de ltar na'ang da res 54

mi lus thob pa'i dus 'dir bshes gnyen dam pa 'di lta bu dang mjal ba bsod nams shin tu che/ rang re lnga brgya tha ma'i sems can rnams kyi don du sangs rgyas de dag so so'i skye bo'i slob dpon gyi tshul du sprul nas gdul bya 'dul bar mdo rgyud mang po nas gsungs pas bdag gi bla ma dam pa 'di yang nges pa'i don du tha mal ma yin la/ rang ngos nas dngos kyi gdams pa bstan pas sangs rgyas las kyang lhag /mtshan dpes spras pa'i sangs rgyas dngos su mjal yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam chos bstan nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la bkri ba nyid las lhag pa ni mdzad rgyu med/ de'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen legs par bsten pa'i don rang gis nyams su len nus na mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi go 'phang thob par the mi tshom/ tshe 'di'i zas gos gyi na dang dgra gdon sogs las skyob pa dag la'ang bka' drin che bar rtsi na/ 'khor ba mtha' med kyi sdug bsngal sel zhing gtan gyi bde ba la bkod par mdzad pa'i bka' drin ni dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi 'dzam bu chu po'i gser gyis bkang yang gzhal bar ga la nus/ de'i phyir gdul bya rang ngos nas sangs rgyas thams cad las bla ma dam pa bka' drin che zhing lhag go snyam pa'i dad gus dang mos pa snying khungs rus pa'i gting nas bskyed 55

dgos te/ ma rgyud klong gsal las/ nad gdon zhi byed sman pa'i mchog /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin po che/ /thams cad dbang du sdud byed rtsi/ /'gro ba ma lus sgrol ba'i gru/ /phrin las kun gyi mnga' bdag mchog /thog mar bla ma gal che'o/ /gang zag 'khor bar zhen pa rnams/ /zhen pa ldog thabs bla ma gtso/ /gang zag dam chos ma dran zhing / /dge sdig ngo mi shes pa rnams/ /chos ston dge sdig ngos ston phyir/ /bla ma dam pa shin tu gces/ /sgom skyes gegs kyis thums pa la/ /gegs sel 'bras bu 'byung ba yang / /bla ma dag gi drin las 'byung / /zhes dang / rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams kun/ /bla ma'i zhal las 'byon pa yin/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /bla ma dam pa bsten las byung / /zhes gsungs la/ de'i phyir thog ma nyid nas bdud dang bslu ba mkhan ma yin pa'i bla ma dam pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dang mjal ba'i rjes thog tu ci mdzad legs mthong gi mos gus skye ba ni zhe nas skyes pa'i dad pa ste byin rlabs zhugs pa'i rtags su nges la/ bcos ma'i mos gus kyis ni dad pa tshugs mi thub cing spyod lam ma dag pa bag tsam mthong bas ldog pa'i phyir yid brtan rung ba'i dad pa ma yin no / /gnyis pa sbyor bas bsten tshul ni/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bcu tshan gsum gyi dam tshig bsrung mtshams de'i rjes 'brel 56

dang bcas pa ni/ rang byung rang shar gyi rgyud las/ /dang po sku yi dam tshig ni/ /dang po lus kyi bsrung bya bcu/ /bla ma'i gdong nas 'gro mi bya/ /ci phyir khrel nas rgyab phyogs 'dra/ /chos med dud 'gro'i gnas su skye/ /bla ma'i gzhug nas 'gro mi bya/ /ci phyir zhabs rjes gnon pa'o/ /skyabs med mgon dang bral bar skye/ /bla ma'i g.yas nas 'gro mi bya/ /ci phyir brdeg pa'i stabs su'o/ /tshe thung nad mang dmyal bar lhung / /dbu yi grib ma gnon mi bya/ /ci phyir khyad du bsad pa yin/ /ngu 'bod chen po'i dmyal bar lhung / /dbu skra rdog pas brdzi mi bya/ /ci phyir sangs rgyas gshung pa 'dra/ /thig nag 'dra ba'i dmyal bar skye/ /dbus sngas bzhugs gdan brdzi mi bya / /ci phyir sangs rgyas bla med smad/ /bshal ma ri la 'dzegs pa skye / /sku la mtho yis gzhal mi bya/ /ci phyir lag gis brgyab dang mtshungs / /mdung thung sum brgyas 'joms par 'gyur/ /bla ma'i bzhengs phyag tshur mi blang / /mtho ris thar pa'i lam sna 'gag /'du shes med pa'i dmyal bar skye/ /zab mo'i man ngag tshig gsum yang / /mnyan nas de yi gong du min/ /shes rab 'chal ba'i 'dam du 'dzud/ /bla ma'i zhal du ma gsol bar/ /longs spyod zas la phud bcad na/ /sha khrag 'bar ba'i lus su skye/ /gzhan yang bzhengs tshe bsdad pa na/ /mgo lus bral ba'i dmyal bar skye/ /bzhugs tshe 57

stegs la bsdad pa na/ /dmyal ba mgo 'phyang lus su skye/ /de rnams sku yi dam tshig bcu/ /nyams na bskal pa chen po gcig /tsha grang las kyi dmyal bar skye/ /nyams pa skong na mchod rten bzhengs/ /bum par bla ma'i sku gzugs bzhengs/ /mchod cing bskor ba rgyun mi gcad/ /ces dang / ngag gi sgo nas dam bcu bsrung / /bla ma sangs rgyas kun las lhag /de la rtogs bcas bya mi rung / rgyab nas 'phya gtam zer ba de/ /sangs rgyas rgyab kyis phyogs pa yin/ /'bras bu med par ngan song lhung / /lus rus mgul 'gag nad kyis 'debs/ /bla ma blun zhes brjod mi rung / /brjod na bskal pa phra mo gcig /byang chub lam dang phrad mi srid/ /bla ma zog che bya mi rung / /ral gri so mas lce gtubs nas/ /lkugs pa'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la/ /zhe la 'bab pa'i tshig mi smra / /smras na ri 'thab bar du skye/ /legs par gsungs pa'i bka' mi bcag /bcag na mnar med gnas su skye/ /ngag tshig brlang pos zhe 'gems na/ /'o dod 'bod pa'i gnas ngan du/ /bskal pa stong phrag drug tu gnas/ /smras pa'i tshig la mi gnas pa/ /sdug bsngal las la yun ring spyod/ /sgro skur mang po 'dogs pa de/ /dge slong 'bum phrag bsad dang mnyam/ /mnar med dmyal ba kho nar lhung //khyod bas nga bzang zer ba de/ /dmyal bar bskal pa yun ring 58

gnas 7 /dmod pa'i g.yo rgyu sna tshogs smra/ /rtag tu rke bcad dmyal bar lhung / /de yang sku yi dam tshig yin/ /nyams pa skong na gzung sngags 'bum/ /bris la mchod rten nang du gzhug /dril bu zung 'brel mang du btags/ /ces dang / yid kyi sgo nas dam bca' bsrung / /bla ma'i dkor la brnab sems byed/ /yi dwags gnas su bskal pa gnyis/ /bkres skom mi bzod myong bar 'gyur/ /bla ma dag la 'gran sems byed/ /'khor ba'i gcong rong thar med du/ /chos spyod brtson yang skye bar 'gyur/ /zhe 'gras pa yi sems byed na / /ral gris gcod pa'i dmyal bar skye/ /rdo rje slob dpon 'dod chags che/ /sems na ngan song kun tu 'khyams/ /rdo rje slob dpon zhe sdang che/ /sems na dmyal ba drug cur 'tshod/ /rdo rje slob dpon 'du shes chung / /sems na ngu 'bod dmyal bar skye/ /rdo rje slob dpon brod pa che/ /sems na mnar med dmyal bar skye/ /rdo rje slob dpon nga rgyal che/ /sems na kha 'thabs gnas su skye/ /rdo rje slob dpon kha zhan ngu / /sems na bla med lam mi rnyed/ /rdo rje slob dpon skyon bzhir sems/ /skyon bzhi ni bla ma 'di 'jig rten gyi bya ba la mi mkhas snyam pa dang / rang bas na tshod gzhon snyam pa dang / bza' tsho dang nye 'brel yin snyam pa dang / rang las rigs dman pa yin snyam pa'i log pa'i 'du shes bzhi'o/ /rtag tu bsam ngan mtshang 'bru ba/ /lha klu gdug pas srog bcad nas/ /59

myur du dmyal ba'i gnas su lhung / /'di yang sku yi dam tshig yin/ /nyams pa gso na mtshan gyi mthar/ /gsol 'debs bstod pa bris pa 'bum/ /bshags pa'i tshig bris 'bum ther gzhug /lo zla dus mchod rgyun du bzung / /zhes so/ /de bzhin du bla ma'i gnang ba ma thob kyi bar la lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyis gzhan don byed pa'i nus pa mnga' ba yin na'ang smon pa'i yul du bya ba las 'jug pas dngos su mi bya ste/ /rgyud de nyid las/ gzhan yang rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /bya ba'i las rnams slob mas min/ /bla ma'i slob bu slob ma ru/ /bcug na skyabs med dmyal bar lhung / /rdo rje slob dpon chos kyi rgyal/ /rgyal po'i bya ba mnga' thang skyong / /de bzhin chos kyi rtsa ba drug /theg pa 'og ma'i rtsa ba gnyis/ /sems bskyed pa dang sdom pa 'bogs/ /theg pa gong ma'i rtsa ba gnyis/ /dbang bskur ba dang ngo sprod pa/ /theg pa thun mong rtsa ba gnyis/ /rab tu gnas dang gnas spor ba'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon rgyal po yi/ /mnga' thang skyong ba'i chos yin pas/ phyogs bzhir dpag tshad bcu gnyis te / /ma 'das par la rtsa ba drug /de yi slob mas bsnyen pa na/ /bskal pa drug cu rtsa brgyad du/ /ri rab chen po'i 'og tu skye/ /ci phyir zhe na rgyal po yi/ /rgyal srid 'bangs kyis phrogs pa ltar/ /bla ma'i yon tan slob mas bsgrubs/ /de yi phyi ma dmyal ba las/ /'gro 60

sa med par nga yis bshad/ /dpag tshad bcu gnyis phar tshad du/ /slob dpon de yis ma khyab na/ /rgyal tshab bskos la gnang ba byin/ /de yang lo yi dus su mjal/ /mnyes pa'i longs spyod dad pas 'bul / /zhes dang / rgyud don mdor bsdus las kyang / rang nyid yon tan bsam yas kyang / /bla mas rjes su ma gnang na/ /kha rog 'dug la mkhas pa dang / /grub pa'i spyod pa thams cad spangs/ /longs spyod ldan zhing phun tshogs kyang / /lto gos spong zhing sdug sran gyis / /dma' sa bzung la sgeg chos spong / /gsung yang de nyid don bzhin bsgrub/ /ces gsungs so/ /gal te bla mas bka' gnang na/ /'jig rten gyi snang ngor mi rig pa ltar snang ba'i ngan spyod mi rung ba yang bsgrub dgos te/ rang byung gi rgyud las/ khyod kyis brkus phrogs dmag khyer dang / /brdung btsog gzhan brnyas smyon bcos dang / /khrel med ngo tsha med pa'i las/ /bya ru mi rung sna tshogs pa/ /gyis zhes bka' stsal lung bzhin bsgrub/ /las ka tshong khe bag ma len / /phrag dog 'thab 'dzing zhing gzhis dang / /be'u lug sbrel zhes bka' stsal yang / /the tshom med par gsung bzhin bsgrub/ /ces so/ /gang zag thos pa nyung zhing rtog pa can kha cig de ltar slob na bshes gnyen tshul ldan du mi 'gyur ram snyam na ma yin te/bla ma'i mtshan nyid kyang rgyud sde nas gsungs pa ltar btsal ba las 61

'dod kha dang nyon mongs gang che snyan pa tsam gyis rjes su phyogs nas 'tshol ma nyes pa dgos te/ bka' brgyad yongs 'dus las/phyi mar gyur pa dus kyi tshe/ /bsod nams dman pa'i sems can gyis / dam pa rnyed par mi 'gyur zhing / /tshul min slob dpon nag po'i bdud/ /'byung bar 'gyur gyi de bas na/ /nor ba spang ba nyid du bya/ /zhes gsungs la/ de ltar min phyin chad mtshan nyid tshang ba'i bla ma de nyid cha lugs dang ltar snang ji ltar snang yang skyes bu dam pa yin par nges la/ /des log pa'i spyod pa mi slob cing gal te slob na rang rgyud gdul ba'i phyir nges par dgongs pa can gyis slob pa'i phyir/ paṇa chen nā ro pas te lo'i zhabs pad bsten pa bzhin the tshom med par bya dgos pa nyid do/ /de'i phyir rig pa ltar rjes su gnang ba ni shin tu'ang bsgrub dgos te/ rgyud de nyid las / bla ma'i zhabs tog chos bshad dang / /sdom pa 'bog cing sde dgon bzung / /'khor dang slob ma tshogs su bsdus/ /'gro phan skyid sdug ro mnyam kyang / /ri khrod bstan pa skyong spel gyis/ /na'am shi yang bya ba la/ /thang lhod med par gyis gsungs yang / /ji ltar bka' stsal de bzhin bsgrub/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin gshegs bzhugs gang gi thad du bsnyen bkur bya tshul yang rgyud las / gshegs na 'das pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhugs na mnyes 62
