ris skyabs su song ba tsam kyis thar ba'i sa bon 'debs pa dang /mi dge'i tshogs las ring du byed cing / dge ba gong du 'phel ba dang —/ sdom pa kun gyi rten gzhir 'gyur zhing / yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su 'gyur ba dang / gnas skabs su yang dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams kyis bsrung zhing smon pa yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang / rtag tu dkon mchog gsum gyi snang ba dang mi 'brel zhing tshe rabs dran pa dang / 'di phyir bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa la sogs phan yon dpag tu med do / /zhar la skyabs su song ba'i sdom pa rgyud la gnas bya'i phyir/bslab bya'i mtshan nyid mdor bsdu na/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas rang nyid 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i 'jig rten pa'i lha dang brten par dka' zhing gnod pa sbyin pa'i rang bzhin rgyal po la sogs par mgon skyabs mi 'tshol/ sku'i rten chag dum yan chad la ci mi mnyam pa'i sri zhu mi lhod/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la 'tshe ba'i rtog pa rmi lam du'ang spong zhing / yi ge'i ras ma yan chad la gus pa bskyed/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas lta spyod log pa'i gang zag mu stegs kyi dngos po can dang mi 'grogs shing / lhan pa ser po'ang rdog pas mi brdzi/ mdor na gsang ba mchog gi theg pa 'dir skyabs yul gyi gtso bo bla ma yin 130

la/ bla ma'i thugs sangs rgyas/ gsung dam chos/ sku dge 'dun yin pas de nyid sun phyung na skyabs yul thams cad spangs par 'gro/chos thams cad kyi gzhi rten skyabs 'gro'i gnad la nan tan du bya'o/ /gnyis pa theg chen gyi rtsa ba sems bskyed kyi khrid la gsum/ tshad med bzhis blo sbyong ba/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ smon 'jug gi bslab bya bzung ba dang gsum las/ dang po'i nang gses btang snyoms bsgom pa ni/ ga re/ da lta'i gnas skabs na pha ma dang gnyen 'dun sogs rang phyogs la shin tu chags/ dgra dang de'i phyogs la sdang zhen mi bzad par byed pa 'di yang ma brtags pa'i skyon du 'dug /'di ltar tshe rabs snga mar/ dgras kyang gnyen byas/gnyen gyis kyang dgra byas pa la the tshom med/ da lta'ang dgra la dgrar bzung kyang des nges par rang la gnod thub pa'i gtan tshigs med/ rang gis bstun shes na gnyen bzhin phan thogs pa'ang srid la/ gnyen yin kyang bu tshas pha ma bslu ba bzhin/ 'gal zla dang bsdongs nas de'i phyogs bzung / nor 'phrog rtsod pa 'gyed pa sogs mthong chos su 'gyur ba dang / gal te gcig tu mdza' ba ltar snang yang de la mi 'dod pa byung ba'i tshe rang la'ang sdug bsngal bskyed cing gnas skabs kyi bde ba 'joms pa dang /131

mthar thug dge ba'i gegs rlabs po che byas te ngan song du bskyur ba'ang yod na de las dgrar 'gyur pa ci zhig yod/ ma 'ongs pa'i cha la dgra gnyen du 'gyur dang / gnyen dgra ru 'gyur nges pa med nges yin pa la cis smyon snyam du sems can gcig dang gnyis nas rim par nam mkhas gar khyab tu brtags la nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba dmigs pa med pa'i btang snyoms la rtsal sbyang ngo ske/ /de nas byams pa bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad dmigs yul du bsam la/ bu tsha chung ngur pha mas brtse zhing log sgrub bzod pa ltar/ sems can de dag bde ba dang legs pa'i dpal la sbyor ba'i blo 'dun drag pos/ thabs ji lta bus phan gdags par bya snyam pa'i byams pa sgom zhing rtsal sbyang ngo / /de nas snying rje bsgom pa la/ gang zhig nag can btson dong du bcug pa de nyid mthar gsod du nye ba'am/ shan pa'i 'dun sar dud 'gro 'chi ka ma lta bu'i sems can sdug bsngal drag pos gdungs pa zhig blo yul du bsam la/ de la brtse ba'i yul ma dang bu'i 'du shes bskyed de sdug bsngal 'di las da lta nyid du myur ba nyid du skad cig nyid du thar na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje shas mi bzod pa mchi ma thon par bsgom zhing / de nas rim par ngan song gzhan dang / der skye ba'i rgyu sgrub pa thams cad la sgom zhing mthar mi 132

dmigs pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog go/ /de nas dga' ba ni/mtho ris kyi yul na su zhig bde zhing skyid pa/ tshe ring ba/ 'khor mang ba/ longs spyod dang ldan pa zhig dmigs yul du bsam nas/de la 'gran sems dang phrag dog med par/ da rung 'di bas kyang mngon mtho'i dpal gyis 'byor zhing / 'tshe ba med pa/ shes rab che ba la sogs pa'i phun sum tshogs pa du mas 'byor bar shog cig /sems can gzhan rnams kyang 'di lta bu'i go 'phang la gnas na nga re dga' snyam pa dang / khyad par du rang la gnod byed kyi dgra dang sems la phrag dog gi gnas su gyur pa thams cad la gzhan 'byor phun sum tshogs pa la mi bzod pa'i blo ngan gyi rtsa ba drung nas phyung ste/ bde ba dang ldan pa'i cha thams cad la dga' ba khyad par can sgom zhing mthar dmigs pa med pa'i ngang la gzhag go/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed dngos la/ blo'i khyad par gyis/ sngon la rang nyid thar bar byas nas 'gro ba gzhan yang de'i go 'phang la 'god par 'dod pa ded dpon lta bu'i sems bskyed/ rang dang sems can gzhan lhan cig thar par 'dod pa mnyan pa lta bu'i sems bskyed / sems can thams cad byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rang nyid thar pa'i 'dod pa mi byed pa rdzi bo lta bu'i sems bskyed/ sa mtshams kyis dbye na/ tshogs sbyor gyi lam la mos pas dpyod pa'i 133

sems bskyed/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar la lhag bsam rnam dag gi sems bskyed/ dag pa'i sa gsum na rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed/ sangs rgyas kyi sar sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed gyi tha snyad yod kyang / kun rdzob cho ga dang don dam mtshan nyid sgom stobs kyis thob pa yin la/ 'dir las dang po pa/ cho ga la ltos pa can yin pas sems bskyed 'bogs chog gzhan du blta/mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs sems bskyed kyi dpang por dmigs la blo gros chen po'i sems bskyed ni/ 'di ltar sems can 'di dag thams cad bdag gi pha mar ma gyur pa ni gcig kyang med/ pha mar gyur pa'i tshe da lta'i pha ma bzhin gces spras kyis bskyangs/ zas su phud byin/ gos kyis brtse g.yogs shin tu byams pa'i bsam sbyor gyis bskyed bsring bar nges na/ pha ma 'khor ba na gnas bzhin bdag thar pa la dgos pa ci yod/ de'i phyir bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ spyod pa rlabs po che la bslab cing 'khor ba na sems can gcig kyang mi gnas pa de tsam du brtson 'grus brtsam mo snyam pas/ ho: sna tshogs snang ba chu zla'i rdzun ris kyi: 'khor pa lu gu rgyud du 'khyams pa'i 'gro:rang rig 'od gsal dbyings su ngal bso phyir: tshad med bzhi yi 134

ngang nas sems bskyed do: zhes mang du brjod pa'i mthar tshogs zhing du gyur pa rnams rang nyid la bstims pas de dag gi thugs rgyud la gnas pa'i don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rang gi shes rgyud la lhang gis skyes par bsam la stong pa nyid kyi gshis la gzhag par bya'o/ /gsum pa bslab bya'i bsam pa la smon 'jug gnyis las/ dang po 'gro bar 'dod pa lta bu smon pa'i bslab bya la bdag gzhan mnyam pa/ brje ba/ gzhan gces par bsgom pa gsum las/ dang po ma 'byongs par/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad dang bdag nyid bde ba 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod par blo gcig tu mthun kyang / sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dge sdig blang dor gyi gnad la rmongs pas rtag tu sdug bsngal la spyod pa 'di snying re rje/ bdag dam pa'i chos kyi rjes su zhugs pas khe nyen shes pa'i rang bzhin can gyi phyir/ log sgrub dang phyogs ris bzod par byas te/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du blta bar bya'o snyam du yang yang sgom/ de nas bdag gzhan brje ba byang chub kyi sems ni/ mthong chos su gyur pa'am/ min na sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa'i sems can zhig mdun du bsams nas/ dbugs phar rgyu ba na bdag gi bde ba dang legs pa lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa gos phud de g.yogs pa ltar khong la byin/135

khong gi sdug bsngal ci yod pa de dag thams cad rang nyid kyis dang du blangs par bsam pa dang lhan cig dbugs nang du rngubs pas de nyid bde ba dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal dang bral bar bsams pa'i gtong len sems can gcig nas thams cad kyi bar la rim par sgom mo/ /'byongs nas bdag bas gzhan gces par bsgoms pa ni/ bdag 'khor bar gnas rung dmyal bar skyes rung / na rung tsha rung nyam nyes ci byung yang bzod par bya yis/sems can gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin par shog cig /bdag gis bde ba dang dge ba'i 'bras bu khong la rdzogs par shog cig snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam zhing mthar dmigs pa med pa'i ngang du gzhag go/ /gnyis pa 'gro ba dngos lta bu 'jug pa'i bslab bya ni sems can thams cad kyi don du nor rdzas la chags zhen med par dge ba'i phyogs la gtong ba dang / yongs su gtong ba dang / shin tu gtong ba gsum gyis sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/rang rgyud kyi nyes spyod sdom zhing gzhan la phan gdags pa tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ de'i khyad par la phal po che'i spyod yul dag pa dang / skyes bu chen po'i rnam rtog brgyad bsgom pa/chos phyir dka' ba spyod pa dang gzhan gyi log sgrub bzod pa ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/ dal 'byor chud gsan pa'i byed po 136

le lo zil gyis mnan nas chos spyod bcu dang pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la 'bad pa ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ 'dus pa ni 'brel ba'i chos can/ 'dod pa ni nyes pa thams cad kyi 'byung khungs / yod cing chog mi shes ser sna 'phel la rkun po la sogs rtsod pa can dang thun mong ba rnam par grol ba'i chos dang 'gal bas 'phags pa rnams kyis smad pa/ byis pa'i grogs ni rang bzhin ngan pa/ byas pa mi gzo ba mgu bar dka' ba/ phrag dog pa la sogs 'grogs pa tsam gyis dge ba 'grib pa/ 'du 'dzi ni rtag tu bral zhing don chung ba/ ji tsam brtson yang snying po med pa/ dgra btul kyang mtha' med pa/ gnyen bskyangs kyang mtha' med pa 'di dag ni nges par spang bar bya'o/ /de ltar spangs nas nags khrod dben pa zhes sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang zhi ba brnyes pa'i gnas/ 'du 'dzi dang rnam g.yeng med pa tshong dang so nam med pa/ byis pa'i grogs dang bral ba / bya dang ri dwags 'grogasan bde/ chu dang lo ma dka' thub kyi zas dang mthun pa/ rig pa ngang gis dwangs/ ting 'dzin shugs kyis 'phel ba'i gnas/ dgra med gnyen med chags sdang gi sgrog las grol ba yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i gnas su/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas yid gang du'ang mi rtog cir yang mi 137

'dzin pa'i ngang du 'jog pa ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa/'di ltar phyi yul lnga'i snang ba thams cad ni med bzhin 'khrul ngo la snang ba rmi lam lta bu/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa la sa glo bur du snang ba sgyu ma lta bu/ med pa yod par snang ba mig yor lta bu/snang bzhin du bden par ma grub pas smig rgyu lta bu/ phyi nang gang la'ang snang bas brag ca lta bu/ rten dang brten par med pas dri za'i grong khyer lta bu/ snang la rang bzhin med pas gzugs brnyan gyi snang ba lta bu/ med snang cir yang shar bas sprul pa'i grong khyer lta bu ste/ dngos po med pa'i stong gzugs sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad du bltas bas yul phyi snang ba rdzun pa'i rang bzhin du go la/ de ltar snang ba'i mkhan po yul can sems kyi gshis lugs la brtags pas / yul snang ma 'gag la/ yul gyi 'dzin rtog zhi/ chos nyid stong gsal nam mkha' lta bur rtogs pa'i ngang du 'jog pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste 'khrid tshul 'di lta bu'i nges pa las phar phyin theg pa'i zab gnad thams cad kyang 'du zhing theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rtsa ba yin pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las skyob pa dang / nyan rang gi theg pa las 'phags pa dang / dge rtsa mi zad cing 'phel ba dang / bsod nams rgya chen po thob pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi gdung 'tshob pa dang gzhan don rlabs po che 'grub pa la 138

sogs pa'i dgos pa dpag tu med pas na sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo / /gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ zab mo'i lam gyi nyams rtogs khyad par can skye ba la bar du gcod pa ni sdig sgrib yin la/ de nyid sbyong ba'i mchog tu gyur pa ni rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin te/ de la stobs bzhi'i gnad ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' la skyabs su bzung nas smon 'jug gi byang sems dang ldan pa rten gyi stobs/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa mi dge ba'i las thams cad la 'gyod sems drag po bskyed pa nyes byas sun 'byin gyi stobs/phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi byed snyam pa nyes spyod sdom pa'i stobs / sngar byas kyi gnyen por rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas byed pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs te/ stobs bzhi'i dag pa dran pa'i ngang nas 'don sgom zung 'jug tu/ a: bdag nyid tha mal spyi bo ru: pad dkar zla ba'i gdan gyi dbus: stu las bla ma rdo rje sems: dkar gsal longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: rdo rje dril 'dzin snyems ma 'khril: khyed la skyabs gsol sdig pa sbyang :'gyod sems drag pos mthol lo bshags: phyin chad srog la bab kyang sdom: khyod thugs zla ba rgyas pa'i steng: ju yig mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pa sngags kyi rgyud bskul bas: yab yum 139

bde rol sbyor mtshams nas: bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi sprin:ga bur rdul ltar 'dzag pa yis: bdag dang khams gsum sems can gyi: las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal rgyu: nad gdon sdig sgrib nyes ltung grib: ma lus byang bar mdzad du gsol: zhes dmigs pa dang mos gus rtse gcig las rnam rtog gzhan du mi yengs par ye ge brgya pa bzlas pas thugs ma'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las bde chen ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zla ba zhun ma lta bu babs/ sku'i dbyibs rgyud sbyor mtshams nas bdag nyid kyi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ nad thams cad rnag khrag gdon thams cad srog chags/ sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang sol khu rlangs kyi rnam par ba spu'i bu ga dang dbang po'i sgo gnyis nas thon/ sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje kha gdangs pa'i lto bar tshud pas dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba bslus par bsam la sngags ci mang bzlas mthar/ 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas rnams kyang bdud rtsis skya mer gyis khengs pa'i rkyen las lus sems zag med kyi bde bas myos/ rdo rje sems dpa' dgyes bzhin 'dzum pa dang bcas pas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag pa yin no zhes gnang ba byin zhing 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen las rang nyid kyang rdo rje sems dpa' snang stong me long 140

gi gzugs brnyan lta bu'i skur gyur pa'i thugs srog gi tha mar yi ge 'bru bzhi po gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros khams gsum snod bcud dang bcas pa rdor sems rigs lnga'i rten dang brten pa'i rang bzhin du sangs rgyas par bsam la/ o badz+ra sa twa t+t+waṃ/ zhes bzla ba ni khyad par can gyi man ngag dang / thun bsdu ba na sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi rtog tshogs thams cad 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i dran shes kha yan gyis rgyas 'debs pa ni don dam pa'i sgrib sbyong ngo / /'di ni 'bum ther tha ma yin te sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags ma mthong tshun bya'o/ /bzhi pa mthun rkyen tshogs bsag pa la maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid ni/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi stobs su gyur ba'i 'bras bu ni dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sangs rgyas yin la/ de'i phyir lam gyi dus na tshogs gnyis bsags pa ni thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'ang yin no/ /de la 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i rab kyis rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal/ 'bring 'khar ba la sogs pa'i rgyu dag pa/ tha ma'ang rdo shing la sogs pa'i stegs khod snyoms la ngos 'jam pa'i gzhi ma byi dor legs par byasate/ dri bzang dang ba byung gis byugs/ rab rin po che/ 'bring sman gyi 'bras bu/ tha ma 'bru la sogs pa'i tshom bu rnam nges ltar bkod pa dmigs rten du byas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sku gsum gyi 141

ngo bo rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa tshogs zhing du dmigs la/ bsam par bya ba ni/ thun mong sprul sku'i maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab lha gnas dang bcas pa'i stong gsum 'jig rten gyi zhing khams bye ba phrag brgya dang bye brag rang gi lus longs spyod mnga' ris phun tshogs dang bcas pa mdor na 'dzin sems kyis gces dgur bzung ba thams cad ser sna dang 'jur gegs kyis ma bcings par ltos med du 'bul ba ni bdag tu lta ba'i gnyen por yang 'gyur ro/ /de'i steng gi nam mkhar thun min longs sku'i maṇ+ḍal rang snang 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams ye shes rin po che'i gzhal med khang sku dang zhing khams ye nas lhun grub kyi rnam pa la sgeg sogs 'dod yon gyi lha mos spras pa/ de'i steng gi dbyings la khyad par chos sku'i maṇ+ḍal skye med gdod ma'i gzhi la 'gag med 'od gsal gyi snang cha rig pa tshad phebs kyi tshom bur bkod pa ste sku gsum gyi dmigs pa'i bye brag rnams gsal bde ba'i ched 'di ltar du sgom zhing / dngos gnas la rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba'i rang snang gi zhing khams rnams la yan man dang steng 'og gi gzhal byar ma dmigs pa rdul phran gyi khongs su rdul snyed kyi zhing khams yangs dog med par rang shar lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas rnams khongs su chud pa'i ngang nas mos gus kyi gdung ba dang bcas/ o āḥrgyu/142

stong gsum 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing: rin chen sna bdun lha mi'i 'byor bas gtams: bdag lus longs spyod bcas pa yongs 'bul gyis: chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i srid thob shog:'og min bde chen stug po bkod pa'i zhing: nges pa lnga ldan rigs snga'i tshom bu can: 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam yas pa: phul bas longs sku'i zhing la spyod par shog: snang srid rnam dag gzhon nu bum pa'i sku: thugs rje ma 'gag chos nyid rol pa'i rgyan: sku dang thig le'i 'dzin pa rnam dag zhing : phul bas chos sku'i zhing la spyod par shog: ces 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i shes rab kyis dbul loḥlnga pa bdud bzhi cig char du bcom pa ku su lu'i tshogs gsog ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri rkang dar zab 'bol brtsegs dang bcas pa'i steng du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang bcas pas bskor zhing / 'og tu rigs drug gnod byed dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal btab la dmigs 'don zung du chud pas/ phaṭa: lus gces 'dzin bor bas lha bdud chom: sems tshangs pa'i sgo nas dbyings la thon: 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom khros mar gyur: g.yas nyon mongs bdud bcom gri gug gis: gzugs phung po'i bdud bcom thod pa brags: g.yon 143

las byed tshul gyis bharnya thogs: sku gsum gyi mi mgo'i skyed pur bzhag: nang stong gsum gang ba'i bam ro de: a thung dang haṃ yig gis bdud rtsir bzhu: 'bru gsum gyi nus pas sbyangs spel bsgyur:o āḥrgyu grangs med pa brjod: phaṭa: yar mchod yul mgron gyi thugs dam bskangs: tshogs rdzogs nas mchog thun dngos grub thob: mar 'khor ba'i mgron mnyes lan chags byang: khyad par du gnod byed bgegs rig tshim: nad gdon dang bar chad dbyings su zhi: rkyen ngan dang bdag 'dzin rdul du brlag: mthar mchod bya dang mchod yul ma lus kun: gshis rdzogs pa chen por ma bcos ā: zhes mnyam par bzhag /'dis ni tshogs dpag tu med pa 'dums/ 'chi ba bslus shing nad gcod zhi/ bar do'i 'od gsal zin pa la sogs phan yon dpag tu med do/ /drug pa rtogs pa'i ye shes rang rgyud la mngon du bya ba'i thabs kyi mthar phyin pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor la skyabs yul gsal gdab pa/yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa dang gsum las/dang po ni/ zhing khams sbyong ba bsam stobs chen po'i spyod yul khyad par can yin pas/ snang bas gar khyab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang bkod pa dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i dbus su / dbang gi snod du rung pa dang / bde stong gi ye shes bskyed pa 144

dang / rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel gyis khyad par las/ rang nyid ngo bo ye shes 'tsho rgyal la rnam pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mos gus kyi spyan bla ma'i thugs kur rengs pa'i tshul gyis gzigs pa'i spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i o rgyan rdo rje 'chang sku'i rnam 'gyur yongs su rdzogs shing lo brgyad lon pa'i ngang tshul can/ phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs dkar 'dzin cing / g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na thod bum bsnams pa/ rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs can/ de'i mtha' skor du 'od lnga'i drwa ba mig mangs ris su shar ba'i nang khongs 'ja' 'od zlum 'khyil gyi dbus su rgya gar gyi rig 'dzin brgyad/ bod kyi rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho ma tshang ba med pas tha mal gyi snang ba rang 'gags su 'gro bar gsal la/ e ma ho: rang snang lhun grub dag pa rab 'byams zhing : zhes sogs pas tshig don 'brel chags par gsal gdab po/ /gnyis pa yan lag bdun pa ni/ 'di ltar rdo rje theg pa'i lam thabs mang ba dang / dka' ba med pa dang /dbang po rnon po'i spyod yul yin pas/ sems stobs chen po'i tshogs bsags pa la rgyun chags su bslabs pas pha rol tu phyin pa'i skal ba chen po'i tshogs 'dir skad cig ma'i bye brag gis kyang 'dums nas tshe gcig la sogs pas grol ba yin no/ /de'i phyir 145

gsang ba bla na med pa'i tshogs zhing gi rab dang phul du gyur pa yang rdo rje'i slob dpon nyag gcig tu nges pas bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang rjes su 'brel bar byung la/ de la tshogs gsog pa'i sgo mtha' yas pa yan lag bdun du 'du ba'i dmigs pa'i bye brag ni/ rang lus brgya stong grangs med par sprul zhing de dang lhan cig khams gsum sems can thams cad kyang thal mo spyi mgrin snying ga gsum gang rung du sbyar la/ pus mo sa la phab ste yan lag smad lnga btud pas phyag 'tshal bar dmigs pa ni phyag gi yan lag /dngos su ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa bsham zhing / yid kyis nam mkha' dang sa gzhi thams cad lha ma'i mchod rdzas me tog bdug spos mar me la sogs pa dang / gzhal med khang dang yul mkhar kun dga' ra ba/rgyal srid bdun/ bkra shis brgyad/ rdo rje'i lha mo bcu drug la sogs pa'i khyad par mang po glu gar dang rol mo'i sprin phung byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i rjes su 'gro ba ni mchod pa'i yan lag /tshe thog ma med pa nas de ring yan chad dran pa dang mi dran pa'i sdig ltung lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med lnga/ de dang nye ba lnga/ lci ba bzhi/ log pa brgyad / dkon mchog gi dkor la 'bags pa sogs kha na ma tho ba'i las ci bsags pa thams cad gnong 'gyod drag pos 146

bshags pas lce thog tu nag phung gis 'dus pa las/ tshogs zhing gi sku gsung thugs las 'od zer byung ba phog pas dri ma bkrus pa bzhin dag par bsam la/ phyis mi byed pa'i gnyen pos sdom pa ni bshags pa'i yan lag /rgyal ba rnams kyis 'gro ba'i don du chos kyi 'khor lo chen po/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis spyod pa rlabs po che/ sems can rnams kyis bsod nams dang thar pa cha mthun gyi dge ba/ rang gis sngar byas pa/ da lta byed bzhin/ phyis byed par nges pa thams cad la snying thag pa nas rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sogs gzhan don rlabs po che'i khur bzod pa rnams / 'gro ba'i log sgrub dang skyo ngal gyis sun nas chos mi gsung bar zhi bder gzhol ba dag gi drung du/ sngon tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis zhu ba phul ba ltar/ bdag kyang lus bye ba brgya stong grangs med par sprul nas 'khor lo dang nor bu la sogs pa phul nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba gdab pa ni chos 'khor bskor ba'i yan lag /zhing khams 'di dang gzhan dag tu bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sems can gyi don mdzad zin nas mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa dag gi mdun du/ sngon gyi dge bsnyen tsun+das gsol ba btab pa ltar 147

bdag lus mang por sprul te gsol ba btab pas/ 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du bzhugs nas sems can gyi don mdzad par bsam pa ni bzhugs par gsol 'debs kyi yan lag /da ltar gyi dge bas mtshon nas rang gzhan gyis dus gsum dang 'brel bar bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad sems can thams cad kyi don du 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i yongs bsngo ltar dmigs pa med pa'i shes rab kyis rgyas 'debs pa ni bsngo ba'i yan lag ste/ ngag tu/hrīḥ bdag lus zhing gi rdul rnyed du: sogs brjod cing 'di'i khongs su phyag 'bum yang 'gro bar byed pa lag len yin no/ /gsum pa phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab cing rgyu rdo rje bzhi'i ngo bor bsgrub pa ni/ 'di ltar dpal mgon bla ma dam pa ni dkyil 'khor gang tu te ru ku'i ngo bor dbang rdzogs/ mthong ba dang thos pa dang dran pa dang reg pa tsam gyis thar pa'i sa bon 'debs shing sangs rgyas thams cad dang phrin las kyi byed pa gcig pas dkon mchog bzhi par byon/ rang ngor tshe gcig lus gcig la smin grol zab mo'i lam dang thugs rje'i byin rlabs kho nas rdo rje 'chang gi sar btsan thabs su bkod pas sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin mchog tu lhag cing yon tan gyi sgo nas gzhal na dgongs pa nam mkha' ltar rgya che/ mkhyen brtse rgya mtsho ltar tshad 148

med sgyu thugs rje chu klung ltar shugs drag /rang bzhin ri rgyal ltar thugs brtan/ 'gro bar pha ma ltar thugs snyoms shing / yon tan re re'i cha yang dpag tu mi nus pa/ gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis ci 'dod kyi dngos grub thams cad 'bad med du 'byung ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che khyed la brten/ khyed la re khyed gcig bsgrub snyam pa'i mos gus mchi ma 'khrug pa dang bcas/ rje btsun gu ru rin po cheḥkhyed ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyiḥsogs nas/ rje btsun chen po pad 'byung mkhyenaḥyan chad tshar ci nus gdab rjes/bdag la re sa gzhan na medaḥces pa nas/ sgrib gnyis sbyongs shig nus mthu canaḥyan chad tshar 'os 'tshams kyi rjes su/ gsol 'debs rgyud bskul gyi rnal 'byor badz+ra gu ru la chig sgril du bya/de'i tshe dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa ni/ bla ma la gdung ba drag po'i rkyen gyis bdag nyid la brtse bas rjes su dgongs/ gu ru'i smin mtshams nas o yig chu shel lta bur 'tsher ba las 'od zer 'phros / rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi las dang rtsa yi sgrib pa dag /sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ bskyed rim gyi snod du gyur/ rnam smin rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs/ sprul sku'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag /mgrin pa nas āḥyig pad+ma rā ga ltar 'bar ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi mgrin 149

pa nas zhugs/ ngag gi las dang rlung gi sgrib pa dag /gsung rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ bzlas brjod kyi snod du gyur/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i go 'phang gi skal ba rgyud la bzhag /thugs ku'i rtsu yig nam mkha'i mdog can las 'od zer 'phros/ /rang gi snying ga nas zhugs / yid kyi las dang thig le'i sgrib pa dag /thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ bde stong tsaṇ+ḍa li'i snod du gyur/ phyag rgyu'i rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs/ chos sku'i go 'phang gi skal ba rgyud la gzhag /slar yang thugs ku'i t+t+waṃ las t+t+waṃ yig gnyis pa zhig skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du chad/ rang sems dang tha dad med par 'dres/ kun gzhi'i las dang shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ tshig gis mtshon pa'i don dam gyi dbang thob/ ka dag rdzogs pa chen po'i snod du gyur/ lhun grub rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i skal pa rgyud la bzhag go/ /de rjes gu ru'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi sgo gsum du ma ro gcig tu bsres pa'i ngang la lta ba'i ngang mdangs bskyang zhing gsol 'debs bsnyen pa la 'bad/ 'di ni bla ma chos sku'i zhal lta ba zhes bya'o/ /de la rang rgyud la rdo rje bzhi'i sa bon gdod nas 'brel ba grub par 150

gnas pa rdo rje'i slob dpon gyis rig sad par bya ba'i dkyil 'khor du bcug nas smin par byas pa ni skabs 'dir gzhi'i dbang zhes bya la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi tshe gzhan rkyen la ltos pa med par kun nas kun tu nyams su blang bar byar yod pas lam gyi dbang zhes bya ste/ da ltar blangs pa la dag rdzogs smin gsum gyi yon tan rgya mtsho'i sa bon thebs pa'i dgos pa ches che ba dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i lam mchog 'dis smin par slebs pa rnams kyis lam dbang 'di rtags par blang zhing / gsol 'debs kyi bsnyen pa'i tshad kyang 'bum phrag brgya tham pa bzhi'o/ /'bras bu'i dbang ni / sgrib byed mtha' dag zad pa'i tshe mdo lugs la'ang sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur gyi tha snyad mtshon pa bzhin/ bla na med pa'i theg pa 'dir/ /chos sku kun tu bzang po la / /bla ma bya ba yod min te/ /dbang chos bshad byed mkhan po med / /rang sems chos skur rtogs tsa na/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbang lung thob/ /brgyud par 'dzin pa rtog pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i bla sgrub kyi gnas skabs na ting nge 'dzin la skyo ba seng ba dang / bog sad dbyung ba'i phyir dmigs pa'i rim pa bsal gzhag dang spro bsdu'i rnam pa go ma 'gag pa ni bla sgrub gzhung rtsa ba'i yig chung gis shes par 'gyur la/ thun thams cad kyi mthar 151

rdzogs rim bsdu ba'i dmigs pa zab gnad can 'di nges par gces te/ nam zhig tshe yi dus byas dza: sogs kyi tshig brjod pa dang chab gcig /slob dpon chen po la gdung ba drag po bskyed pa'i rkyen gyis bdag nyid la thugs rje'i 'jug pas shin tu dgongs par gyur te/ zhal 'dzum pa dang spyan dgyes chags su g.yo ba'i ngang las thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po drod tsha lam gyis 'bar ba zhig 'thon/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying gar reg pa'i mod la 'od kyi gong bu sran ma tsam du gyur/ de nyid kyang mthar me stag yar ba bzhin du gu ru rin po che'i thugs kur 'dres pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag /rjes thob la dge ba bsngo zhing zangs mdog dpal ri'i smon lam 'don pa'ang gnad dam pa'o/ /mos gus dang dam tshig rnam par dag pa gang zhig 'di yan chad kyi lam mthar phyin pas kyang dngos gzhi la mi ltos par rnga yab dpal gyi ri bor dbugs dbyung / dag pa'i zhing khams der rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i lam nyi zla'i bgrod pa las kyang myur bas kun tu bzang po'i sa la phyin par 'gyur ro/ /maṅga lam̐// //152

༄/ /chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgya gar skad du/ dharma dhā tu rat+na ko ṣa nā ma/ bod skad du/ chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas lhun grub ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rang byung ye shes 'od gsal byang chub sems/ /snang srid snod bcud 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i mdzod/ /mi g.yo spros dang bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /theg pa'i yang rtse ri rgyal nyi zla'i klong / /'od gsal lhun grub rdo rje snying po'i dbyings/ /rtsol zhing sgrub med rang bzhin babs kyi klong / /ye 'byams rmad du byung ba bshad kyis nyon/ /lhun grub klong las thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /ngo bo stong la rang bzhin ma 'gags pas/ /cir yang ma grub cir yang 'char ba ste/ /sku gsum klong nas 'khor 'das rang shar kyang / /dbyings las ma g.yos chos nyid bde ba'i zhing / /sems nyid klong chen 'gyur med nam mkha'i ngang / /rol pa nges med thugs rje cho 'phrul klong / /thams cad dbyings kyi rgyan las logs na med/ /phyi nang 'du 'phro byang chub sems kyi rtsal/ /cir yang ma yin cir yang snang ba'i 153

phyir / /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul ya mtshan rmad kyi chos/ /phyi nang skye 'gro gzugs su snang ba kun/ /dbyings kyi rgyan te sku yi 'khor lor shar / /ma lus grags pa'i sgra skad ji snyed kun/ /dbyings kyi rgyan te gsung gi 'khor lor shar/ /dran rig 'gyu 'phro mi rtog bsam yas kyang / /dbyings kyi rgyan te thugs kyi 'khor lor shar/ /'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas bzhi po yang / /chos dbyings ngang las g.yos pa rdul tsam med/ /snang srid yul drug gzung 'dzin snang ba yang / /chos dbyings ngang na med snang sgyu ma'i tshul/ /rten med sang seng ye stong yangs pa che/ /rang gsal ji bzhin chos dbyings rgyan du shar//ji ltar snang grags dbyings kyi ngang chen 'dir/ /lhun mnyam mi g.yo chos sku byang chub sems/ /ye babs rang stong 'pho dang 'gyur med pas/ /cir snang chos nyid rang byung ye shes ngang / /bya dang rtsol med bde klong gcig tu 'khyil/ /rang gsal mi g.yo longs spyod rdzogs pa ni/ /gang snang nyid nas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /bcos shing bsgyur med lhun mnyam gdal ba'o/ /sna tshogs ma 'dres rol ba'i 'char tshul las/ /sprul pa rang byung ya mtshan 'phrul gyi don/ /bya bral kun tu bzang las g.yos pa med/ /g.yang sa med pa'i byang chub sems nyid la/ /rtsol ba med pa'i sku gsum lhun rdzogs kyang / /dbyings las ma g.yos lhun grub 'dus ma byas//154

sku dang ye shes phrin las lhun rdzogs kyang / /tshogs chen ye rdzogs na shar chen po'i klong / /ye nas lhun grub 'pho 'gyur med pa'i zhing / /chos nyid ngang las chos can gzigs pa yang / /mkhyen pa ma 'gags dbyings kyi rgyan du shar/ /byas shing sgrub med ye nas gnas pa nyid/ /nyi mkha' bzhin te ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /ye nas lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings rum 'dir/ /'khor ba kun bzang mya ngan 'das pa bzang / /kun bzang klong na 'khor 'das ye nas med / /snang ba kun bzang stong pa kun tu bzang / /kun bzang klong na snang stong ye nas med/ /skye shi kun bzang bde sdug kun tu bzang / /kun bzang klong na bde sdug skye shi med/ /bdag gzhan kun bzang rtag chad kun tu bzang / /kun bzang klong na bdag gzhan rtag chad med/ /med la yod par 'dzin pas 'khrul bar btags / /rten med rmi lam 'dra ba'i rang bzhin la/ /'khor 'das rang mtshan zhen pa mtshar re che/ /thams cad kun ba zang lhun grub chen po ni/ /ma 'khrul mi 'khrul 'khrul bar mi 'gyur bas/ /srid pa ming tsam yod med mtha' las 'das/ /su yang gang du sngar yang ma 'khrul la/ /da lta mi 'khrul slad kyis 'khrul mi 'gyur/ /'di ni srid gsum ka dag dgongs pa'o/ /'khrul ba med pas ma 'khrul chos su med / /ye nas lhun grub rang byung rig pa che/ /ma grol mi grol grol 155

bar mi 'gyur la / /'das pa ming tsam su yang grol ma myong / /grol bar mi 'gyur bcings pa ye nas med/ /mkha' bzhin rnam dag rgya chad phyogs lhung bral/ /'di ni yongs grol ka dag dgongs pa'o/ /mdor na lhun grub yangs pa'i dbyings rum nas/ /rol pa'i rtsal gyi 'khor 'das ci shar yang / /shar tsam nyid nas 'khor 'das yod ma myong / /gnyid kyi rtsal las rmi lam ci shar yang / /don la med de rang rig bde ba'i mal/ /lhun mnyam yangs pa chen por phyam gdal lo/ /chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod las/ 'khor 'das dbyings las ma g.yos pa'i rang bzhin bstan pa'i le'u ste dang po'o/ /dbyings kyi rang bzhin gdod nas lhun grub la/ /phyi dang nang med kun tu khyab par gdal/ /mtha' yi mu med steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'das/ /yangs dog gnyis med rig pa mkha' ltar dag /dmigs bsam spro bsdu bral ba'i klong nyid du/ /skye med dbyings las skye ba'i cho 'phrul rnams/ /cir yang ma nges gar yang rgya chad med / /'di zhes mi mtshon dngos po mtshan ma med/ /phyogs 'byams nam mkha' 'dra ba'i rang bzhin la/ /skye med lhun grub snga phyi thog mtha' bral/ /'khor 'das kun gyi ngo bo byang chub sems/ /ma byung ma skyes ma nges lhun grub ni/ /gang nas ma 'ong gar yang song ba 156

med / /snga phyi ris med byang chub sems kyi klong / /'gro dang 'ong med kun tu khyab par gdal/ /thog mtha' dbus med chos nyid de bzhin nyid/ /phyam gdal mkha' mnyam dag pa'i rang bzhin la/ /thog mtha' med de snga phyi'i yul las 'das/ /skye 'gag med de dngos po mtshan ma med/ /'gro 'ong med de 'di zhes mtshon dang bral / /rtsol zhing sgrub med bya ba'i chos kyis stong / /phyogs cha dbus med de bzhin nyid kyi gzhi/ /dmigs med rgyun chad med de mnyam pa'i klong / /thams cad chos nyid mnyam pa'i rang bzhin las/ /mnyam pa'i klong na mi gnas gcig kyang med/ /gcig mnyam kun mnyam byang chub sems kyi ngang / /ma skyes mkha' mnyam yangs par phyam gdal bas/ /mnyam nyid ngang la rgyun chad med pa'i phyir/ /lhun grub phyogs med kun khyab gdal ba'i rdzong / /steng 'og bar med ye klong yangs pa'i rdzong / /phyogs med kun shong skye med chos sku'i rdzong / /mi 'gyur lhun grub rin chen gsang ba'i rdzong / /snang srid 'khor 'das ye rdzong phyam gcig rdzogs/ /phyogs med kun khyab gdal ba'i sa gzhi la/ /'khor 'das ris med byang chub sems kyi mkhar/ /chos nyid klong yangs rtse mo lhun mtho zhing / /ma byas rang bzhin phyogs bzhi yangs pa'i dkyil/ /rim rtsol bral ba'i 'jug sgo shin tu yangs/ /lhun grub 'byor ba'i bkod pas 157

brgyan pa der/ /rang byung ye shes rgyal po gdan la bzhugs/ /'du 'phror snang ba ye shes rtsal rnams kun/ /blon por gyur pas yul la dbang bsgyur zhing / /rang gnas bsam gtan btsun mo dam pa dang / /dgongs pa rang shar sras dang bran g.yog bcas/ /bde chen klong 'khyil rang gsal rtog pa med/ /mi g.yo bsam brjod bral ba'i ngang nyid las/ /snang srid snod bcud kun la mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /chos dbyings yangs pa'i yul khams rgya che'o/ /yul der gnas na thams cad chos kyi sku/ /rang byung ye shes gcig las ma g.yos par/ /ma byas ye zin rtsol sgrub 'das pa nyid/ /grwa zur med pa'i thig le zlum pas na/ /ji bzhin dbye bsal med pa'i klong du 'khyil/ /'gro drug gnas dang sangs rgyas zhing khams kyang / /gzhan na med de chos nyid nam mkha'i ngang / /rang gsal byang chub sems su ro gcig pas/ /rig pa'i ngang du 'khor 'das 'ub chub po / /thams cad kun 'byung chos dbyings mdzod 'di ni/ /'das pa ma btsal ye nas lhun grub pas/ /chos sku mi 'gyur yul med kun 'byams la/ /phyi nang snod bcud snang ba longs spyod rdzogs/ /gzugs brnyan lta bur rang shar sprul ba'i sku/ /sku gsum rgyan du ma rdzogs chos med pas/ /thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi rol par shar / /bde gshegs zhing khams ma lus grangs med kyang / /nyid 158

las byung ba'i sems nyid sku gsum klong / /'khor ba'i rang bzhin 'gro drug grong khyer kyang / /chos dbyings ngang las gzugs brnyan shar ba tsam/ /skye shi bde sdug sna tshogs snang ba yang / /sems nyid klong 'dir sprul ba'i ltad mo bzhin/ /med la yod la snang la gzhi med pas/ /mkha' la sprin bzhin glo bur rkyen byung tsam/ /yod min med min rang bzhin mtha' 'das pas/ /spros bral thig le'i ngang du 'ub chub po/ /sems nyid byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin ni/ /mkha' ltar dag pas skye shi bde sdug med/ /dngos po ris med 'khor 'das chos las grol/ /'di zhes mi mtshon mkha' klong rab yangs pas/ /mi 'gyur mi 'pho lhun grub 'dus ma byas/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying por sangs rgyas pas/ /thams cad kun kyang rang byung bde ba'i zhing / /lhun mnyam byang chub mchog gi ngang nyid do/ /chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod las/ snang srid zhing khams su shar ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o/ /thams cad kun 'dus byang chub sems su 'dus/ /byang chub sems las ma gtogs chos med pas/ /chos kun byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin no/ /byang chub sems kyi mtshon dpe nam mkha' 'dra//sems la rgyu med skye ba'i yul med pas/ /mi gnas brjod 'das bsam yul 'das pa nyid/ /nam mkha'i dbyings zhes dpe ru 159

mtshon pa tsam/ /mtshon dpe nyid kyang 'di zhes byar med na/ /mtshon dpe'i don la bsam brjod ga la srid/ /'di ni rang bzhin dag pa'i dper shes bya/ /don ni rang rig mkha' mnyam byang chub sems / /bsam pa'i yul min mtshon brjod 'das pa ste/ /rang gsal mi g.yo 'od gsal yangs pa'i klong / /ma byas lhun grub yangs dog mtho dman med/ /chos sku byang chub snying po'i dkyil yangs so/ /rtags ni rtsal las cir yang 'char ba ste/ /shar ba'i dus na shar sa shar mkhan med/ /shar zhes ming tsam dpyad na nam mkha' 'dra/ /ris med mnyam pa chen por 'ub chub pas/ /phyam gdal gzung 'dzin med pa'i klong nyid do/ /rang byung ye shes chos nyid phyogs yan la/ /dpe don rtags kyi nges pa'i mtshon dpe bstan / /mkha' mnyam gzer chen gsum gyi bdag nyid du/ /thams cad kun 'dus rang bzhin dbye bsal med/ /phyam mnyam yangs pa chen po'i dbyings rum na/ /thams cad ye mnyam snga phyi bzang ngan med/ /kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa'i dgongs pa'o/ /byang chub sems ni nyi ma'i snying po 'dra/ /ngang gis 'od gsal ye nas 'dus ma byas/ /sgrib pa'i chos med zang thal lhun gyis grub/ /spros pa'i tshogs med mi rtog chos nyid ngang / /stong pas chos sku gsal bas longs spyod rdzogs/ /zer ldan sprul ba sku gsum 'du 'brel med/ /160

lenas yon tan lhun gyis grub zin pas/ /skyon dang nyes cha'i mun pas bsgribs pa med/ /snga phyi dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med par gcig /sangs rgyas sems can kun la khyab par gcig /'di ni rang byung byang chub sems zhes bya/ /de yi rtsal ni cir yang 'char ba ste/ /rtog dang mi rtog snang srid snod bcud dang / /skye 'gro'i snang ba sna tshogs ji snyed do/ /'di kun shar yang rang bzhin 'gag med de / /smig rgyu'i chu dang rmi lam sgra brnyan bzhin/ /sprul pa gzugs brnyan dri za'i grong khyer dang / /mig yor ji bzhin med pa gsal snang du/ /gzhi med rten med glo bur snang ba tsam/ /bar skabs re 'ga'i chos su rtogs par bya/ /lhun grub byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin las/ /rol pa ma 'gags 'khor 'das cho 'phrul 'byung / /cho 'phrul de kun dbyings su 'ub chub pas/ /gdod ma'i ngang las g.yos pa med shes bya/ /'dir ni thams cad byang chub sems kyi ngang / /gcig rdzogs kun rdzogs ma byas don kun rdzogs/ /rang bzhin lhun rdzogs rang byung ye shes so/ /byang chub sems ni snang dang mi snang las/ /'khor 'das phyi nang chos su med na yang / /de yi rtsal las g.yos pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /snang srid 'khor 'das sna tshogs rol par shar/ /shar tsam/ nyid nas rang bzhin stong pa'i gzugs / /skye ba med las skye bar snang ba ste/ /snang dus nyid nas 161

skyes pa 'ga' yang med/ /'gag pa med pa 'gag par snang na yang —/ /'gag pa med de sgyu ma stong pa'i gzugs/ /gnas pa nyid nas gnas pa'i chos med de/ /gnas mkhan gzhi med 'gro 'ong med pa'i ngang / /ji ltar snang ba de ltar ma grub pas/ /rang bzhin med ces btags pa tsam du zad/ /snang ba de yang rtsal las rang shar bas/ /rten 'brel nyid ces rang bzhin brda tsam brjod/ /rtsal las shar ba snang ba'i rang dus nas/ /shar dang ma shar phyogs dang ris med pas/ /rtsal yang brda tsam ngo bo 'ga' med pas/ /thams cad rtag tu 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang / /byang chub sems las g.yos pa rdul tsam med/ /chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod las/byang chub sems kyi mtshon dpe bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o/ /kun 'dus byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin ni/ /snang ba ma yin snang ba'i chos las 'das/ /stong pa ma yin stong pa'i chos las 'das / /yod pa ma yin dngos po mtshan ma med/ /med pa ma yin 'khor 'das kun la khyab/ /yod med ma yin lhun mnyam gdod ma'i dbyings/ /phyogs dang ris med gzhi rtsa dngos po med/ /rgyun chad med pa'i rig pa byang chub klong / /'pho dang 'gyur med mkha' dbyings ye nas gdal/ /rang byung ye shes ye zla med pa'i don/ /mi skye mi 'gag thig le gcig tu 'dus/ /ma nges kun khyab phyogs 162

mtha' yongs kyi med/ /lhun mnyan mi g.yo rdo rje snying po'i gdung / /'du 'brel med pa'i dbyings mchog rab 'byams 'di/ /tshig gis mtshon pa'i spyod yul ma yin te/ /shes rab klong rdol so sor rang rig yul/ /bsam brjod spros dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mtshon dang mi mtshon med par thag bcad de/ /sgom dang bsgom par bya ba ma rnyed pas/ /bying rgod rnam rtog dgra bo bsad ma dgos / /ye nas spyi blugs gnas pa'i chos nyid la/ /bdag dang gzhan du rtog pa mi mnga' bas/ /khams gsum 'di nyid rang bzhin mnyam pa'i zhing / /dus gsum rgyal ba rang snang dag pa ste/ /spang blang med par thams cad phyam gcig pas/ /gzhan nas thob par bya ba rdul tsam med/ /chos kun sems nyid klong chen der gsal la/ /mnyam pa'i don las g.yos pa cung zad med/ /phyi dang nang med 'char nub rtog pa med/ /mtha' yi mun sel rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /gang yang ma spangs gol sa shugs la chod/ /'gro ba'i snang tshul sna tshogs 'jig rten dang / /dag pa'i sangs rgyas sku dang ye shes kyang / /rtogs dang ma rtogs rtsal las shar ba yi/ /rol pa ma 'gags nam mkha'i dbyings khyab kyang / /chos dbyings ngang la rtogs dang ma rtogs tsam/ /rtogs pas bde gshegs dag pa'i snang ba dang / /ma rtogs ma rig gzung 'dzin bag chags las/ /sna 163

tshogs snang yang dbyings las g.yos pa med/ /byang chub sems ni kun gyi dngos gzhi ste/ /mtshan nyid ma 'gags sna tshogs cir shar yang / /rang gsal chos nyid dag pa'i dbyings su gsal/ /dbye bsal med do rgya yan rig pa'i 'gros/ /zang thal ye shes rang byung klong yangs shing / /ma bsgribs phyi nang med par 'od gsal bas/ /rang rig sems kyi me long 'od po che/ /'dod 'byung nor bu rin chen chos kyi dbyings/ /btsal ba med pa thams cad rang byung bas//rang byung ye shes 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i dpal/ /che ba'i yon tan rnam grangs ji snyed pa/ /dbyings las dbyings byung thabs mchog ma 'gags shar/ /thams cad skye med dbyings su lhun rdzogs pas/ /dngos po zil gnon stong nyid byang chub klong / /stong pa zil gnon rang rig byang chub klong / /byang chub sems la snang stong ye nas med / /gnyis med ma zhen bsam yas cho 'phrul 'byung / /dus gsum dus med skye med chos kyi dbyings/ /mi 'gyur mi phyed 'dus ma byas pa'i klong / /dus gsum sangs rgyas rig pa'i ye shes dbyings / /gzung 'dzin zil gnon rang rig byang chub klong / /phyi dang nang med chos nyid lhun yangs so/ /chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod las/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o/ /164

sems nyid byang chub sems kyi ngo bo la/ /lta ba bsgom med spyod pa spyad du med/ /'bras bu bsgrub med sa lam bgrod du med/ /dkyil 'khor bskyed med bzlas brjod rdzogs rim med/ /dbang la bskur med dam tshig bsrung du med/ /ye nas lhun grub dag pa'i chos nyid la/ /glo bur rim rtsol rgyu 'bras chos las 'das/ /'di dag byang chub sems kyi ngo bo ste/ /nyi ma sprin dang mun pas ma bsgribs la/ /glo bur ma byas dbyings na ngang gis gsal/ /rtsol zhing sgrub pa'i chos bcu gang bstan pa/ /rtsal las glo bur 'khrul ngor gsungs pa nyid/ /rim rtsol dbang po'i rim pas 'jug pa'i thabs / /a ti yo ga rdo rje snying po'i don/ /ji bzhin rnal du 'byor la bstan pa min/ /rim 'jug rtsol ba can gyi gang zag rnams/ /chos nyid gdod ma'i dbyings su drangs pa'i phyir/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa'i theg /chung ngu gsum la bstan pa'i rim pa ste/ /kri ya u pa yo ga rnam pa gsum/ /'bring po gsum la rang bzhin babs kyis grub/ /ma hā a nu a ti rnam pa gsum/ /chen po gsum la gdod nas snang ba ste/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i chos kyi sgo dbye bas/ /skal ldan 'gro ba byang chub gsum la 'dren/ /kun kyang mthar thug rdo rje snying po'i don/ /gsang chen rmad du byung 'dir 'jug dgos pas/ /kun gyi rtse mo 'od gsal mchog mi 'gyur/ /165

mngon par byang chub snying po'i theg par grags/ /chos kyang gnyis las blang dor bya rtsol can/ /rtsal las rol par shar ba'i rang bzhin gyi/ /sems dang sems byung bag chags sbyang phyir bstan/ /de dag sems las ye shes dag par 'dod/ /blang dor bya rtsol med pa'i chos chen ni/ /rang byung ye shes byang chub sems nyid kyi/ /ngo bo thad drang ngang las ma g.yos par/ /mngon du byed pas gzhan du rtsol mi dgos/ /rang la bzhag nas gzhan du 'tshol mi byed/ /'di ni nyi ma'i ngo bo de nyid don/ /rang bzhag 'od gsal mi g.yo gnas par 'dod/ /gzhan ni sprin dang mun sel rtsol sgrub kyi/ /nyi ma gdod sgrub byed dang mtshungs par bstan/ /des na 'di gnyis khyad par gnam sa bzhin/ /deng sang a tir rlom pa'i glang chen dag /'gyu 'phro'i rtog tshogs byang chub sems yin lo/ /rmongs pa 'di kun mun pa'i klong nyid du/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i don la ring / /rtsal dang rtsal las shar ba'ang mi shes na/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo smos ci dgos/ /'dir ni gdod nas dag pa'i byang chub sems/ /don dam dbyings kyi chos nyid bden pa ni/ /smra bsam 'das pas shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ngang gis mi g.yo rang bzhin 'od gsal zhing / /'gyu 'phro'i spros dang ye nas bral ba la/ /ngo bo zhes brjod nyi ma'i snying po 'dra/ /de yi rtsal ni 'char tshul ma 166

'gags pa'i/ /rig pa zang thal rtog dpyod gnyis dang bral/ /sal gyis gsal yang gzung 'dzin med pa yin/ /rtsal las shar ba'i rig pa spros pa'i blo/ /des bskyed gzung 'dzin bag chags sna tshogs can/ /yul med yul du bzung ba'i yul lnga dang / /bdag med bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nyon mongs lnga/ /phyi nang snod bcud 'khrul snang ji snyed de/ /'khor bar snang ba rtsal las yang shar ba/ /ma rtogs log par gzung ba'i snang ba nyid/ /gang nas ma 'ongs gang du ma song la/ /shar yang mi gnas chos nyid klong chen du/ /rtogs pas khams gsum yongs grol dgongs pa zhes/ /a ti lhun grub rdo rje snying po'i lung / /kun bzang yangs pa chen po'i klong nas shar/ /rnam dag byang chub sems kyi ngo bo la/ /lta ba'i yul med lta ba'i chos su med/ /blta bar bya dang byed pa rdul tsam med/ /sgom pa'i blo med bsgom bya'i chos kyang med/ /spyad dang spyod pa gnyis med lhun grub pas/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i 'bras bu rdul tsam med/ /med pa'i chos la bgrod pa'i sa med pas/ /phyin par bya ba'i lam yang ye nas med/ /'od gsal thig le chen por grub zin pas/ /rnam rtog 'phro 'dus bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / /sngags dang kha ton dbang dang dam tshig med/ /rim sdud la sogs mi dmigs rdzogs rim med/ /ye nas grub zin sku dang ye shes la/ /'dus byas 167

glo bur rkyen byung rgyu 'bras med/ /'di dag yod na rang byung ye shes min/ /'dus byas nyid phyir 'jig pa nyid dang ni/ /lhun grub 'dus ma byas zhes gang slad mtshon/ /de phyir don dam dbyings kyi ngo bo la/ /rgyu 'bras las 'das rang bzhin rnam bcu med/ /rtsol dang bsgrub med sems nyid rnal ma'i don/ /yod med spros kun zhi bar mkhyen mtshal lo/ /chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod las/ rtsol sgrub rgyu 'bras las 'das pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o/ /nyi ma'i snying por 'od noms 'dus pa ltar/ /chos kun rtsa ba byang chub sems su 'dus/ /snang srid snod bcud ma dag 'khrul ba yang / /gang byung rten dang gnas pa'i dbyings brtags pas/ /gzhi med ye grol sems kyi ngang du 'dus/ /sems nyid ye klong yangs pa chen po'i ngang / /'khrul dang ma 'khrul ming don 'das par 'dus//dag pa'i rang snang sku dang zhing khams dang / /ye shes phrin las ngo mtshar rol pa yang / /rang byung ngang la 'du 'brel med par 'dus / /snang srid 'khor 'das kun 'dus byang chub sems/ /nyi mkha' bzhin du stong gsal 'dus ma byas/ /gdod nas rang byung ye klong yangs pa yin/ /sems nyid klong chen 'gyur med nam mkha'i ngang / /rol pa nges med byang chub sems kyi rtsal/ /'khor 'das theg pa kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /byar med gcig gis 168

thams cad zil gyis mnan/ /mtha' ru gyur pa'i yul gzhan logs na med/ /chos nyid byang chub sems las gar ma g.yos/ /thams cad kun bzang lhun grub gcig shar bas/ /ma lus kun 'dus 'gran zla bral ba'i mchog /che ba'i che ba kun bzang chos kyi dbyings / /rgyal po lta bur thams cad kun 'dus pas/ /'khor 'das kun la dbang bsgyur gar ma g.yos/ /thams cad kun bzang mi bzang gcig med pas/ /bzang ngan med par kun tu bzang por gcig /grub dang ma grub thams cad dbyings gcig pas / /thams cad lhun grub mi g.yo mnyam par gcig /gcig las kun shar ma lus chos kyi dbyings/ /byar med ngang la sgrub med btsal du med/ /rtsol sgrub rang gi dbyings las gzhan med pas/ /gang las rtsol zhing gang du sgrub par byed/ /btsal ba'i yul med bsgom pas mthong ba med/ /bsgrub pa'i gnas med gzhan nas 'ong ba med/ /'gro 'ong med pas mnyam nyid chos kyi sku/ /lhun rdzogs thig le chen po'i dbyings su 'dus/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa'i lung / /bdag dang bdag gi med par thag bcad nas/ /spros bral nam mkha' 'dra bar dgongs don gcig /a ti mchog gsang rnal 'byor chen po'i lung / /bdag gzhan dbyer med yangs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /rang byung ye shes ji bzhin 169

rnal 'jog pas/ /dgongs don de kun snying po'i mchog 'dir 'dus / /gī ya u pa yo ga rigs gsum yang / /bdag dang lha dang ting 'dzin mchod sprin las/ /sgo gsum rnam dag dngos grub 'dod par gcig /rdo rje rtse mo lung rgyal gsang ba yang / /snang grag rig pa rnam dag ye nas lha/ /sgo gsum rnam dag dngos grub mngon gyur pas/ /dgongs pa de kun snying po'i mchog 'dir 'dus/ /ma hā a nu a ti rnam gsum yang / /snang srid snod bcud lha dang lha mo'i zhing / /dbyings dang ye shes rnam dag dbyer med pas/ /chos nyid mi g.yo rang byung ye shes 'dod/ /mchog gsang rab 'dir thams cad rnam dag pas/ /ma byas gzhal yas ye klong bde ba'i zhing / /phyi dang nang med kun khyab gdal ba las/ /blang dor bya rtsol mtshan ma'i chos med par/ /thams cad ye 'byams chos sku'i klong du grol/ /dgongs pa de kun gsang chen snying por 'dus/ /gcig rdzogs kun rdzogs chos kun 'dus pa'i klong / /ye babs rang gsal lhun grub chen por 'dus/ /chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod las/ thams cad byang chub sems su 'dus par bstan pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o/ /rang bzhin lhun grub byang chub sems kyi lung / /ma byas don grub ri rgyal rtse mo ni/ /kun las 'phags so theg mchog rgyal po che/ /ji 170

ltarari rgyal rtse mor phyin pa na/ /dma' ba'i lung rnams dus gcig mthong ba ste/ /lung gis rtse mo'i rang bzhin mthong dang bral/ /de bzhin a ti rdo rje snying po ni/ /theg pa'i yang rtse don kun gsal bar mthong / /'og ma'i theg pas 'di don mthong ba med/ /de phyir lhun grub rtse mor gyur pa'i tshe/ /ji ltar yid bzhin nor bu chen po la / /gsol ba btab na 'dod rgu ngang bis 'byung / /phal ba'i ngos la de lta ma yin no/ /rdo rje snying po sku gsum lhun grub pas/ /rang bzhag dbyings las sangs rgyas rang la 'grub/ /rtsol zhing bsgrub med che ba de nyid do/ /'og ma'i theg pas blang dor 'bad byas kyang / /bskal par mi 'grub tshi chad nad du che/ /ye nas lhun mnyam rig pa byang chub sems/ /ji bzhin rang babs chos nyid yangs pa ni / /rang bzhin chos sku mnyam nyid gdod ma'i klong / /kun la yod de skal ldan 'ga' yi yul/ /ji bzhin bzhag na ngang der babs kyis 'grub/ /khyab gdal rang gsal lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs/ /kun la yod kyang mthong ba 'ga' yi yul/ /gang snang rang bzhag bya rtsol bral na mngon/ /ma 'gags rol pa sprul sku gdal ba'i klong / /kun la yod de 'char ba'i dus na gsal/ /yid bzhin yon tan phrin las cho 'phrul yang / /gzhan na med de rang rig dag pa'i klong / /chu dang rnyog bzhin rang dwangs bzhag na 'char/ /btsal 171

bas mi rnyed gdod nas dag pa'i chos/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rang byung klong na gsal/ /sngar grub zin pas da gzod bsgrub mi dgos//che ba rang gnas dgongs pa chos nyid klong / /mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub la rtsol mi byed/ /ye gzhi babs gzhi byang chub snying po'i gzhi/ /rang bzhin ngang las g.yos pa 'ga' med pas/ /klong gsal rig pa'i don las mi g.yo zhing / /thams cad bzhag pas grub pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / /mi 'gyur kun 'gro khyab bdag ye shes lnga/ /sku lnga gsung lnga thugs lnga yon tan lnga/ /phrin las lnga ste dang po'i sangs rgyas kyang / /thog mtha' med pa'i klong 'dir lhun grub pas/ /gzhan du ma 'tshol rang bzhin ye nas grub/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi chos sku byang chub kyang / /mi 'gyur mnyam pa'i don las gzhan du med / /de yang rang byung ngang 'dir lhun grub pas/ /ma tshol ma sgrubs re dogs lhun gyis zhog /sems can kun gyi rang byung ye shes kyang / /ma byas ma btsal chos skur lhun grub pas/ /spang blang ma 'dzin chos dbyings ngang 'dir zhog /mi g.yo mi bsam lhun mnyam ngo bo la/ /ma byas don grub gzhi klong yangs pa yin/ /mi 'gyur kun 'gro sku dang ye shes bdag /rgyal thabs spyi blugs rang byung chen po'i dbang / /snang srid snod bcud ye grol lhun grub pas/ /bya rtsol mi dgos rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /thams cad kun grub lhun 172

grub chen por rgyas/ /chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod las/ thams cad byang chub kyi sems su ye nas lhun gyis grub par bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o/ /thams cad dbyings gcig rang byung ye shes la/ /gnyis su med pa ngo bo'i 'dug tshul te/ /gnyis snang ma 'gags rtsal las rol par shar/ /snang btags gnyis med byang chub sems zhes bya/ /'pho 'gyur med pa'i rig pa byang chub la/ /spangs thob med pa'i snang srid 'khor 'das shar/ /gzung 'dzin med pa'i rnal 'byor ngo kha la / /med la snang 'di ya mtshan dgod po 'chor/ /snang bar med la sna tshogs snang bar shar/ /stong par med la mtha' dbus khyab par gdal / /gzung 'dzin med la nga bdag so sor zhen/ /gzhi rtsa med la tshe rabs brgyud mar snang / /dgag sgrub med la bde sdug blang dor byed/ /phar bltas skye 'gro'i snang ba mtshar re che/ /mi bden bden par zhen pas bden bden 'dra/ /ma 'khrul 'khrul bar zhen pas 'khrul 'khrul 'dra/ /nges med nges par bzung bas nges nges 'dra/ /yin min yin par bzung bas yin yin 'dra/ /mi 'thad 'thad par bzung bas 'thad 'thad 'dra/ /sna tshogs col chung yul gyis sems khrid nas/ /don med rig pa skad cig brgyud mar mthud/ /nyin zhag zla ba lo dang mi tshe 'das/ /gnyis med 173

gnyis su bzung bas 'gro ba bslus/ /rnal 'byor dag pa'i sems la tshur bltas pas/ /rten gzhi med pa'i rig pa ming dang bral/ /mtshon brjod ma mthong lta sgom khrigs chags bud/ /phyal ba lhug pa yangs pa phyam gdal bas/ /nyams len ma shes thun mtshams phyogs ris med/ /thams cad rgya yan phyam phyam bar mtshams bral/ /lus dang yul la snang ba'i gtad med par/ /nam mkha'i klong mnyam yangs pa phyam gdal bas/ /nang gi chos zhes bdag tu 'dzin pa med/ /phyi rol snang ba'i yul la phar bltas pas/ /thams cad sang seng 'al 'ol zang ma thal/ /ra ri zab zeb gza' gtad chos dang bral/ /snang grag dran rig myong tshor sngar bzhin med/ /'di ci rang bzhin smyon pa'i snang ba'am/ /rmi lam nang bzhin rang la dgod po 'chor/ /dgra gnyen chags sdang nye ring 'du shes bral//nyin mtshan ris med mnyam par phyam gcig pas/ /dmigs gtad mtshan ma 'dzin pa'i 'khor ba sangs/ /rang byung ye shes ngang zhes mi rtog pas/ /blang dor spang gnyen gzeb las 'das pa yin/ /'di ltar rtogs na gnyis med ye shes te/ /rang byung kun tu bzang po'i dgongs par phyin/ /ldog pa'i gnas med zad pa'i sar phyin te / /rang byung ngang nas mnyam nyid ma rtogs par/ /gnyis med nyid ces tshig la mngon zhen nas/ /ci yang mi dmigs yid dpyod 174

bdeng 'cha' ba/ /log rtogs nyid de ma rig mun pa'i klong / /de phyir rang byung 'pho 'gyur med pa la/ /bsam rdzogs rgyal po gnyis su med par sbyang / /khams gsum yongs grol 'khor 'das gnyis med don/ /rang bzhin khong nas rang shar chos sku'i rdzong / /mkha' ltar rnam dag dpe las 'das pa 'byung / /'di dang 'di zhes so sor zhen pa'i bar/ /gnyis su gnas par rang gzhan 'khrul ba'i gzab / /gang tshe 'di zhes tha dad ris med cing / /thams cad phyam mnyam dmigs gtad med pa na/ /gnyis med rtogs zhes rdo rje sems dpas gsungs/ /chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod las/byang chub kyi sems la gnyis su med par bstan pa ste le'u brgyad pa'o //rang bzhin yangs pa chen po'i klong gcig la/ /mkha' mnyam byang chub sems kyi gnam gzer ni/ /gnad du dril te bcud du phyung ba ni/ /che ba'i che ba kun bzang yangs pa'i thugs/ /rang gi ngo bos spyi rgya rlabs kyis bcad/ /klong chen gcig la rtogs dang ma rtogs dang / /grol dang ma grol gnyis med mnyam pa che/ /sgo nga'i nang nas 'dab gshog rgyas pa'i bya/ /rgya dang bral bas nam mkha'i klong na gnas/ /klu rnams zil gnon g.yang sa shugs kyis chod/ /theg pa'i yang rtse rdo rje snying po yang / /ji bzhin rtogs pa'i rnal 175

'byor skal ba can/ /theg dman zil gnon 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chod / /kun grol mnyam pa chen por gnas pa de/ /rgyu 'bras rtsol sgrub can la mi rigs kyang / /theg mchog mi g.yo mnyam pa'i don la 'thad/ /thams cad bde chen mkha' mnyam chos sku'i klong / /chos sku'i klong du ma grol 'ga' yang med/ /chos nyid rang bzhengs rdo rje snying po'i sku/ /bag chags lus la snying po'i rtsal rdzogs te/ /skye shi bar do srid pa'i lus bor nas/ /rig pa gcig pu kun dang dbyer med cing / /lhun grub sa la rgyal ba'i srid zin nas/ /rgya chad med par sprul pa 'byung ba dang / /thogs pa med par kun la 'jug pa ni/ /byar med rlung zhon rnal 'byor spyod yul te/ /dman pa'i theg pa kun la mi rigs kyang / /a tis rig par ston pa 'bras bu'i gnad/ /skye med skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'byung ba la/ /rgyu 'bras mtshan mar 'dzin pa 'khrul pa'i blo/ /a tis rgyu rkyen med par bstan pa ste/ /'og ma rnams la mi rigs rigs pa'i gnad/ /sangs rgyas sems can dgongs spyod dbyer med la/ /'khor 'das gnyis su 'dzin pa 'khrul ba'i blo/ /a tis gnyis su med par bstan pa de/ /'og ma rnams la mi rigs rigs pa'i gnad/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs med par grol ba la/ /rtogs nas grol bar 'dod pa nyams pa'i dgra/ /a tis mnyam nyid gcig tu bstan pa 176

de / /'og ma rnams la mi rigs rigs pa'i gnad/ /mtshon byed thabs kyi khyad par ma bsten par/ /brjod med rtogs par mi 'dod blun po'i blo/ /a tis don dam dbyer med bstan pa de/ /'og ma rnams la mi rigs rigs pa'i gnad/ /rdzogs chen ye gdal gting mtha' med pa la/ /thug pa med ces zer ba blun po'i blo / /a tis mu med tshig chod bstan pa de/ /'og ma'i blo yul mi rigs rigs pa'i gnad/ /thig le gcig la rgyu mtshan go bzlog pas ཿ /'bras bu re dogs chod des mkha' dang mnyam/ /yangs so che'o mkha' mnyam rgyal ba'i thugs/ /spangs thob med de thig le gcig gi klong / /ye nas grol lo rtogs dang ma rtogs med/ /rnal 'byor mkha' mnyam bya bral lam du bde/ /ye sangs rgyas pa'i rig pa yul med 'di/ /'khor bar mi 'khyams 'khrul gzhi kun las 'das / /su yang ma 'khrul 'khrul pa'i gnas med de/ /thams cad chos dbyings klong gsal gcig gi ngang / /snga phyi ris med mkha' mnyam yangs pa nyid/ /ye babs lhun grub 'khor ba gdod nas dag /grol bar mi 'jug mya ngan 'das mi len/ /mi 'gyur klong chen 'khor 'das yod ma myong / /'di la spang thob re dogs mi dmigs shing / /gdod nas byang chub gzhi klong yangs pa che/ /thams cad ming tsam don la mtshon brjod 'das/ /grol dang 177

'khrul med 'khor 'das la zlos pas/ /su yang ma rtsol bcos bsgyur ma byed cig /yangs dog mtho dman med pa'i rig pa la/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung med kyis dmigs gtad shol/ /bya byed 'gro 'ong med pa'i rig pa la/ /dus dang gnyen por med kyis 'dzin rtsol zhog /ched du dmigs pa yod na 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /gang la'ang gtad 'dzin ma 'cha' phyam la thong / /chos kun ye nas grol rung ma grol rung / /gnas lugs rang bzhin dag rung ma dag rung / /sems nyid spros dang bral rung ma bral rung / /gnyug ma'i gshis la grub rung ma grub rung / /'khor 'das rang bzhin gnyis rung ma gnyis rung / /bsam brjod kun las 'das rung ma 'das rung / /dgag sgrub 'khrul pa zhig rung ma zhig rung / /rtogs pa'i lta ba rtogs rung ma rtogs rung / /chos nyid don la bsgoms rung ma bsgoms rung / /blang dor med pas dpyad rung ma dpyad rung / /gnas lugs 'bras bu grub rung ma grub rung / /sa dang lam rnams bgrod rung ma bgrod rung / /sgrib pa kun dang bral rung ma bral rung ske/ /bskyed rdzogs chos nyid rdzogs rung ma rdzogs rung / /thar pa'i 'bras bu thob rung ma thob rung / /'gro drug 'khor bar 'khyams rung ma 'khyams rung / /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub rung ma grub rung / /rtag chad gnyis 'dzin bcings rung ma bcings rung //178

chos nyid dgongs par sleb rung ma sleb rung / /gong ma'i rjes su snyogs rung ma snyogs rung / /gnam sa 'dre ldog snang ba ci shar yang / /phyal ba lhug pa gzhi med zang ka ma/ /gtad med zang zing ban bun chal ma chol/ /re dogs gnyis med skyon pa'i ngang tshul can / /lta sgom ris med ched 'dzin 'dod blo zhig /zhe 'dod 'khris med 'di zhes rtsol sgrub med/ /gang byung byung la gang snang snang du chug /gang shar shar la gang yin yin du chug /gang yang yin la gang yang min du chug /kun spyod nges med rig pa thod rgal ngang / /chos dang chos min rtsis gzhi 'ga' med pas/ /gtad med zang ka grub mtha'i gzeb las 'das/ /za 'chag nyal 'dug nyin zhag phyam gdal bas/ /rang bzhin chos nyid mnyam pa'i ngang nyid de/ /mchod pa'i lha med brdung ba'i 'dre yang med/ /sgom pa'i chos med tha mal rang ga'i ngang / /ma bcos rgyal po snyems med phyam gcig pas / /phyal pa lhug pa lhun grub gcig pu nyid/ /ma byas ye zin rtsol sgrub bral bas bde/ /lta ba'i gzhi med sgom pa'i ngang med la/ /spyad pa'i chos med bsgrub bya'i 'bras bu med/ /thams cad ris med mnyam par phyam gdal bas/ /bya rtsol mi dgos yangs dog med par bde/ /smon pa med pas sgrub blo'i chos zad de/ /spang bya med pas gnyen po'i 'ching zhen 'das/ /gang yin kun yin yin min 179

'ga' med pas/ /gang snang gang shar 'dem ka med par grol/ /ma grol ye grol rang grol chos med pas/ /phyam gcig gtad med la bzla'i chos las 'das/ /klong yangs klongs yangs klong chen yangs pa'i ngang / /klong chen rab 'byams klong gsal klong 'byams pas /klong gcig gnyis med bde klong 'khyil ba ni/ /sna tshogs rang grol chos nyid zad sar phyin/ /mi 'gyur lhun grub 'dun ma legs pa'i rtse / /bdag bzhin rjes su 'jug pa'i 'gro rnams kyang / /'di bzhin ye 'byams klong chen gcig tu dril/ /kun bzang sa la gtan srid zin pa yin/ /chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod las/chos thams cad byang chub sems kyi klong du la bzla bar bstan pa'i ste le'u dgu pa'o/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i byang chub sems/ /btang gzhag 'gro 'ong med pa'i chos nyid la/ /btsal bas mi 'grub chos nyid nam mkha'i klong / /rang bzhin bzhag pas 'od gsal nyi zla 'char//yul kyang mi dgag sems kyang mi gzung bar/ /rang bzhin lhun mnyam ngang las mi g.yo na/ /kun bzang yangs pa chen po'i dgongs par phyin/ /mi spro mi bsdu rang dwangs sang nge ba/ /dwangs pa'i rgya mtsho mi g.yo mnyam pa bzhin/ /chos nyid gting gsal rang byung ye shes ngang/ /'byung 'jug re dogs bral bar gnas pa yin//180

tshig gis mi mtshon 'jur bu'i sems med par/ /rang babs gyin 'da' bcos bslad med pa ni/ /klong thim chos nyid mtshan ma med pa ste/ /sgom dang bsgom par bya ba'i chos med pas/ /bying rgod rang yan rang byung dgongs par shar/ /spangs pas mi spong kun rtog rig pa'i rtsal/ /chos nyid ngang du dbye bsal ris med pas/ /bsgrubs pas mi 'grub chos nyid dbyings su shar/ /'khor ba ma spangs rang byung ye shes su/ /klong chen rtsal gyi rnal 'byor dag pas mthong / /ye nas snang sems rang babs chos nyid ngang / /ting 'dzin mi g.yo chu bo'i rgyun shar bas/ /rdo rje rtse mo kun bzang thugs kyi mchog /yangs pa'i chos mchog nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam / /dbye bsal med par thams cad sgom pa'i mchog /ye 'byams rmad byung rgyal por lhun gyis grub/ /ye nas spyi blugs 'od gsal chu bo'i rgyun/ /btang bzhag med pa'i ngang 'dir lhun grub pas / /'khor 'das rang bzhin chos dbyings dgongs pa'i mchog /mi g.yo brjod 'das mkha' mnyam klong chen nyid/ /'gro ba kun la ye nas babs kyis grub/ /bdag las gzhan du snang ba 'khrul ba'i sems / /bsgom dang rtsol bar 'dod pa 'khrul ba'i sems/ /'khrul ba chos nyid ngang bzhag mnyam pa'i zhing / /mi g.yo gdod nas dag pa'i rang bzhin klong / /bya dang rtsol med gzhag dang ma bzhag 181

med / /mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i chos nyid la/ /dmigs bsam tshol khro bral ba'i rang rig gis/ /yang yang bltas na blta ru med pa mthong / /bltar med rig pa spyi blugs lta ba yin/ /ma bsgoms rig pa btang gzhag bral ba la/ /yang yang bsgoms na bsgom du med pa mthong / /bsgom med rig pa spyi blugs sgom pa yin/ /gnyis med blang dor bral ba'i gnas lugs la/ /yang yang dpyad na dpyad du med pa mthong / /dpyad med rig pa spyi blugs spyod pa yin / /ye zin re dogs bral ba'i lhun grub la/ /yang yang bsgrubs na bsgrub tu med pa mthong / /bsgrub med rig pa spyi blugs 'bras bu yin/ /mnyam nyid ngang las yul du mi rtog cing / /sems su mi 'dzin re dogs 'byung 'jug zhi/ /yul sems mnyam pa'i ngang der gnas pa ni/ /chos nyid klong las ngang gis g.yos pa med/ /mtshan ma'i yul la yul med spyi blugs gnas/ /ye nas gnyis med rig pa spyi blugs pas/ /'khor 'das dbyer med rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang / /thams cad blang dor med par phyam gdal lo/ /dngos dang dngos med dbyings su mnyam pa dang / /sangs rgyas sems can dbyings su mnyam pa dang / /kun rdzob don dam dbyings su mnyam pa dang / /skyon dang yon tan dbyings su mnyam pa dang / /mtho dman phyogs mtshams dbyings su mnyam pa'i phyir/ /rang byung 182

ngang las rol ba ci shar yang / /shar ba'i dus na mnyam shar bzang ngan med/ /de la blang dor gnyen pos bcos ci dgos/ /gnas pa'i tshe na mnyam gnas bzang ngan med/ /da lta sems las gang byung rang zhir glod/ /grol ba'i tshe na mnyam grol bzang ngan med / /dran pa'i rjes la dgag sgrub 'phro ma mthud/ /thams cad gzhi klong byang chub sems nyid las/ /rtsal dang rol pa'i 'char tshul ma nges pas/ /mnyam par shar yang gdod ma'i klong nas shar//mi mnyam shar yang mnyam pa'i dbyings nas shar/ /mnyam par gnas kyang rang bzhag chos nyid ngang / /mi mnyam gnas kyang mnyam pa'i dbyings na gnas/ /mnyam par grol yang rang byung ye shes klong / /mi mnyam grol yang mnyam pa'i dbyings su grol/ /thams cad ye mnyam rang byung rig pa la/ /shar dang ma shar dbyings la ye nas med/ /gnas dang mi gnas dbyings la ye nas med / /grol dang ma grol dbyings la ye nas med/ /mi g.yo mnyam pa chen po'i rig pa la/ /shar ba'i dus na rang shar rang sa zin/ /gnas pa'i dus na rang gnas rang sa zin/ /grol ba'i dus na rang grol rang sa zin/ /mi 'gyur spros dang bral ba'i rig pa la/ /shar ba ye shar gnas pa ye gnas la/ /grol ba ye grol nam mkha'i rang bzhin no/ /shar gnas grol gsum shar grol rgyun chad med/ /rgyun 183

chad med pas rgyu 'bras bar ma chod/ /rgyu 'bras med pas 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chod/ /g.yang sa med pas gol sa ga la yod/ /ye nas mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i klong / /'pho 'gyur med pa rdo rje sems dpa'i klong / /gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa tsam nyid la/ /sangs rgyas zhes su ming du btags par zad/ /'di nyid rtogs nas blang dor chos med pas/ /thams cad chos nyid gcig tu phyam gdal ba/ /gser gling lta bur dbye bsal med pa yin/ /mtha' yi ma rig gol sgrib gdar sha chod/ /g.yang sa med pa'i byang chub sems nyid la/ /'bad rtsol med pa'i sku gsum lhun rdzogs kyang / /bsam brjod 'das zhes ming tsam brjod par zad/ /snang ba rgya yan rig pa rang byung gsal/ /ma bsgribs phyi nang med par zang thal bas/ /ma bcos rnal gzhag chos nyid chen por gsal/ /blo bde'i mal na lus sems khong glod de/ /shes pa bag yangs byar med skyes bu bzhin/ /sgrims glod med par lus sems gang bder bzhag / ji ltar 'dug kyang rang gi ngang la 'dug /ji ltar gnas kyang rang gi ngang la gnas/ /ji ltar 'gro yang rang gi ngang la 'gro/ /byang chub dbyings la 'gro 'ong ngang gis med/ /'gro 'ong med pa rgyal ba rnams kyi sku/ /ji ltar smras kyang rang gi ngang la smra/ /ji ltar brjod kyang rang gi ngang la brjod/ /byang chub sems la smra brjod 184

ngang gis med/ /smra brjod med pa dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsung / /ji ltar bsams kyang rang gi ngang la bsam/ /ji ltar rtog kyang rang gi ngang la rtog /byang chub sems la bsam rtog ye nas med/ /bsam rtog bral ba dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs/ /med la cir yang 'byung ba sprul ba'i sku/ /nyid la nyid longs spyod pa longs spyod rdzogs/ /de la dngos gzhi med pas chos sku ste/ /'bras bu sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i klong / /byang chub sems kyi klong chen ngang nyid las/ /dran pa'i rnam par rtog pa mi 'byung ste/ /shes pa'i mtshan ma yid la mi g.yo na/ /de nyid sangs rgyas nyag gcig dgongs pa yin/ /byang chub rang bzhin nam mkha'i dkyil yangs 'dra/ /dran dang rtog pa med pa sgom pa'i mchog /rang gi rang bzhin ma g.yos bcos pa med / /mi bsam yid la byed pa rnam bral ba/ /rang babs chos nyid dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med/ /'gyu 'phro'i kun rtog med na sgom pa'i mchog /de bzhin nyid de gang gnas dam pa'i sems sangs rgyas nyag gcig mtshon pa kun dang bral/ /mi g.yo chos dbyings 'dzin rtog phyam 'das pa/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs klong rang bzhin yangs pa'i mchog /lus sems bcos pa'i 'ching ba rnams spangs shing / /gyin 'dar lhod chags dran bsam ci 'gyus kyang / /gzhi gzhag chos nyid ngang las mi g.yo na/ /thams cad kun bzang 185

dgongs klong yangs pa yin/ /ma bzung ma btang 'jur bu'i sgrims glod med/ /ji bzhin rang babs rgya yan ngang gis zin/ /mi g.yo phyam gdal yangs dog med pa'i klong / /dran bsam thams cad rang byung rang zhi na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha'i dgongs pa yin/ /ma bcos klong du ma yengs ngang ldan na/ /dran rtog yu/la la 'jug pa'ang chos nyid ngang / /ched du 'jur bus bcos na chos nyid kyang / /mi rtog mkha' ltar yangs kyang mtshan ma'i gzeb/ /nyin mtshan sgom pas 'da' yang 'ching zhen nyid/ /bsam gtan lha dang mtshungs par rgyal bas gsungs/ /de bas ma yengs 'bad rtsol zhig pa'i sems/ /rang babs 'dzin rtsol 'das pa shin tu gces / /rang byung ye shes phyogs dang ris med pas/ /'di zhes mi mtshon rang bzhin spros kun zhi/ /de bas yid la byed pa rnams spangs te/ /gzhi bral yangs pa chen po'i don la bslab/ /chos nyid nyag gcig rang byung ye shes te/ /lta ba nyag gcig spros pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /sgom pa nyag gcig gtang bzhag 'gro 'ong med/ /spyod pa nyag gcig blang dor byar med cing / /'bras bu nyag gcig spang thob gnyis dang bral/ /'di ni rang byung lhun grub dgongs pa yin//snang srid snod bcud 'khor dang mya ngan 'das/ /chos so cog kun chos nyid gdod ma'i ngang / /rang byung ye shes nyid las ma g.yos 186

pas / /gang yang gzhi gzhag dgongs par shes par bya/ /sna tshogs yul du snang ba'i chos nyid la/ /gang du 'di ltar 'jog ces mi rtog par/ /rang babs spro bsdu bral bar lhun gyis zhog /chos nyid mnyam pa'i klong du ngang gis gnas/ /dkar dmar yul du snang ba'i rnam pa la/ /dbang po mi bsdu mig kyang mi 'gul bas/ /bdag la mi bsam gzhan la mi rtog par/ /phyam phyam yangs pa chen por rang gsal zhog /rgya bskyed dpangs bstod spro bsdu bral ba'i sems / /kun mnyam rang byung ye shes dgongs pa la/ /phyi nang bar med nam mkha' 'dres pa'i nyams/ /bde gsal spros dang bral ba'i ting 'dzin 'char/ /gzhi gzhag mi g.yo chos nyid dgongs pa la / /phyi dang nang med gzung 'dzin spros dang bral/ /yul zhes gzhan du zhen pa'i sems med pas/ /gzung ba'i chos med snod bcud snang zhen bral/ /'khor bar skye ba'i yul med nam mkha' 'dra / /rang zhes sems la nang du mi rtog pas/ /'dzin pa'i chos med srid pa'i kun rtog zhi/ /'khor bar skye ba'i mkhan po rtsad nas chod / /de tshe mkha' 'dra phyi nang 'khrul ba'i chos/ /gang yang mi dmigs chos sku'i dgongs par phyin/ /zad pa'i sar thug 'gro dang 'ong med pas/ /thams cad klong 'byams kun tu bzang po'i zhing / /chos sku'i pho brang mchog tu phyin pa yin/ /da lta'i rig pa 187

gzhi las ma g.yos na/ /de nyid goms chas phyi ma'i srid pa stongs/ /yang srid len pa'i las dang bag chags bral/ /rgyu 'bras la zlos 'khor 'das mnyam par brjod/ /srid zhir mi gnas byang chub snying por phyin/ /'dir yang zhi gnas rtse gcig phyed pa gces/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i dgongs pa yin/ /ngang las g.yos na yid dpyod 'khor ba nyid/ /de la rgyu 'bras nyid de la ma zlos/ /nor ba'i skye bo 'og nas 'og tu 'gro/ /des na mchog gsang rdzogs pa chen po ni/ /dbyings las ma g.yos rtsal rnams gzhi la 'khyol/ /dgongs pa mi g.yo mnyam par gnas pa yin/ /'di yi ngang la rgyu 'bras bya rtsol med/ /lta ba bsgom du med pa la sogs te/ /mtha' dbus gnyis med 'gog pa'i tshul brjod kyi/ /gzhan du ngang las phyir 'khyal rtsal nyid las/ /rol pa sna tshogs snang srid dgu 'char bas / /rgyu 'bras med ces nam yang ma brjod cig /rten 'brel rkyen 'byung 'dus byas grangs bsam 'das/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang zhi bde'ang grangs bsam 'das/ /de kun rgyu rkyen tshogs pa'i rten 'brel nyid/ /gshis la gzhal na gang yang ma grub ltar/ /lam du byed pas gshis thog mi g.yo'i dus/ /gang yang mi dmigs dgongs pa'i dus na rtsi/ /gshis thog mthar phyin gang yang gos mi 'gyur / /nyon mongs las dang bag chags klong chen 'di/ /rten med 188

sgyu mas sprul pa'i rtsed mo byed/ /'di las thar dgos rgyu 'bras la zlos 'tshal/ /de yi thabs ni 'di las mchog gzhan med/ /de phyir chos dbyings dbongs pa ma g.yos gces/ /'di nyid kho bo'i snying gtam zab mo'i klong / /kun yin kun min yin min 'das pa gces / /chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod las/ dgongs pa chos nyid las mi g.yo bar bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o/ /thams cad mkha' mnyam byang chub sems gcig la/ /gnyis su bzung bas rgyu 'bras srid par 'khrul/ /'khrul snang rten med sgyu ma'i snang ba la/ /thug phrad rjes med rtsis gdab bral bar skyongs/ /mi 'dod thog tu bab la dor bya'i sems/ /khro dang mi dga' phrag dog 'khrug dang 'tshig /skyo bas yid byung na tsha sdug bsngal sems/ /'chi dang skye bas 'jigs la sogs pa ste/ /rtsal las rol bar shar dus ngos bzung la/ /mi spong mi sbyong mi sgyur mi len zhing / /mi blta mi bsgom rang babs phyam gcig tu/ /dmigs pa'i spro bsdu bral bar lhun gyis zhog /rjes med rang yal mkha' klong dag pa'i sems / /gsal dwangs ngar dang bcas pa khong nas 'char/ /yin min med pa'i rig pa phyogs yan la/ /'dir gtad med pa'i snang ba thug phrad kyis/ /'dir gzung med pa'i ngang der rang bzhag pas / /'dir grol med pa'i dgag sgrub rjes med yal/ /'dzin zhen 189

med pa'i nyams myong khong rdol 'byung / /'di nyid ji bzhin dgongs klong ye nas yangs/ /de bzhin 'dod cing yid la dga' ba'i sems/ /grub bde gnyen dang gtam snyan longs spyod dang / /gnas dang phyogs ni yid du 'ong ba der/ /rang bzhin dga' bas brgyan pa'i sems shar ba/ /de nyid ngos bzung rang babs cog gzhag gis/ /gdod ma'i dbyings su ma bcos lhun gyis grub/ /rang bzhin bar ma 'gro 'dug gyin 'dar gnas/ /dga' dang mi dga' gnyis min ci shar yang / /shar dus ngos gzung spang blang ma byas pas/ /rang babs chos nyid dbye bsal med pa ni/ /gti mug 'od gsal chen por grol zhes bya/ /mtshan mo la sogs gnyid kyis myos pa na'ang / /rang babs spro bsdu bral ba'i ngang nyal bas/ /rags par snang ba nub pas der 'dzin nub/ /phra ba ches phra 'dzin par bcas nub pas/ /phyam mnyam mi rtog ngang du rig pa'i sems//'byung 'jug re dogs bral ba rang bzhin gnas/ /kun rtog chos dbyings grol ba'i dus yin pas/ /'khor ba myang 'das grol zhes brjod pa yin/ /gnyid kyang rang byung gdod ma'i klong chen te/ /rtsal rnams ngo po'i dbyings su gzhi thim pas/ /rol par 'dzin pa'i spros kun ngang gis zhi/ /byar med rang byung ye shes dgongs pa'o / /de ltar 'dod dang mi 'dod bar ma'i sems/ /dug gsum 190

rtsal las rol bar shar to cog /dbyings las byung zhing dbyings kyi ngang du shar/ /dbyings su ma gtogs g.yos pa 'ga' med pas//gzeb dang bcos bsgyur gang yang mi byed par/ /dbyings nyid ngos bzung ngang der gzhag ma thag /rang zhi rang yal rang grol 'gro ba gnad/ /nyon mongs las dang bag chags thams cad kyang //rtsal las rol bar shar ba'i cho 'phrul la/ /gnyen po bzang byas thar ba'i lam nyid kyang / /rtsal las rol bar shar ba'i cho 'phrul te / /gnyis ka rtsal las rol bar ye shar nas/ /ngo shes ngang du ma bcos 'jog pa gnad/ /bang mnyam 'gros mnyam gzhi nas g.yos par mnyam/ /rkyen byung 'dus byas rgyu 'bras ma 'das pas/ /rang gzhag cog gzhag rgyu 'bras zlos pa gces/ /'di ni mchog gsang theg pa'i yang rtse ste/ /blo dman rnams la mi smra shin tu gsang / /sgro skur dbang gis snying po'i bstan pa 'chol/ /sgro 'debs nyid dang dgongs pa log par zhugs/ /gsang sgo 'chol rnams mtha' med ngan 'gror ltung / /de bas rab gsang theg pa rgyal po'i gdung / /skal bzang dam pa rnams la bstan zhing gtad/ /mdor na gang snang yul sems rkyen rnams la/ /gnyen po mi 'jug rtsol bas ma spangs par/ /rang bzhag cog gzhag rang babs rig pa'i gnad/ /bde sdug thams cad rig pa'i 'char tshul la/ /blang dor gnyis su 191

bzung bas srid par 'ching / /gang snang yu la mnyam dbang po'i ngor gsal tsam/ /gang shar sems mnyam dran rig rjes med tsam/ /gnyis ka 'phral mnyam dgag sgrub 'ching ba tsam/ /don la phugs mnyam gzhi med snang ba tsam/ /yul rnams ris mnyam gzhig na rjes med tsam/ /blo rnams ngor mnyam dpyad na nam mkha' tsam/ /yul sems gnyis med bar snang dag pa tsam/ /de ltar sus shes kun tu bzang po'i gdung / /rgyal ba'i sras mchog sa rab rig pa 'dzin / /'di ltar chos rnams yod mnyam med mnyam la/ /snang mnyam stong mnyam bden mnyam rdzun mnyam pas/ /spang gnyen 'bad rtsol 'ching zhen kun thongs la/ /yul med mnyam pa chen por phyam gdol cig /sems med rig pa chen por phyam gdol cig /skyon med dag mnyam chen por phyam gdol cig /chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod las/ rkyen snang mkha' mnyam dag par bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o/ /chos kun byang chub sems su ye grol bas/ /ma grol ba yi chos ni yod ma yin/ /'khor ba ye grol gdod nas dag par grol/ /'das pa ye grol lhun gyis rdzogs par grol/ /snang ba ye grol gzhi rtsa med par grol/ /srid pa ye grol byang chub snying por grol/ /spros pa ye grol mu mtha' med par grol/ /spros med ye grol ma skyes dag par grol/ /192

bde ba ye grol chos nyid phyam du grol/ /sdug bsngal ye grol gzhi mnyam yangs par grol/ /bar ma ye grol mkha' mnyam chos skur grol / /dag pa ye grol dag gzhis stong par grol/ /ma dag ye grol yongs grol chen por grol/ /sa lam ye grol bskyed rdzogs bral bar grol / /lta sgom ye grol spang blang med par grol/ /spyod pa ye grol kun tu bzang por grol/ /'bras bu ye grol re dogs med par grol/ /dam tshig ye grol chos nyid chen por grol/ /bzlas brjod ye grol gleng brjod bral bar grol/ /ting 'dzin ye grol bsam yul med par grol/ /yod med ye grol mtha' las 'das par grol/ /rtag chad ye grol gzhi rtsa med par grol/ /yang dag ye grol dmigs bsam 'das par grol/ /yang dag min grol phyogs bsam 'das par grol/ /las rnams ye grol gos pa med par grol/ /nyon mongs ye grol 'ching grol med par grol/ /bag chags ye grol rten gzhi med par grol/ /rnam smin ye grol myong gzhi med par grol/ /gnyen po ye grol spang bya med par grol/ /spang blang gnyis med mkha' mnyam yangs par grol/ /grol ba ye grol bcings pa med par grol//ma grol ye grol bcing grol med par grol/ /glod pa ye grol glod rgyu med par grol/ /cog gzhag ye grol 'jog rgyu med par grol/ /mdor na snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams dang / /mi snang mi srid 193

chos las 'das so cog /thams cad ye nas dbyings su grol zin pas / /da gzod 'bad pas sus kyang grol mi dgos/ /de la 'bad rtsol byas kyang don med pas/ /ma byed ma byed rtsol zhing sgrub ma byed / /ma blta ma blta yid kyi chos ma lta/ /ma sgoms ma sgoms blo yi chos ma sgoms/ /ma dpyad ma dpyad yul sems rjes ma dpyad/ /ma sgrubs ma sgrubs re dogs 'bras ma sgrubs/ /ma spongs ma spongs nyon mongs las ma spongs/ /ma len ma len yang dag chos ma len/ /ma 'chings ma 'chings rang gi rgyud ma 'chings/ /thams cad phyam log gang la'ang yul med pas/ /khrigs dang chos med dmigs gtad ngos gzung med/ /gzhi log lam log 'bras bu'i chos log pas / /legs nyes shor god rdul tsam dmigs su med/ /phyam phyam phyang chad ye chad snang srid chad/ /'khor 'das ru log dbyings kyi so na med/ /gang yin ci yin 'di yin gtad so med/ /khyed cag ci bya nga ni gang na 'dug /sngar shul da med 'di la sus ci bya/ /ha ha 'di 'dra mtshar re dgod re bro/ /snang srid snod bcud 'khrul pa ru log pas/ /nyin mtshan ye sangs rang sangs nam mkhar sangs/ /zhag dang tshes sangs lo zla bskal pa sangs/ /gcig sangs kun sangs chos dang chos min sangs/ /'khor 'das 'khrul gzhi gdod ma'i dbyings su sangs/ /dbyings zhes tha snyad blo yi chos sangs 194

pas / /gang sgrub ci 'bad da ni ci zhig gnyer/ /'dod blo'i 'khris zad nam mkha' ya mtshan che/ /chos med sprang po'i rang bzhin de 'drar zad/ /sa gzhi rin chen nam mkha' bar snang rdzong / /rten med ye grol dgongs par lhun grub pas/ /srid gsum snod bcud yul med chen por grol/ /phyogs med phyogs su 'dzin pas bcings pa rnams/ /rang bzhin ma shes rang gis rang bslad pas/ /rang la rang rmongs 'khrul pa a re 'khrul/ /'khrul ba med la g.yang sa 'dzin pas 'khrul/ /'khrul dang ma 'khrul byang chub sems kyi klong / /byang chub sems la 'khrul grol ye nas med/ /de las rol bar shar la 'dzin pas bcings/ /'ching grol gnyis dang bral bas yul sems med/ /med la yod par 'dzin pas ma bslu cig /ye sangs rgyas pa sa grol ba'i rig pa de/ /gtad 'dzin chos kyi gzeb tu ma bcings shig /ye nas yul med rnam kun dag pa'i klong / /mkha' mnyam bde chen gzhi rtsa byang chub klong / /de la 'khor ba mi srid gdod ma'i babs/ /thig le nyag gcig grwa zur med pa la / /gcig dang tha dad 'dzin pa 'khrul ba'i sems/ /rang byung ye shes rgyu rkyen med pa la/ /'khor ba'i lam du 'dod pa byang chub gegs / /lhun grub phyogs med mtha' dang bral ba la/ /phyogs lta'i mtha' la zhen pa snyem byed bdud/ /dngos mtshan med pa'i stong pa 195
