sems kyi mtshang bstan pa ni/ sgom chen pho mo la las sems ngo shes rgyu ma red bsam nas sdug te mchi ma shar shar 'bab nas 'ong ste/ sdug mi dgos/ mi shes rgyu ci yang med/ sems ngo shes rgyu ma red bsam mkhan kho rang gi thog tu zhog dang de rang yin/ sgom chen la las sems ngo bsrung ba la dka' mo gda' zer te/ dka' mo ci yang med/ sgom mi shes pa'i skyon yin/ sgom btsal ni mi dgos / nyo ni mi dgos/ bsgrub ni mi dgos/ 'gro ni mi dgos/ las ni mi dbos/ rang gi sems la gang byung gang shar ngang du bzhag pas chog /rang gi sems ni ye nas rang la yod/ bor rgyu/ rnyed rgyu/yod rgyu/ med rgyu ni ci yang med/ ye nas yod pa'i sems 'di ni dran dus dran mi dran dus mi dran 'dug 'dug mi 'di ni rang yin / sems kho rang ci dran byung na yang / ci byung thog tu ma bcos par lhod de ma yengs par skyong dang chog /bde mo sla mo shugs la 'ong ba yin/ chos la dka' snang byung na rang sdig sgrib che ba'i rtags yin/ sgom chen la las dgos pa'i sems rang thog tu mi bzhag nas/ mi dgos pa'i sems kyis phar blta tshur nyug mang po byed pa gda' ste/ phar blta tshur nyug byas pas sems mi rig mi rnyed don ma go ba'i skyon yin/ phar lta tshur nyug ci mi dgos phar lta tshur nyug byed mi sems kho rang thog tu zhog dang de rang yin/463

sgom chen la las sems dran na dran/ mi dran na mi dran pa'i thog tu ma bzhag nas log gcig nas yong bsams nas/ phar btsal tshur nyug byed pa gda' ste/ phar btsal tshur nyug byas pas sems ngo mi shes mi rtogs/ phar btsal tshur nyug byed mi dgos/ sems dran na dran ma dran na ma dran thog tu zhog dang de rang yin/ sgom chen la las rang gi sems stong pa nyid la/ rang sems yid ma ches nas / i yin mi yin bsam nas the tshom byed pa yang gda' ste/ de yis don ma go ba'i skyon yin/ the tshom byed mi dgos/ rang sems ye nas stong pa yin pas/ stong pa'i ngang du zhog dang de rang yin/the tshom byung na the tshom kho rang thog tu zhog dang de rang yin/ sgom chen la las dran mkhan sems la mi blta bar/ dran pa'i yul rgyu zog sa rdo rnams la blta mi yang mang po gda' ste/ de ni yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin/ gnyis 'dzin gyi lta ba yin/ dran mkhan kho rang thog tu zhog la ltos/ sgom chen la las snang sems dbyer med du mi bzhag nas/ snang ba rang 'ded cing 'gro mi yang gda' ste/ de ni yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin/ gnyis snang gi lta ba yin/ snang ba phar la ma ded/ dngos po tshur la ma bkug snang sems dbyer med du zhog /sgom chen la las sems rang sar mi bzhag nas/ byi las byi ba sgug pa ltar/ rnam rtog ci byung blta 'dug mi yang gda' ste/ de 464

ni yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin/ dran pa sngon bsu yin/ rnam rtog byung na byung ma byung na ma byung thog tu zhog /sgom chen la las sems rang thog tu bzhag ma shes nas/ snga ma dran pa'i rjes su lta zhing 'gro mi yang gda' ste/ de ni yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin/ dran pa'i rjes gcod yin/ dran pa'i rjes mi bcod par gcod mkhan kho rang thog tu zhog /sgom chen la las sems ci gnas gang shar thog tu mi bzhag nas/ sgom bzang po zhig 'dod nas sems gan bcar mdun tshug hrig hrig mang po byed pa yang gda' ste/ de ni yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin/ sems bcos ma yin/ sems bzo bcos gang yang mi byed pa rang gnas ci byung gang shar ngang du zhog /sgom chen la las gang dran mi bcug par shed phyung nas sems bzung 'dug mi yang gda' ste/ de ni yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin / sems bkag pa yin/ sems gnas na gnas thog zhog /'gyu na 'gyu thog zhog /sgom chen la las khyad gsod ltar sems hang hang byed 'dug pa gda' ste/ de ni yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin/sems hang ltas yin / stong pa'i ngang du gsal lhang nger zhog /sgom chen la las sems nyid 'di stong pa yin bsam nas sgom pa yang gda' ste/ de ni yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin/ stong pa bzo sgom yin/stong pa nyid yin bsam mkhan thog tu zhog /sgom chen la las bde 465

shig ge stong sang sang gsal hrig hrig byung dus blta/ rtsub zin zin / na kha kha/ stong 'phyang 'phyang / lta rgyu med pa de 'dra byung dus mi blta mkhan yang gda' ste/ de ni yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin/spang blang yin/ spang blang gang yang ma byed par gang byung thog tu zhig /sgom chen la las bzang po dran byung dus blta/ ngan pa btsog po dran byung dus mi blta mkhan yang gda' ste/ de ni yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin/ bzang blta ngan bskyur yin/ bzang blta ngan bskyur ma byed par/ bzang ngan gang dran byung na yang / de yi thog tu ma yengs par zhog /sgom chen la las sems bde mo byung na dga'/rnam rtog rgod po byung na rang gi sems la zhe sdang byed pa yang gda' ste/ de ni yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin/ gang shar gyi ngo bo skyong ma shes pa'i skyon yin/ rnam rtog rgod po byung dus sems glod glod ngang nas rgod po kho rang gi thog tu zhog /sgom chen la las dgos mi dgos med par sgrim lhod gang yang mi byed pa gda' ste/ de ni yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin/ bcos ma cung zad rdzog 'gro ba yin/sems gnas ma shes pa'i skyon yin/ dgos pa'i dus sgrim lhod gyis / mi dgos pa'i dus su sgrim lhod mi bya bar rang babs su gsal lhang nger zhog /sgom chen la las zas skom zhim mngar gyi ro dran dus su sgom mi tshug nas/ yar langs nas zas skom zhim 466

mngar can zhig i thob mi thob byed nas zas skom zhim mngar la longs spyod pa gda' ste/ de 'dra byas na bsam gtan 'tsho ba za ba'i sgom chen legs po zhig mi 'ong / kha zhim sto skyid kyis sgom chen sdug bred can gcig 'ong / de phyir zas skom zhim mngar gyi ro la ma chags par bsam gtan gyi 'tsho ba za dgos pa yin/ sgom chen la las skyid rgyag longs spyod che bstod de 'dra byung dus sgom byed mi tshug pa dga' dga' skyid skyid cher byed/ sdug bsngal rkyen ngan na tsha smad bsha' kha mchu de 'dra byung dus sgom byed mi thub nas kha ngo sprin nag ltar bsdus nas kha yis sdug rab bshad mig nas mchi ma btang mkhan yang gda' ste/ de 'dra byas na dga' sdug ro snyoms thub pa'i chos pa legs po zhig mi 'ong / dga' sdug chos brgyad kyi dbang du shor ba'i chos med tha mal sdug bred gcig 'ong ba yin/ de'i phyir dga' sdug gang yang ro snyoms nas lam khyer dgos pa yin/sems kyi rnam thar bshad pa ni/ e ma hoḥ sems nyid ye nas dngos po med/ /bltas pas mi mthong stong par 'gyur/ /stong pa ma yin rig cing gsal/ /rig stong dbyer med mkha' ltar khyab/ /bzhag kyang gtad med zang thal 'gro/ /ma bzhag btang yang rang sar 'khor/ /rkang lag med kyang kun tu rgyug /btang yang mi 'gro 467

rang sar 'khor/ /mig ni med kyang thams cad rig /rig pa'i snang ba stong par 'gro/ /sems kyi ngo bo 'di zhes med/ /med kyang dran rig sna tshogs 'char/ /yod pa ma yin stong par 'gro/ /med pa ma yin dran rig snang / /snang stong zung 'jug 'od zer 'bar/ /stong gsal chos sku rang mdangs gsal/ /ye shes lnga ldan rab tu rgyas/ /ka dag gnas lugs lhun grub dang / /sku dang zhing khams 'gag med 'char/ /'od gsal ma bu gcig tu 'dres/ /sems kyi gnas lugs de 'dra ba/ /rtogs par 'dug gam rtogs ldan rnams/ /shes par 'dug gam sgom chen rnams/ /nyams len mdzod cig rnal 'byor rnams/ /'khrul ba rang grol gyi gdams ngag gis/ /dug sman du bsgyur ba lta bu ni/ /stong pa nyid la ser sna med/ /'khrul ba'i dbang gis ser sna lang / /mi 'khrul ser sna lang mkhan ltos/ /ltos shig skyongs dang ma yengs dang / /ser sna sangs nas stong par 'gyur/ /stong pa'i ngang du ma yengs zhog /de ni ser sna rnam dag yin/ /sbyin pa de bas gong na med/ /de rtogs rnal 'byor e ma ho/ /stong pa nyid la chags zhen med/ /'khrul ba'i dbang gis chags zhen lang / /ma 'khrul chags zhen lang mkhan ltos/ /ltos shig skyongs la ma yengs dang / /chags zhen sangs nas stong par 'gyur/ /stong nyid ngang du 468

ma yengs zhog /de ni chags zhen rnams dag yin/ /tshul khrims de bas gong na med/ /de rtogs rnal 'byor e ma ho/ /stong pa nyid la khong khro med/ /'khrul pa'i dbang gis khong khro lang / /ma 'khrul khong khro lang mkhan ltos/ /ltos shig skyongs la ma yengs dang / /khong khro sangs nas stong par 'gyur/ /stong nyid ngang du ma yengs zhog /de ni khong khro rnam dag yin/ /bzod pa de bas gong na med/ /de rtogs rnal 'byor e ma ho/ /stong pa nyid la le lo med/ /'khrul pa'i dbang bis le lo 'byung / ma 'khrul le lo 'byung mkhan ltos/ /ltos shig skyongs la ma yengs dang / /le lo sangs nas stong nyid 'gyur/ /stong nyid ngang du ma yengs zhog /de ni le lo rnam dag yid/ /brtson 'grus de bas gong na med/ /de rtogs rnal 'byor e ma ho/ /stong pa nyid la/ g.yeng ba med/ /'khrul ba'i dbang gis g.yeng ba 'byung / /ma 'khrul g.yeng ba 'byung mkhan ltos/ /ltos shig skyongs la ma yengs dang / g.yeng ba sangs nas stong nyid 'gyur/ /stong nyid ngang la ma yengs zhog /de ni rnam g.yeng rnam dag yin/ /bsam gtan de bas gong na med/ /de rtogs rnal 'byor e ma ho/ /stong pa nyid la gti mug med/ /'khrul ba'i dbang gis gti mug lang / /ma 'khrul gti mug 'byung mkhan ltos/ /ltos shig skyongs la ma yengs dang / /gti mug sangs nas stong nyid 'gyur/ /stong nyid ngang du ma 469

yengs zhog /de ni gti mug rnam dag yin/ /shes rab de bas gong na med/ /de rtogs rnal 'byor e ma ho/ /stong pa nyid la rloms sems med/ /'khrul pa'i dbang gis rloms sems lang / /ma 'khrul rloms sems ngo bo ltos/ /ltos shig skyongs la ma yengs dang / /rloms sems sangs nas stong nyid 'gyur/ /stong nyid ngang du ma yengs zhog /de ni rloms sems rnam dag yin/ /chog shes de bas gong na med/ /de rtogs rnal 'byor e ma ho/ /nyon mongs rang grol gyi man ngag ni/ nyon mongs ye shes su bsgyur bas na/ yengs med ngang la sdug bsngal med/ /'khrul pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal 'byung / /ma yengs sdug bsngal ngo bo ltos/ /ltos shig ma yengs skyongs mdzod la/ /sdug bsngal med nas stong par 'gyur/ /stong gsal ngang du ma yengs zhog /de ni sdug bsngal rnam dag yin/ /bde chen chos sku de la zer/ /yengs med ngang la nyon mongs med/ /yengs pa'i skyon gyis nyon mongs lang / /ma yengs nyon mongs ngo bo ltos/ /ltos shig bsgom la ma yengs dang / /nyon mongs de ni stong par 'gro/ /stong pa'i ngang du ma yengs zhog /de ni nyon mongs rnam dag yin/ /skye med chos sku de la zer/ /yengs med ngang la zhe sdang med/ /yengs pa'i skyon gyis zhe sdang lang / /ma yengs zhe sdang ngo bo ltos/ /ltos shig bsgom la ma yengs dang / /zhe 470

sdang med nas stong par 'gro/ /stong gsal ngang la ma yengs zhog /de ni zhe sdang rnam dag yin/ /me long ye shes de la zer/ /yengs med ngang la nga rgyal med/ /yengs pa'i skyon gyis nga rgyal lang / /ma yengs nga rgyal ngo bo ltos/ /ltos shig bsgom la ma yengs dang / /nga rgyal med nas stong gsal 'gro/ /stong gsal ngang du ma yengs zhog /de ni nga rgyal rnam dag yin/ /mnyam nyid ye shes de la zer/ /yengs med ngang la 'dod chags med/ /yengs pa'i skyon gyis 'dod chags lang / /ma yengs 'dod chags ngo bo ltos/ /ltos shig bsgom la ma yengs dang / /'dod chags med nas stong gsal 'gro/ /stong gsal ngang du ma yengs zhog /de ni 'dod chags rnam dag yin/ /sor rtog ye shes de la zer/ /yengs med ngang la phrag dog med/ /yengs pa'i skyon gyis phrag dog lang / /ma yengs phrag dog ngo bo ltos / /ltos shig bsgom la ma yengs dang / /phrag dog med nas stong gsal 'gro/ /stong gsal ngang la ma yengs zhog /de ni phrag dog rnam dag yin/ /bya grub ye shes de la zer/ /yengs med ngang la gti mug med/ /yengs pa'i skyon gyis gti mug lang / /ma yengs gti mug ngo bo ltos/ /ltos shig bsgom la ma yengs dang / /gti mug med nas stong gsal 'gro/ /stong gsal ngang du ma yengs zhog /de ni gti mug rnam dag yin/ /chos dbyings ye shes de la zer/ /yengs 471

med ngang la bying rmug med/ /yengs pa'i skyon gyis bying rmug 'thib//ma yengs bying rmug ngo bo ltos/ /ltos shig bsgom la ma yengs dang / /bying rmug med nas stong gsal 'gro/ /stong gsal ngang la ma yengs zhog /de ni bying rmug rnam dag yin/ /stong gsal ye shes de la zer//yengs med ngang la 'thor rgod med/ /yengs pa'i skyon gyis 'thor rgod long / /ma yengs 'thor rgod ngo bo ltos/ /ltos shig bsgo ma la ma yengs dang / /'thor rgod med nas stong gsal 'gro/ /stong gsal ngang du ma yengs zhog /de ni 'thor rgod rnam dag yin/ /'gyur med ye shes de la zer/ /yengs med ngang du dug gsum med/ /yengs pa'i skyon gyis dug gsum long / /ma yengs dug gsum ngo bo ltos / /ltos shig bsgom la ma yengs dang / /dug gsum med nas stong gsal 'gro/ /stong gsal ngang du ma yengs zhog /de ni dug gsum rnam dag yin/ /sku gsum ye shes de la zer/ /nges shes bskyed pa'i don du sems kyi 'ong lugs bshad pa/sgom chen gyi sems la thang re ci yang mi bsam pa stong hong nge 'dug pa 'ong / de 'dra byung dus bcas bcos mi byed par rang thog tu lhang nger zhog /thang re gsal lhang nge bde 'bol le 'dug pa'i dus 'ong / /de 'dra byung dus sems de gsal lhang nger zhog /thang re sems de nag tham tham stong hang hang gsal mi thub pa'i 472

dus 'ong / de 'dra byung dus rig pa gsal gyis bton la rjen hu rer zhog /thang re sems la sdug lhang gis 'ong / de 'dra byung dus spro seng nge glod shig ge dga' ya le sdod/ thang re yud tsam yud tsam 'dug cing yun ring mi 'dug pa zha bi zhi bi dran 'gro ba 'ong / de 'dra byung dus sems kha bsgrim la khong lhod la zhog /thang re sems rig tsam mi rig tsam de 'dra 'ong / de 'dra byung dus sems mar log nang nas spu bton pa ltar gsal hrig gis phyung nas ma yengs pa hu rer zhog /thang re mi dran dgu dran byed nas yar 'phyong mar 'phyong byed cing yud tsam 'dug mi thub pa yang 'ong —/ de 'dra byung dus lus lhod sems lhod kyi ngang nas yengs ma shor bar phyogs 'tsho phyogs skyos gyis la zhog /thang re bsgom snying mi 'dod pa snying na ba 'dug mi tshugs pa de 'dra yang 'ong de 'dra byung dus bla ma la gsol ba lhang lhang btab cing snang ba bde lhang nger skyid lhang nger zhog /thang re bde bde lhan lhan gsal ba dang / dga' lhag lhag bro 'khrab 'dod pa yang 'ong / de 'dra byung dus rang sems la 'dzin pa ma zhugs par lhod me rer sdod/sems kyi 'ong lugs de rnams ni/ las dang po pa gnas lugs gtan la ma 'bebs pa'i dus 'ong ba yin/ gtan la 'bebs thub pa rnams la de 'dra 'ong rgyu med/ de yang zur tsam 473

bshad par bya ste/ gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs pa'i dus/ /lta yang mi dgos 'od gsal rang bzhin 'char/ /bsgom yang mi dgos sems nyid rang sa zin/ /yengs kyang mi yengs sems nyid rang tshod bzung / /'gyur yang mi 'gyur dran rig mkha' ltar khyab//bcas bcos mi dgos 'od gsal ngang la gnas/ /rang sems yengs med chos sku dang / /sangs rgyas dgongs pa'i chos sku dang / /dbyer med 'od gsal ngang nas 'dres/ /yengs med rang sa zin nas kyang / /stong nyid chos sku'i ngang nyid las/ /lhun grub 'od gsal shar ba'i dus/ /rang sems sangs rgyas dbyer mi 'byed/ /sku dang zhing khams 'bral med 'byung / /re dogs bdag 'dzin dga' sdug med/ /spang blang the tshom sna tshogs bral/ /sems nyid gtan la phabs na de ltar 'byung / /spyod lam rnam bzhi khyer tshul ni/ sgom chen 'gro ba'i dus su ni / /smyo 'phyong rgyug 'phyong mi byed par/ /lus sems dal ba'i ngang nyid las/ /rang sems g.yel med srung bzhin 'gro/ /sgom chen 'dug pa'i dus su ni/ /bsam blo bgrang phreng mi btang bar/ /lus gnad drang por bsrang nas kyang / /rang sems gcer bur phud nas sdod/ /sgom chen nyal ba'i dus su ni/ /gti mug ro bzhin mi nyal bar/ /seng ge nyal stabs byed nas nyal/ /yengs med 'od 474

gsal ngang du bsre/ /sgom chen bza' btung za ba'i dus/ /gza' btung bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs/ /rang lus mkha' 'gro'i (zhi khro'i)lha tshogs bsgom/ /sems nyid yengs med ngang la bza'/ /'gro 'dug nyal ba ci byed kyang / /stong nyid dbyer med ngang nas gyis/ /rang sems sangs rgyas dbyer med pa/ /'chi kha mi 'gyod pa zhig 'dod na/ 'di lta bu zhig nyams len dgos pa yin/mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma bsten shes dgos/ /'jig rten spros dang bral ba'i bya btang zhig ni dgos/ /gcig pur ri khrod thub pa'i sdug bsran zhig ni dgos/ /zas gos zhen pa bcad pa'i bka' spyad zhig ni dgos/ /skad cig yengs pa med pa'i brtson 'grus zhig ni dgos/ci/gang yang gnyis snang med pa'i lta ba zhig ni dgos / /yengs med 'od gsal khor yug bsgom pa zhig ni dgos/ /bya rtsol spang blang bral ba'i spyod pa zhig ni dgos/ /rang sems sangs rgyas dbyer med 'bras bu zhig ni dgos/ /chags 'dzin ngos lkog med pa'i dam tshig zhig ni dgos/ /kun la 'dod pa'i rloms sems med pa zhig ni dgos/ /dgos rab nyams len mdzod cig skal ldan chos mdzad rnams/yang bsgom gyi grogs go cha bzang po zhig 'dod na 'di ltar mdzod / g.yog 'khor mang po'i dpon po byed pa spang / /rgyu zog 475

mang po'i bdag po byed pa spang / /rta nor mang po'i 'tsho skyong byed pa spang / /nye ba mang po'i mgo 'dren byed pa spang / /dgra gnyen gnyis la chags sdang byed pa spang / /las dka' so nam bzo rigs byed pa spang / /longs spyod khe grags 'tsho skyong byed pa spang / /che thabs grags thabs mi thabs byed pa spang / /de rnams ma spang sems nyid g.yeng bas khyer/ /de rnams spang na sems nyid btsan sa zin/ /sems nyid btsan sa zin na sangs rgyas dngos/ /deng sang dus kyi gnas skabs la/ /bla ma slob mkhas slob ma bsgom mkhas kyis/ /rang sems 'di ni rtogs mi mang po gda'/ /yang dag don ni rtogs mi mang po gda'/ /sems nyid stong gsal ngo bo ni / /mi gcig la 'char rgyu kun la 'char/ de shes mi kun la dris dang gsal ba yin/ mkhas pa mang por dris dang shes nas 'ong /the tshom med par gyis la bsgom/yang sgom chen la zhal gdams gnad che ba zhig yod de bshad par bya/ deng sang dus kyi gnas skabs la/ /bla ma slob ma la la yis / /bla mas slob nyes slob mas bsgom nyes kyis/ /mi lo bdun cu brgyad cu bsgom na yang / /nyams rtogs ma skyes mi'ang mang po gda' / /yang dag don ni ma rtogs mang po gda'/ /min pa yin snang byed mi mang po gda'/ /mi shes blun sgom byed pa mang po 476

gda' / /don med brtson 'grus byed pa mang po gda'/ /bla ma slob mkhas slob ma bsgo ma mkhas kyis/ /rang che ma byed mkhas pa rnams la dris/ /rang bzo ma byed rang sems phu thag chod/ /rang mgo ma bskor the tshom med par mdzod/ /rdzogs so/ /slar smras pa/ a ho/ rang sems gzhi yi gnas lugs spros bral las / /lta ba/ 'gag med thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bzhengs/ /sgom sna tshogs khro bo khro mo'i zlos gar bsgyur/ /spyod pa/mkha' khyab 'gro kun 'dren pa'i dpal du shog/ //477
rdza /goske'i loliṅgatswatswa——————— dzigos kher

༄༅/ /rtogs ldan rgan po rnams kyi lugs sems ngo mdzub tshugs kyi gdams pa mun sel sgron me bzhugs so/ /bla ma dang 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thos bsam sbyong ba rgya chen mi dgos par/ /man ngag lugs kyis sems ngo skyong ba yi/ /grong sngags phal mo che zhig tshegs chung dus/ /rig 'dzin sa la gshegs te lam zab mthu/ /de yang rang gi sems 'di rang babs su ci yang mi bsam par bzhag nas de yi ngang du dran pa'i rgyun bskyang ba de yi tshe/ btang snyoms lung ma bstan gyi shes pa mun ne thom me ba zhig 'byung / de la 'di shes de shes kyi lhag mthong gang yang ma skyes pa'i tshe na de'i cha nas bla ma dag ma rig par ming 'dogs par 'dug /de la 'di 'dra 'di yin gyi nges bzung smra ma shes pa'i cha nas lung ma bstan zhes ming btags/ci la gnas dang ci bsam pa smrar med pas tha mal btang snyoms zhes btags te/ yin ni kun gzhi'i ngang du tha mal rang gar bsdad pa yin/ bzhag thabs de 'dra ba la brten nas mi rtog ye shes bskyed dgos kyang / rang ngo rig pa'i ye shes ma shar ba de 'dra sgom gyi dngos gzhi ma yin te/ kun smon las/ ci yang dran 479

med thom me ba/ /de ka ma rig 'khrul ba'i rgyu/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de ltar ci yang ma dran ma 'byung ba'i shes pa thom me ba de 'dra sems kyis myong bas na/ de 'dra'i don shes mkhan dang mi bsam par 'dug mkhan kho rang la bab kyis bltas pas/ 'gyu dran bral ba'i rig pa phyi nang med par zang thal le ba nam mkha' dwangs pa lta bu myong bya myong byed gnyis med kyang rang gi rang bzhin rang gis kho thag chod nas 'di las gzhan ci yang mi 'dug snyam pa byung na/ de la bsam brjod kyis 'di 'dra zhes smrar med pas mtha' bral dang brjod bral dang gnyug ma'i 'od gsal dang rig pa zhes btags chog ste/ rang ngo 'phrod pa'i ye shes shar bas dmu thom me ba'i mun pa dwangs te nam langs pas khyim nang mthong ba ltar rang gi sems kyi chos nyid la nges shes skyes pas so 'di la ma rig sgo nga'i sbub 'byed pa'i man ngag ces bya'o/ /de ltar rtogs tshe chos nyid de lta bu ni rang bzhin bab kyis ye nas gnas pas rgyu rkyen gyis 'dus ma byas pa dang / dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa yin par shes shing / de las gzhan du gyur pa'i sems zhes bya ba rdul tsam yang yod par mi dmigs so/ /snga ma mun thom me ba de la brjod du med kyang / ci yang brjod ma shes pas kho thag ma chod pa yin la/ rang ngo la brjod du med kyang brjod med kyi don 480

la the tshom med pa'i kho thag chod pas/ mig med dang mig ldan ltar 'di gnyis kyi brjod du med tshul khyad che bas/ kun gzhi dang chos sku'i dbye ba yang 'dir gnad 'dus so/ /des na tha mal gyi shes pa zhes pa dang / yid la mi byed pa dang / brjod bral sogs la yang dag yin min gnyis yod pas sgra mthun don 'phags kyi gnad nges par byas na zab mo'i chos kyi dgongs nyams rnyed par 'gyur ro / /sems ngo'i ngang du rang bab bzhag tshe kha cig gis gsal tsam rig tsam skyong rgyur byas te yid shes kyis gsal lo snyam pa'i ngang du 'jog /kha cig gis stong cham me ba shes pa stong song ba lta bu la sems 'dzin kyang / 'di gnyis ka yid shes kyi cha gzung 'dzin gyi nyams la zhen pa tsam yin pas/ de'i tshe gsal ba dang gsal bar 'dzin mkhan/ stong pa dang stong par 'dzin mkhan gyi shes pa dran 'dzin gyi rgyun breng nge ba de'i bab la bltas pas/ gzung 'dzin du zhen pa'i rnam shes kyi rten phur phyungs te rjen ne ye re ba gsal stong mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i rang bab kho thag chod de dwangs seng nge ba byung na de la rig ngo zhes ming 'dogs te/ 'dzin pa can gyi nyams kyi shun pa dang bral ba'i rig pa ye shes rjen par — shar ba yin no/ /'di la srid pa'i drwa ba gcod pa'i man ngag ces bya'o / /de bzhin du yid dpyod nyams kyi sbun pa sna tshogs dang bral 481

ba'i rig pa 'bras sne'u lta bu chos nyid kyi rang bab rang gsal gyi sgo nas ngos zin par bya'o/ /rig pa'i bab ngo shes pa tsam gyis mi chog par de ga'i ngang du goms pa'i gnas cha brtan dbos pas/shes pa rang bab bzhag pa'i dran rgyun ma yengs par skyong ba gal che / de ltar skyong dus res ci yin med pa'i mi rtog rmun po/ res lhag mthong gi dwangs cha mi thon pa'i mi rtog zang thal res bde nyams zhen pa can/ res bde nyams zhen med/ res sna tshogs gsal nyams 'dzin pa can/ res dwangs gsal rnyogs med 'dzin bral / res rtsub nyams mi sdug pa/ res 'jam nyams yid 'ong /res rnam rtog ches 'tshub che ba'i phyir 'brangs nas sgom stor ba/res 'thib dwangs mi phyed pas rtogs ma can sogs/ thog med nas goms pa'i rnam rtog dang las rlung gi rba rlabs sna tshogs nges pa dang tshad bzung med par 'byung ba ni/ lam ring por zhugs pa'i bde gzar sna tshogs kyi gnas mthong ba dang 'dra bas gang shar ched 'dzin med par rang lam bskyang / lhag par ma goms pa'i dus na rnam rtog sna tshogs me ltar 'bar ba g.yo ba'i nyams kyi dus su des ma sun par byas te/ sgrim lhod ran pos rgyun ma btang bar bskyang bas thob pa sogs nyams phyi ma dag rim bzhin 'byung ngo / /'di dus spyir rig pa dang ma rig pa/ kun gzhi dang 482

chos sku/ rnam shes dang ye shes kyi khyad par bla ma'i man ngas gis nyams myong gi steng nas ngo 'phrod pa gdeng du byas nas/ skyong dus chu ma bsgul na dwangs pa ltar/ rnam shes rang sar bzhag pas de'i chos nyid ye shes rang byung du gsal ba'i man ngag gtso bor bya dgos kyi/ bdag gi sgom rgyu 'di rnam shes sa ma ye shes gang yin zhes spang blang gi dpyad ra dang dpe cha'i go rtog gi 'du 'phro spel bar mi bya ste/ des zhi lhag gnyis ka cung zad sgrib par 'gyur ro/ /rang bab 'jog pa'i dran pa'i rgyun brtan pa'i zhi gnas kyi goms cha dang / rang ngo rang gsal du shes pa'i lhag mthong rang shugs kyis 'brel ba'i tshul du goms pa brtan por song ba na/ rang bab ye gnas dang / rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi zhi lhag ye nas dbyer med pa rang byung gi ye shes rdzogs pa chen po'i dgongs pa 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ni mkha' ltar mnyam pa nyid la gnas pa'i man ngag go/ /de ltar yang dpal sa ra has/ bsam dang bsam bya rab tu spangs nas su/ /bsam med bu chung tshul du gnas bya zhing / /zhes bzhag thabs dang / bla ma'i lung la bsgrims te rab 'bad na//zhes rig pa ngo sprad pa'i man ngag dang ldan par byas na/ lhan cig skyes pa 'byung bar the tshom med/ /ces gdod nas rang gi sems dang lhan cig skyes pa sems kyi chos nyid rig pa rang byung gi ye 483

shes 'byung ste/ de ni chos kun gyi chos nyid dang tha dad med pa gzhug ma don gyi 'od gsal kyang yin no/ /des na rang bab bzhag pa dang / rang ngo shes pa'i rig pa'am sems kyi ngo po'am chos nyid skyong tshul 'di gnad brgya gcig 'dus kyi man ngag yin/ rgyun du skyong rgyu'ang de yin/ goms pa'i tshad ni mtshan mo'i 'od gsal gyis 'dzin/ yang dag pa'i lam yin pa'i rtags ni dad pa dang snying rje shes rab sogs rang shugs kyis 'phel bas rtogs/ bde zhing tshegs chung ba ni rang gi nyams su myong bas shes/ zab cing myur ba ni shin tu 'bad rtsol chen pos bsgrubs pa'i lam gzhan la zhugs pa rnams dang rtogs tshad bstun pas nges pa yin no/ /rang sems 'od gsal bsgoms pas 'bras bu thob rgyu'ang de'i steng gi rnam rtog dang de'i bag chags kyi sgrib pa rang sangs tshe/ mkhyen gnyis rtsol med du rgyas nas gdod ma'i gtan srid zin te sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa yin no/ /zab po/ /gu rgyaḥ sa ma yaḥ rab tshes me rta zla 2tshes 18la thos bsam la cher mi brtson kyang sems ngo'i nyams len 'dod pa'i grong sngags pa sogs kyi ched du/rtogs ldan rgan po phal gyi nyams myong dmar khrid kyi chos skad go bde dang bstun pa'i gdams pa zab mo mi pham 'jam dpal rdo rjes bkod pa dge'o/ /maṅga lo/ /484
skya dkaratshog lo ces/—

༄༅/ /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i khregs chod lta ba'i glu dbyangs sa lam ma lus myur du bgrod pa'i rtsal ldan mkha' lding gshog rlabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ kun gsal mkhyen brtse'i rta bdun dkyil 'khor las / /tshad med thugs rje'i 'od zer rab spros nas/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa kun/ /dus gcig sel mdzad chos kyi rgyal por 'dud/ /stong gsal chos sku'i lha lam yangs pa'i ngos/ /byams dang brtse ba'i chu 'dzin rab 'khrigs nas/ /skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya'i 'dzin ma la/ /chos char 'bebs mkhas sngags 'chang rdo rjer 'dud/ /lta ba'i gru dbus lhag bsam dar chen 'phyar/ /brtson 'grus rlung gis bskyod nas srid 'tsho ru/ /byings pa'i 'gro rnams sku gsum nor bu'i gling / /'god mdzad ded dpon 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshor 'dud/ /de gsum mkhyen brtse rta bdun dkyil 'khor las/ /'phros pa'i byin rlabs nus mthu'i tsha ba'i zer/ /skal ldan bya btang pad dkar bdag la rdzog /rig pa'i kha phye nyams rtogs 'dab stong bzhad/ /bdag blo'i ge sar sto bar legs 485

'khyil ba'i/ /lta ba'i glu dbyangs myong grol bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /skal ldan slob ma rkang drug tshogs la 'bul/ /ngoms pa med par gus pa'i yid kyis rol/ /myu/e ma ho/ bya btang gu yangs yan pa blo bde ngas/ /sa lam ma lus myur du bgrod byed pa'i/ /lta ba'i glu dbyangs mkha' lding gshog rlabs len/ /skal ldan sems kyi bu rnams lhan der nyon/ /'khor 'das gnyis la 'brug gi sgra bzhin du/ /yongs grags sangs rgyas zer ba'i sgra bo che/ /'gro drug sems can rgyud la rtag bzhugs nas/ /skad cig tsam yang g.yel med 'grogs 'di mtshar / /sangs rgyas rang la yod par ma shes par/ /phyi rol gzhan du sangs rgyas btsal ba mtshar/ /gsal dwangs nyi ma'i snying po ji bzhin du/ /mngon sum gsal kyang mthong mkhan nyung ba mtshar/ /pha ma med pa'i rang sems sangs rgyas nyid/ /skye ma myong zhing 'chi rgyu med pa mtshar/ /bde sdug sna tshogs ji ltar myong na yang / /bzang dang ngan du cung zad mi 'gro mtshar/ /ma skyes gdod nas dag pa'i sems nyid 'di/ /ma bcos ye nas lhun gyis grub pa mtshar rang bzhin ye nas grol ba'i rang rig nyid/ /gang byung gang bder bzhag pas grol ba mtshar/ / |e ma ho/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams ma yengs nyon/ /dus 486

gsum rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyis/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs pa'i/ /gsung rab nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam dpag med kyang / /don la rang sems rtogs phyir gsungs pa las/ /gzhan du ci yang rgyal bas gsungs pa med/ /dper na sdong po'i rtsa ba gcig bcad na/ /yal ga lo ma khri 'bum dus gcig skam/ /de bzhin sems kyi rtsa ba gcig bcad na/ /gzung 'dzin la sogs 'khor ba'i lo 'dab skam/ /khang stong mun pa lo stong lon pa yang / /sgron mes skad cig nyid la sel ba bzhin/ /rang sems 'od gsal rtogs pa'i skad cig la/ /bskal pa grangs med bsags pa'i sdig sgrib 'dags/ /gsal dwangs nyi ma'i snying po'i rang bzhin de/ /bskal pa stong gi mun pas sgrib mi nus/ /de bzhin rang sems snying po'i 'od gsal de/ /bskal par 'khrul pas sgrib par mi nus so/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin mdog dbyibs tshad las 'das/ /dkar nag sprin gyis gos par mi 'gyur ltar/ /sems kyi rang bzhin mdog dbyibs tshad las 'das/ /dge sdig dkar nag chos kyis gos mi 'gyur/ /dper na 'o ma mar gyi rgyu yin kyang / /ma skyog bar du mar ni mi 'byung ltar/ /'gro kun bder gshegs snying po'i rgyu yin kyang / /nyams su ma blangs sems can sangs ma rgyas/ /'di nyid nyams su blangs na kun grol te/ /dbang po rnams la rno rtul 487

khyad par med/ /nyams su blangs na ba glang rdzi yang grol/ /mngon sum rang sems 'od gsal don rtogs na/ /kha bshad mkhas pa 'di la mi dgos te/ /bu ram rang gi kha ru zos pa'i tshe/ /bu ram ro bshad mi dgos ji bzhin no/ /'di nyid ma rtogs paṇ+ḍi ta yang 'khrul / /theg dgu'i bshad pa yongs la mkhas gyur kyang / /ma mthong rgyang gi gtam rgyud bshad pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas sa la gnam sa bas kyang ring / /yang dag rang sems 'od gsal ma rtogs na/ /bskal pa'i bar du tshul khrims bsrungs pa dang / /yu na ring bar du bzod pa bsgoms byas kyang / /khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas nas mi 'phags pas/ /de'i phyir 'bad pas sems kyi rtsad gcod gyis/ / 1e ma ho/ da yang skal ldan bu mchog kun gyis nyon/ /rang gi sems kyi rtsa brdar ma chod na/ /dge sbyor gang byas gnad du mi 'gro ste/ /dper na 'ben ni drung du bzhag nas kyang / /mda' ni thag ring phyogs su 'phen dang mtshungs/ /rkun ma rang gi khyim du bzhag nas kyang / /rtsad gcod drag po phyi ru byed dang mtshungs/ /'dre ni shar sgo'i phyogs su bzhag nas kyang / /glud ni nub kyi phyogs su gtong dang mtshungs/ /dbul po'i snyed rdo gser du ma shes par/ /gzhan nas slong mo byed pa ji bzhin no/ /des na rang gi 488

sems kyi rtsad brdar rnams/ /'di bzhin chod cig skal ldan snying bi bu/ /sems zhes bya ba'i rig rig 'gyu 'gyu po/ /bdas na mi zin yal yal ban bun po/ /bzhag na mi sdod tshub tshub yer yer po /'di zhes mtshon med stong pa phyang chad po/ /bde sdug sna tshogs myong mkhan rang gi sems/ /dang po 'di ni byung sa gang nas byung / /phyi yi snang ba ri brag chu shing dang / /nam mkha'i rlung sogs rten bcas rten med pa/ /gang las byung ngam 'dri zhing rtsad brdar chod//yang na pha ma gnyis kyi khu khrag las/ /byung ngam snyam na ji ltar byung tshul dpyod/ /de ltar dpyad pas byung sa ma rnyed tshe/ /bar du da lta rang lus stod smad dang / /dbang po don snying la sogs gang la gnas / /snying la gnas na mgo 'jug gang na gnas/ /dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs ji ltar 'dug /legs par dpyod la gnas sa ma rnyed tshe/ /tha mar 'gro dus yul gyi dbang po'i sgo/ /gang nas 'gro dang phyi rol yu la rnams su/ /yu/da tsam nyid la sleb pa'i dus de ru/ /lus kyis phyin nam sems nyid kho nas phyin/ /lus sems tshogs pas phyin sogs rtsad brdar chod/ /de yang nyon mongs rnam rtog skye ba'i tshe/ /dang po gang nas skyes dang da lta'i dus/ /gang la gnas dang mdog dbyibs e 'dug ltos/ /tha mar rang sar zhi nas yal ba'i tshe/ /gang du yal nas 'gro sogs rtsad brdar chod/ /'chi ba'i 489

tshe na ji ltar byas nas 'gro/ /zhib tu dpyod la skye 'chi 'gro 'ong dang —/ /dngos bzung bral ba'i stong sangs brjod med du/ /nges par gtan la ma phebs bar du dpyod/ /gzhan gyi dpe dang kha bshad skam po yis/ /stong pa nyid yin zer bas mi phan te/ /dper na stag yod zer ba'i sa cha ru/ /gzhan gyis stag ni med par brjod na yang / /rang nyid de la yid ches mi skye bar/ /yid gnyis the tshom za ba ji bzhin no/ /rang gi sems kyi rtsa ba rang nyid kyis/ /zhib tu bcad nas gtan la phab pa'i tshe/ /dper na stag yod zer ba'i lung pa der/ /rang nyid song nas phu mdo thams cad du/ /stag ni e yod rtsad brdar bcad gyur na/ /ma rnyedatshe na rang nyid yid ches te/ /phyin chad sa der stag yod snyam pa yi/ /yid gnyis the tshom med pa ji bzhin no/ /lhaye ma ho/ da yang skal ldan bu rnams tshur nyon dang / /khyed rnams de ltar brtags shing dpyad pa'i tshe/ /sems zhes mdzub mo btsugs nas 'di yin zhes/ /dngos por grub pa rdul tsam ma rnyed tshe / /ma rnyed pa de rnyed pa'i mchog yin no/ /'o skol sems la dang po byung sa med/ /ye nas stong pas ngo bo ngos bzung med/ /bar du gnas sa dbyibs dang kha dog med/ /tha mar 'gror med 'dir song rjes med de/ /'gyu ba stong 'gyu stong pa stong snang yin/ /sems 490

nyid 'di ni dang po rgyus ma bskyed/ /tha ma phyi rol rkyen gyis 'di mi 'jig /'phel dang 'grib dang gang stong 'di la med/ /'khor 'das yongs la khyab pas phyogs ris med/ /'di zhes mi mtshon cir yang 'gag med 'char/ /cir yang ma grub yod med mtha' las 'das/ /'gro 'ong med cing skye 'chi gsal 'grib med/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dri med shel gong bzhin/ /ngo bo stong pa rang bzhin gsal ba dang / /thugs rje 'gag pa med par sa ler gnas/ /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ci yang ma gos te/ /sems nyid ye nas sangs rgyas yin par nges/ /'di ni gzhi yi sems nyid gnas lugs kyi/ /rang bzhin gtan la phab pa'i ngo sprod do/ / /e ma ho/ da yang skal ldan sems kyi bu rnams nyon/ /dang po chos sku kun tu bzang po yis/ /bsgom pa rdul tsam ma byas grol tshul dang / /'gro ba drug gis mi dge sdig pa'i las/ /spu tsam ma byas 'khor bar 'khyams tshul ni/ /ye thog dang po kun gyi sngon rol tu / /'khor 'das ming med gdod ma'i gzhi la gnas/ /de dus rig pa gzhi nas 'phags tshul ni/ /shel la nyi phog rang 'od phyir gsal ltar/ /rig pa'i ye shes srog rlung gis bskyod nas/ /gzhon nu bum pa sku yi rgya ral te/ /lhun grub 'od gsal sku dang ye shes kyi / /zhing khams mkha' la nyi shar bzhin du gsal/ /de dus chos sku 491

kun tu bzang po yis/ /rang snang yin par shes pas skad cig la/ /phyir gsal sku dang ye shes nang du thim/ /ka dag gdod ma'i gzhi la sa ngas rgyas so/ /'o skol rnams kyis rang bzhin lhun grub kyi/ /snang ba rang gdangs yin par ma shes pas / /shes pa dran med thom me ba de nyid/ /de la lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig zer/ /de nas gzhi snang 'od gsal de nyid la/ /gnyis su 'dzin pa'i shes pa skyes pa de / /kun tu brtags pa'i ma rig pa zhes zer/ /ma rig gnyis 'dzin sbubs su de dus tshud/ /de nas bag chags rim bzhin rgyas nas kyang / /'khor ba'i bya ba 'di rnams thams cad byung / /de nas nyon mongs dug gsum dug lnga dang / /brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs rgyas nas kyang / /'khor ba'i gnas su zo chu'i 'khyud mo bzhin/ /'khor zhing bde sdug da lta'i bar der myangs/ /rgyas par 'dod na kun mkhyen theg mchog mdzod/ /zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin phung sogs la ltos/ /da ni bla ma'i man ngag zab mo yis/ /'khrul pa'i rang mtshang thams cad rig nas kyang / /rang sems sangs rgyas rang ngo mthong ba yin/ /gdod ma'i mgon po'i rang zhal mjal ba yin / /kun tu bzang por skal ba mnyam pa yin/ /snying nas dga' ba sgoms shig sems kyi bu/ /'khrul pa gtan la phab pa'i ngo sprod do / /492

myu/e ma ho/ da yang skal ldan snying gi bu rnams nyon/ /sems zhes bya ba'i yongs grags sgra bo che/ /yod ni gcig kyang yod pa ma yin te / /'byung ni 'khor 'das bde sdug sna tshogs 'byung / /'dod ni theg pa'i rnam grangs mang du yod/ /ming ni bsam gyis mi khyab so sor btags/ /so so skye bo rnams kyis nga yang zer/ /mu stegs la las bdag ces ming du btags/ /nyan thos pa yis gang zag bdag med zer/ /sems tsam pa yis sems zhes ming du btags/ /la las shes rab pha rol phyin pa zer/ /la las bde gshegs snying po ming du btags/ /la las phyag rgya chen po ming du btags/ /la las dbu ma zhes pa'i ming du btags/ /la las thig le nyag gcig ming du btags/ /la las chos kyi dbyings zhes ming du btags/ /la las kun gzhi zhes pa ming du btags/ /la las tha mal shes pa ming du btags/ /ming ni bsam gyis mi khyab ci btags kyang / /don la 'di nyid yin pas shes par gyis/ /khyed rnams sems nyid rang sar glod la zhog /bzhag dus tha mal shes pa rjen ne+e ba/ /bltas pas mthong rgyu med pa'i sa le ba/ /rig pa mngon sum sa le hrig ge ba/ /cir yang ma grub stong zhing seng nge ba/ /gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i ye re ba/ /rtag pa ma yin cir yang grub pa med//chad pa ma yin sa le hrig ge ba/ /gcig pu ma yin du ma rig cing 493

gsal / /du ma ma yin dbyer med ro gcig pa/ /gzhan na med de rang rig 'di nyid do/ /snying dbus bzhugs pa'i gdod ma'i mgon po'i zhal/ /mngon sum da lta'i dus 'dir mthong ba yin/ /'di dang 'bral med gyis shig snying gi bu/ /'di min gzhan las lhag pa sus 'dod pa/ /glang po rnyed kyang rjes 'tshol ji bzhin du/ /stong gsum thams cad thags su btags na yang / /sangs rgyas ming tsam rnyed par mi srid do/ /dngos gzhi'i gnas lugs don gyi ngo sprod do/ /pa.e ma ho/ da yang rigs kyi bu rnams legs par nyon/ /da lta'i rang rig rang gsal 'di nyid la/ /sku gsum ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje dang / /sku lnga ye shes lnga sogs thams cad tshang / /rig pa'i ngo bo kha dog dbyibs la sogs/ /cir yang ma grub stong pa chos kyi sku/ /stong pa'i rang gdangs gsal ba longs sku'o/ /sna tshogs 'char gzhi ma 'gags sprul pa'i sku/ /de rnams mtshon pa'i dpe ni 'di dang 'dra/ /shel gyi me long chos kyi sku dang mtshungs/ /rang bzhin dwangs shing gsal ba longs sku'i mtshon/ /gzugs brnyan 'char gzhi ma 'gags sprul sku'i dpe/ /'gro rnams sems nyid ye nas sku gsum du/ /gnas pa yin te rang ngo shes nus na/ /'gro ba rnams kyis sgom pa rdul tsam yang / /bya mi dgos te dus 494

gcig 'tshang rgya'o/ /sku gsum ngo sprod tha dad bstan pa ni/ /don la dbyings gcig ma gtogs tha dad du/ /bzung nas 'khrul par ma 'gro snying gi bu/ /sku gsum ye nas stong pa ka dag ste/ /gsal stong zung 'jug ngo bo gcig pa ru/ /shes par gyis la 'dzin med ngang la spyod/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum po yang / /chos sku longs sku sprul sku nyid dang mtshungs/ /gsum ka gsal stong zung 'jug chen po ru/ /shes par gyis la 'dzin med ngang la spyod/ /de yang rang byung rig pa'i ye shes 'di/ /cir yang snang bas rnam par snang mdzad sku/ /'gyur ba med pas mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku/ /mtha' dbus med pas snang ba mtha' yas sku/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun 'byung ba'i/ /nor bu 'dra bas rin chen 'byung ldan sku/ /don kun 'grub pas don yod grub pa'i sku/ /de rnams rig pa'i rtsal las logs na med/ /rig pa'i ye shes ngo bo ma 'gags par/ /mngon sum gsal bas me long ye shes so/ /kun la khyab pas mnyam nyid ye shes so/ /rtsal las sna tshogs 'char bas sor rtog go/ /don kun 'grub pas bya grub ye shes so/ /de dag rnams kyi ngo bo ka dag tu / /'dus pas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /de rnams thams cad rang gi rig rtsal las/ /logs na grub pa rdul tsam med pa'o/ /sku gsum ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje dang / /sku lnga ye shes lnga po 495

gcig char du/ /mngon sum mdzub mo btsugs nas ngo sprod na/ /da lta'i shes pa bzo bcos ma byas pa/ /rkyen gyis ma bsgyur 'dzin pas ma bslad pa'i/ /rig pa sa le hrig ge 'di ka yin/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'di las byung / /'di ni dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs yin pas/ /'di dang 'bral med gyis shig skal ldan kun / /ma bcos rang gsal 'di ka yin pa la/ /rang sems sangs rgyas ma mthong ci la zer/ /'di la bsgom rgyu ci yang med pa la/ /bsgom rgyu ma byung bya ba ci la zer/ /rig pa mngon sum 'di ka yin pa la/ /rang sems ma rnyed bya ba ci la zer/ /gsal hrig rgyun chad med pa 'di ka yin/ /sems ngo ma mthong bya ba ci la zer/ /'di la bya rgyu rdul tsam med pa la/ /byas pas ma byung bya ba ci la zer/ /gnas dang mi gnas gnyis su med pa la/ /gnas su ma gtub bya ba ci la zer/ /rang rig sku gsum rtsol med lhun grub la/ /bsgrubs pas ma 'grub bya ba ci la zer/ /byar med cog ger bzhag pas chog pa la/ /de la mi nus bya ba ci la zer/ /rtog pa shar grol dus mnyam yin pa la/ /gnyen po ma byung bya ba ci la zer/ /da lta'i shes pa 'di ka yin pa la/ /'di la mi shes bya ba ci la zer/ /ྈ e ma ho/ da yang skal ldan bu rnams gus pas gson/ /rang sems dngos med nam mkha' stong pa 'dra/ /'dra'am mi 'dra skal 496

ldan bu rnams kun/ /blta ru med pa'i tshul du rang sems la cer gyis ltos la phyam gyis zhog dang shes/ /stong pa phyang chad dag kyang ma yin par/ /rang rig ye shes ye nas gsal bar nges/ /rang byung rang gsal nyi ma'i snying po 'dra/ /'dra'am mi 'dra rang gi sems nyid la/ /cer gyis ltos la phyam gyis zhig dang shes/ /rnam rtog 'gyu dran ngos bzung med par nges/ /'gyu ba nges med bar snang bser bu 'dra/ /'dra'am mi 'dra rang gi sems nyid la/ /cer gyis ltos la phyam gyis zhog dang shes/ /cir snang thams cad rang snang yin par nges / /gang snang thams cad me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /'dra'am mi 'dra rang gi sems nyid la/ /cer gyis ltos la phyam gyis zhog dang shes/ /sems las ma gtogs gzhan la chos med pas/ /lta ba blta rgyu gzhan na chos med do/ /sems las ma gtogs gzhan na chos med pas/ /sgom pa bsgom rgyu gzhan na chos med do/ /sems las ma gtogs gzhan na chos med pas/ /spyod pa spyod rgyu gzhan na chos med do/ /sems las ma gtogs gzhan na chos med pas/ /dam tshig bsrung rgyu gzhan na chos med do/ /sems las ma gtogs gzhan na chos med pas/ /'bras bu bsgrub rgyu gzhan na chos med do / /yang ltos yang ltos rang gi sems la ltos/ /phyi rol nam mkha'i khams la sems thongs la/ /rang sems nyid la 'gro 'ong e 'dug 497

ltos / /bltas tshe 'gro 'ong sems la mi gda' na/ /nang gi rang gi sems la tshur ltos la/ /rtogs pa 'phro ba'i 'phro mkhan e 'dug ltos / /rtog pa 'phro ba'i 'phro mkhan mi gda' na/ /sems la kha dog dbyibs sogs e 'dug ltos/ /kha dog dbyibs med stong par thug pa'i tshe/ /stong pa nyid la mtha' dbus e 'dug ltos/ /mtha' dbus med tshe phyi nang e 'dug ltos/ /phyi dang nang med rig pa mkha' ltar yangs/ /zang nge thal ler rgya chad phyogs lhung bral/ /rang rig khyab gdal klong chen yangs pa'i ngang / /'khor 'das chos rnams bar snang 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /sna tshogs snang yang sems kyi rol pa ste/ /rang rig g.yo med ngang las phar ltos dang / /chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma chu zla bzhin/ /snang stong so sor dbye bar mi nus so/ /rig pa'i ngang la 'khor 'das gnyis su med/ /rang rig g.yo med ngang las phar ltos dang / /'khor 'das chos rnams me long gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /ji ltar snang yang gdod nas yod ma myong / /'khor 'das ming med thams cad chos sku yin —/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'gro kun gyis/ /ye nas 'khor 'das chos kun mnyam nyid du/ /gnas pa'i ye shes rang ngo ma rtogs par/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dbang gis so sor bzung / /gnyis med don la gnyis 'dzin phyir ma grol/ /kun 498

gyis rang sems 'khor 'das dbyer med la/ /spang blang 'dor len byas pas 'khor bar 'khyams/ /rang rig sku gsum rtsol med lhun grub las/ /'di min thag ring gzhan du 'gro thabs kyi/ /sa lam btsal nas blun rmongs 'gro ba kun/ /sangs rgyas sa la slebs pa'i dus ma byung / /gang snang thams cad rang snang yin par nges/ /rang rig g.yo med ngang nas phar ltos dang / /snang zhing srid pa thams cad gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /snang stong grags stong rang bzhin ye nas stong / /de ltar lta mkhan sems la tshur ltos dang / /dran rtog rang yal stong pa nam mkha' 'dra/ /spros med spros bral smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /gang snang thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul te/ /cho 'phrul thams cad gzhi med stong pa yin/ /thams cad rang gi sems su rtogs gyur na/ /mthong snang thams cad stong pa chos sku yin/ /snang bas mi 'ching zhen pas 'ching ba yin/ /zhen chags 'khrul ba chod cig snying gi bu/ /༈ye ma ho/ skal bar ldan pa'i sems kyi bu mchog rnams/ /lcag gis ma brgyab rta la bang mi ldang / /mang du ma bsrubs 'o mar mar mi chags/ /zhib tu ma bshad gtan la mi phebs pas/ /tshig ka mang po'i glu dbyangs blangs pa la/ /snang ba ma sun dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /snang ba thams cad sems su ma shes na/ /stong nyid don 499

de nam yang mi rtogs par/ /snang ba 'di dag dang po gang las byung —/ /bar du gar gnas tha ma gang du 'gro/ /skal ldan bu kun legs par rtog dpyod thongs/ /brtags tshe dper na nam mkha'i na bun de/ /mkha' las byung zhing slar yang mkha' la 'gro/ /de bzhin snang ba sems kyi cho 'phrul te/ /rang gi sems su shar zhing sems su 'gro/ /dper na mig gi dbang po bslad pa'i mis bar snang khams bltas rab rib snang ba de/ /nam mkhar yod yod 'dra bar snang na yang / /mkha' la med de mig gi cho 'phrul yin/ /de bzhin dngos 'dzin bag chags ngan pa yis/ /sems kyi dbang po bslad pa'i mthu yis ni/ /kun rdzob snang grags chos rnams thams cad kun/ /bden par yod yod 'dra bar snang na yang / /gdod nas dngos por grub pa rdul tsam yang / /med de rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul yin/ /cho 'phrul thams cad gzhi med stong pa yin/ /med pa gsal snang sgyu ma chu zla 'dra/ /snang stong dbyer med don la mnyam par zhog /da lta rang cag gnyid kyi rmi lam na/ /pha yul gnas khang nye 'bral la sogs pa/ /mngon sum snang nas bde sdug myong ba'i tshe/ /rang gi nye du 'brel ba gcig kyang med/ /rang nyid mal nas cung zad ma g.yos kyang / /nyin par ji bzhin nyams su mngon sum myong / /de bzhin tshe 'di'i snang ba thams cad kun/ /500

mdang gi rmi lam nyams su myong ba bzhin/ /rang gi sems kyis der btags der bzung nas/ /de ltar snang ste sems kyis myong ba yin//rmi lam gnyid kyi skabs su'ang rang bzhin med/ /de bzhin ji ltar snang yang stong pa'o/ / /e ma ho/ skal bar ldan pa'i sems kyi bu gcig po/ /snang ba thams cad nges pa ma yin te/ /la las snang ba la las mun pa'o/ /de yang sems can 'ga' zhig sa gzhi la/ /sa la sa yi 'du shes sems can yod/ /sa la me yi 'du shes sems can yod/ /sa la longs spyod 'du shes sems can yod/ /sa la sdug bsngal 'du shes sems can yod/ /chu la chu yi 'du shes sems can yod/ /chu la me yi 'du shes sems can yod/ /chu la bdud rtsi'i 'du shes sems can yod/ /chu la gnas khang 'du shes sems can yod/ /chu la sa ru 'du shes sems can yod/ /me la me yi 'du shes sems can yod/ /me la longs spyod 'du shes sems can yod/ /me la gnas su 'du shes sems can yod/ /me la zas su 'du shes sems can yod/ /nam mkha' nam mkhar 'du shes sems can yod/ /nam mkha' gnas su 'du shes sems can yod/ /nam mkha' sa ru 'du shes sems can yod/ /des na snang ba nges pa med pa'i phyir/ /bag chags dbang gis gang ltar snang ba yin/ /de ltar 'byung ba bzhi po 501

rang rang du/ /'du shes pa ni mi yi snang ngo yin/ /'gro ba gzhan gyis sa gzhi 'di la yang / /dmyal ba'i me dang zhing pa'i longs spyod dang / /rgyud kyis non pas sdug bsngal 'du shes pa'o/ /de bzhin me la me lha'i longs spyod dang / /yi dwags me lus can gyis gnas khang dang / /me yi srin bus zas su 'du shes pa'o/ /de bzhin chu la dmyal ba'i 'gro bas me/ /yi dwags sems can rnams la rnag khrag dang / /bhasto glang pos sa dang lhas bdud rtsi/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha la rin chen dang / /me tog char dang klu yi gnas khang ngo / /nam mkha' la yang de ltar byas nas gnas/ /lha rnams kun gyis sa yi 'du shes so/ /des na thams cad rang gis gang ltar du/ /btags pa de ltar bzhin du snang ba'o/ /de yang lha yi bu yis sangs rgyas la/ /ri rab nyi zla la sogs su yis byas/ /zhus tshe sangs rgyas nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / /'di la byed mkhan gzhan ni su yang med/ /rang gi rtog pa'i bag chags a 'thas kyis/ /der btags der bzung de ltar snang ba yin/ /thams cad rang gi sems kyis byas par gsungs/ /lha yi bu yis sangs rgyas yang zhus te / /rang gi rtog pa ji ltar a 'thas kyang / /ri rab nyi ma zla ba la sogs pa'i/ /sra zhing brtan pa 'di 'dra ga na 'ongs/ /zhus tshe sangs rgyas nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / /wā ra ṇa sīr rgan mos rang 502

lus ni/ /stag tu bsgoms pas grong khyer de yis kyang / /stag tu mthong nas grong khyer stongs pas na/ /yun ni thung bus de ltar snang nus na/ /skye ba thog ma med nas bag chags sems/ /goms na 'di 'dra los snang thub pas gsungs/ /des na thams cad sems kyis byas pa'o/ /de yang phyi rol mu stegs kha cig gis/ /'jig rten 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba 'gog pa'i phyir/ /dben gnas bsgoms pas dben gnas mngon sum du/ /grub nas gzhan gyi mis kyang mthong ba byung / /gcig gis nam mkha' brag tu bsgoms nas kyang / /brag tu gyur nas phung po thogs pa skad/ /des na thams cad sems kyi rtog pa yis/ /byas pa yin pas sems kyi rang snang ste/ /rang snang thams cad don la stong pa'o/ /de yang dmyal ba nyi tshe'i sems can gyis / /sgo dang ka ba thab dang thag pa sogs/ /gzugs su 'du shes sdug bsngal myong ba'o/ /des na sems kyi rtog pas gang ltar du/ /btags pa de ltar gzhan du snang ba'o/ /'gro drug sems can bde sdug thams cad ni/ /rang gi sems nyid gcig pur byas pa'i phyir//thams cad rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul gyis/ /med snang stong pa nyid kyi rang gzugs su/ /blo thag rbad kyis chod la phyam gyis zhog /de yang thub pa gangs chen mtsho yis ni/ /phyag gi pad+ma'i rdul gcig steng nyid na/ /stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten yod par gsungs/ /503

thod rgal rig pa tshad la phebs pa'i tshe/ /rang lus ba spu'i khung bu re re ni/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams tshad med mthong ba dang / /'gro drug sems can gnas kyang tshad med mthong / /de la 'gro 'dul sprul pa bkye nas kyang / /rmi lam ji bzhin 'gro don byed par gsungs / /des na 'khor 'das chos rnams rang snang yin/ /rang snang thams cad gzhi med stong pa yin/ /stong gsal 'dzin med ngang la blo gdeng 'chos/ /gzhan yang rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed kyi / /sangs rgyas zhing khams dpag tu med pa dang / /'gro drug gnas kyang grangs med yod par gsungs/ /de rnams thams cad 'dres med rtog pa med/ /gnod par gyur pa med par rgyal bas gsungs / /gzhan yang srin 'bu re re'i khog na yang / /srin 'bu'i grong khyer dpag med yod par gsungs/ /nam mkha'i khams na grong khyer mang po yis/ /mgo bo thur du bstan nas chags pa dang / /de bzhin 'phred dang gyen du chags pa yi/ /grong khyer dpag tu med pa yod par gsungs/ /'di 'dra 'di dag su yis byas snyam na/ /thams cad sems kyis byas par rgyal bas gsungs/ /sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /kun rdzob snang grags chos rnams thams cad kun/ /rang gi sems nyid gcig pu'i rang snang ste/ /'chi tshe 504

rang gi sems rgyud 'gyur bas na/ /phyi rol 'gyur ba med kyang rang snang 'gyur/ /des na thams cad sems kyi rang snang ste/ /rang snang thams cad gzhi med stong pa yin/ /med pa gsal snang gzugs brnyan chu zla 'dra/ /gsal stong gnyis med rig pa'i ngang nyams skyongs / /mthong snang thams cad sems kyi rang snang yin/ /snod kyi 'jig rten bem por snang ba sems/ /bcud kyi sems can rigs drug snang ba'ang sems/ /mtho ris lha mi'i bde ba snang ba'ang sems / /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal snang ba'ang sems ma rig nyon mongs dug lngar snang ba'ang sems/ /rang byung ye shes rig pa snang ba'ang sems/ /ngan rtog 'khor ba'i bag chags snang ba'ang sems / /bzang rtog sangs rgyas zhing khams snang ba'ang sems/ /bdud dang 'dre yis bar chad snang ba'ang sems/ /lha dang dngos grub legs par snang ba'ang sems/ /rnam par rtog pa sna tshogs snang ba'ang sems/ /mi rtog rtse gcig bsgom par snang ba'ang sems / /dngos po mtshan ma kha dog snang ba'ang sems/ /mtshan ma med cing spros pa med pa'ang sems/ /gcig dang du ma gnyis med snang ba'ang sems/ /yod med gang yang ma grub snang ba'ang sems/ /sems las ma gtogs snang ba gang yang med/ /sems ni dper na ri mo mkhan dang 'dra/ /rang gi lus kyang sems kyis byas pa ste/ /505

stong gsum 'jig rten khams ni ji snyed pa/ /de dag thams cad sems kyis bris pa ste/ /rang gi rtog pas bris pa'i ri mo yis/ /byis pa'i blo can 'gro kun bslus pa yin/ /des na thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul du/ /thag chod nges shes bskyed pa gal che'o/ /'di ni rnam rtog sems su ngo sprod do/ / ཿe ma ho/ da yang sems kyi bu mchog thams cad nyon/ /de ltar byed mkhan rang gi sems nyid la/ /ngo bo ngos bzung dbyibs dang kha dog sogs/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang bstan du med pa ste/ /ye nas stong pa 'dzin med nam mkha' 'dra/ /sems nyid stong pa gzhi med yin par nges/ /sems nyid mtshon don nam mkha' dper bzhag kyang —/ /re zhig stong phyogs tsam gyi mtshon dpe ste/ /sems nyid rig bcas stong pa cir yang 'char/ /nam mkha' rig med stong chad had po ste/ /de'i phyir sems don nam mkhas mtshon du med/ /'di ni sems nyid stong par ngo sprod do/ /sems nyid gsal stong de yi rang rtsal las/ /snang ba sna tshogs gang yang 'char ba yin/ /shar yang me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /gnyis su med de stong pa'i ngang du gcig /'di ni stong pa snang bar ngo sprod do/ /ye nas snang stong gnyis su med pa ste/ /rang sems stong pas snang ba mi 'gag cing / /stong pa'i ngang las snang ba 'dzin med bkra/ /snang ba 506

rnams kyis stong pa mi 'gag cing / /snang yang rang bzhin ye nas stong pa'o/ /nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon chu nang zla gzugs ltar/ /snang stong gnyis med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /'khor 'das chos rnams sgyu ma'i ltad mo yin/ /snang stong gnyis med ltad mor bltas pa'i tshe/ /blo sems 'gyur ba med pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /de ltar yin min skal ldan bu rnams kun/ /rang sems stong pa nyid dang snang ba gnyis/ /so sor dbye rgyu e yod ltos dang shes/ /ye nas snang stong gnyis su med pa'o/ /'di ni snang stong gnyis med ngo sprod do/ /de ltar snang stong gnyis med rang byung gi /rig pa rang gsal sa le hrig ge ba/ /sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i dgongs pa ste/ /thun mtshams med par khor yug nyams len la/ /nyin mtshan med par skyongs shig sems kyi bu/ /'di ni gnyis med rang grol ngo sprod do/ / /e ma ho/ da yang bya btang bdag gi glu la nyon/ /gzhi yi rig par sku gsum tshang tshul dang / /gzhi snang dus kyi sku gsum tshang tshul gyi/ /rnam dbye 'di gnyis legs par shes byas nas/ /'khor 'das sku gsum zhing du rtogs par bya/ /gzhi yi rig par sku gsum tshang tshul ni/ /sngon du'ang bshad kyang da dung 'dir yang 'chad/ /rang rig gzhi ni shel gyi gong bu 'dra/ /de yi stong pa chos sku'i rang bzhin dang / /gsal ba'i rang gdangs longs spyod rdzogs pa dang //507

'char gzhi ma 'gags sgo ni sprul pa'i sku/ /gzhi yi rig par sku gsum tshang tshul yin/ /'di la nam yang 'du 'bral med pa'o/ /dper na shel las 'od lnga shar ba bzhin/ /de las shar ba gzhi snang dus na yang / /dag pa rgyal ba'i zhing khams snang ba dang / /ma dag snod bcud snang ba gang snang yang / /thams cad ngo bo stong pa chos kyi sku/ /rang bzhin snang ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /sna tshogs ma 'gags shar ba sprul pa'i sku/ /gzhi snang dus kyi sku gsum tshang tshul lo/ /gzhan du 'di yi rnam dbye phyes pa nyung / /gnad 'di legs par rtogs dgos pa zhig yin/ /ngas kyang kun mkhyen legs bshad drin las shes/ /de ltar shes na snang srid thams cad kyang / /sku gsum lhun grub dkyil 'khor ye nas yin/ /sku gsum zhing khams gzhan nas btsal du med/ /'gro drug sems can rnams kyang sku gsum du/ /gnas pa yin te rang ngo shes nus na/ /'gro ba rnams kyis sgom pa rdul tsam yang / /bya mi dgos par thams cad 'tshang rgya'o/ /de yang don la gzhi yi sku gsum yang / /chos sku yin pas so sor ma 'dzin zhig /gzhi snang dus kyi sku gsum de nyid kyang / /gzugs sku yin pas so sor ma 'dzin zhig /chos gzugs gnyis kyang don la so sor min/ /stong pa chos sku'i ngang du ro gcig go /mthar thug gzhi snang gzhi la rang thim nas/ /gzhi yi 508

chos sku'i dgongs pa mngon gyur tshe/ /don gyi 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa yin/ /de nas chos sku'i mkha' las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gzugs sku rnam gnyis 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du/ /bstan nas 'gro don rgyun mi 'chad pa'o/ / ༈ye ma ho/ da yang bya btang bdag gi glu la nyon/ /khyed rang rnams la sngon la gnod pa bskyal/ /sun ni dbyung dang brdung btsog byas pa dang / /ngo tsha gtad dang sems la gnod pa'i las/ /ji ltar gzhan gyis byas pa'i tshul rnams kun/ /rang gi yid la tshul bzhin bsam byas nas/ /zhe sdang skyer chug skyes tshe ngo bo la cer gyis ltos la zhe snang mkhan po de/ /dang po gang nas byung dang da lta'i dus/ /gang du gnas dang tha ma gang du 'gro/ /dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs e 'dug ltos/ /bltas tshe ye nas stong pa 'dzin med yin / /zhe sdang ma spangs me long ye shes so/ /khyed rnams snying la sdug pa'i bud med dang / /sha sogs rang nyid za ba gang 'dod dang / /gos sogs rang gi gon pa gang 'dod dang / /rta sogs rang gi phyugs rnams gang 'dod rnams/ /tshul bzhin rang gi yid la bsam byas nas/ /'dod chags skyer chug skyes tshe ngo bo la cer gyis ltos la 'dod chags mkhan po de/ /dang po gang nas byung dang da lta'i dus/ /gang du gnas dang tha ma gang du 'gro/ /dbyibs dang 509

kha dog la sogs e 'dug stos/ /bltas tshe ye nas stong pa 'dzin med yin/ /'dod chags ma spangs sor rtog ye shes so/ /khyed rnams gnyid dang bying rmugs la sogs pa'i/ /gti mug skyer chug skyes tshe ngo bo la/ /cer gyis ltos la gti mug mkhan po de/ /dang po gang nas byung dang da lta'i dus/ /gang du gnas dang tha ma gang du 'gro / /dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs e 'dug ltos/ /bltas tshe ye nas stong pa 'dzin med yin/ /gti mug ma spangs chos dbyings ye shes so/ /khyed rnams rang gi rigs rus stobs 'byor dang / /gzugs byad legs dang ngag gi dbyangs snyan dang / /thos bsam sgom gsum yi ge 'bri klog dang / /rig gnas mkhas dang grong chog gdul bya sogs/ /rang la yod tshad yon tan bsam byas nas/ /gzhan las cung zad nga bzang snyam pa yi/ /nga rgyal skyer chug skyes tshe ngo bo la/ /cer gyis ltos la nga rgyal mkhan po de/ /dang po gang nas byung dang da lta'i dus/ /gang du gnas dang tha ma gang du 'gro/ /dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs e 'dug ltos/ /bltas tshe ye nas stong pa 'dzin med yin/ /nga rgyal ma spangs mnyam nyid ye shes so/ /rang las che ba'i gzhan gyi stobs 'byor dang / /yon tan mkhan dang gdul bya mang ba dang / /rig gnas mkhas dang 'don bzang skad bzang dang / /chos kyi go ba 'jig rten gtam la sogs/ /510

gzhan gyi yon tan thams cad bsam byas nas/ /rang las mtho bar dogs pa'i phrag dog sems/ /skyer chug skyes tshe phrag dog ngo bo la / /cer gyis ltos la phrag dog mkhan po de/ /dang po gang nas byung dang da lta'i dus/ /gang du gnas dang tha ma gang du 'gro/ /dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs e 'dug ltos/ /bltas tshe ye nas stong pa 'dzin med yin/ /phrag dog ma spangs bya grub ye shes so/ /de ltar rtogs na nyon mongs ye shes yin/ /nyon mongs rtog pa spangs pa'i pha rol nas/ /stong nyid ye shes 'tshol ba dgod re bro/ /btsal bas ma rnyed tshe na snying re rje/ /'di ltar dug lnga stong par shes nas kyang —/ /phyin chad dug lnga'i rtogs pa gang shar yang / /ngo sprod 'di bzhin skye sa gnas sa dang / /'gro sa dbyibs dang kha dog dpyad mi dgos/ /sngon du dug lnga stong par shes pa'i phyir/ /shar ma thag tu rjes su mi 'brang bar/ /sems nyid ngang du rang sar glod la zhog /rang yal nyid du 'gro bar the tshom med/ /'di ni ngo sprod rtsal sbyong gnyis ka yin/ /'di ltar sngon la rtsal sbyong byas gyur na/ /phyin chad nyon mongs dug lnga nam shar tshe/ /nyon mongs rang mtshang sngon la shes stabs kyis/ /stong nyid ye shes gnyis ka mnyam shar nas/ /shar grol dus mnyam shar grol dus mnyam mo/ /bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar gsung rgyun du/ /nyon mongs rtog pa mang na chos sku mang / /511

gsungs pa ji bzhin yin pas shes par gyis/ /las ni dang po pa la nyon mongs sems/ /shugs drag shar tshe dpyad 'jog byas na bzang / /'di ni zhal shes yin pas thugs la zhog /'di ni dug lnga rang grol ngo sprod do/ /༈ye ma ho/ da yang snying dang 'dra ba'i bu rnams nyon/ /gos la sogs pa'i 'jam po lus la dril/ /'jam mo snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /re ba la sogs rtsub mo lus la dril/ /rtsub bo snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /bltas tshe gnyis ka stong par ro mnyam mo / /gser sku la sogs mdzes pa'i gzugs la ltos/ /mdzes so snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /sbal ba la sogs mi mdzes gzugs la ltos/ /mi mdzes snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /bltas tshe gnyis ka stong par ro mnyam mo/ /bu ram la sogs zhim po kha ru zo/ /mngar ro snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /bca' lga la sogs kha ru myangs nas kyang / /kha kha snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos / /bltas tshe gnyis ka stong par ro mnyam mo/ /tsan dan spos sogs dri ni zhim por snoms/ /zhim mo snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos / /shing kun sgog pa la sogs dri ngan snoms/ /mi zhim snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /bltas tshe gnyis ka stong par ro mnyam mo/ /dril bu pi wang gling bu'i sgra la nyon/ /snyan no snyam pa'i rang gi 512

sems la ltos/ /rdo dang thal mo rdob la sgra la nyon/ /mi snyan snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /bltas tshe gnyis ka stong par ro mnyam mo / /khyed rnams gling bzhi'i khams la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /'khor los bsgyur rgyal zhig tu skyes nas kyang / /btsun mo blon po mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /rin chen sna lnga las grub khang pa na/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas za bar bsgom/ /de 'dra'i snang ba sems la shar ba'i tshe/ /bde'o snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /khyed rnams dbul po 'khor g.yog gcig kyang med/ /gyang ra zhig po zhig tu mal bcas nas/ /steng nas char babs 'og nas sas brlan zhing //lus la mdze sogs nad sna mang pos btab/ /rkang lag chad nas sdug bsngal du ma yis/ /mnar nas sdug bsngal myong ba zhig tu bsgom / /de 'dra'i snang ba yid la shar ba'i tshe/ /sdug go snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /bltas tshe bde sdug stong par ro mnyam mo/ /'di ltar tshogs drug stong par shes nas kyang / /phyin chad tshogs drug bzang ngan gang shar tshe/ /ngo sprod 'di bzhin dpyad pa mi dgos te/ /gzhi med ye grol stong pa yin pa'i phyir/ /shar tsam nyid nas rjes su mi 'brang bar/ /sems nyid ngang du rang sar glod la zhog /rang grol nyid du 'gro bar the tshom med/ /'di ni tshogs drug rang grol ngo sprod do/ /513

1e ma ho/ da yang rigs kyi bu rnams legs par nyon/ /khyed rnams rang sems glod la rang babs su/ /zhog la ji ltar gnas pa'i tshul la ltos/ /bltas tshe rig pa'i ngang la gnas pa'i phyir/ /gnas kyang stong pa rig pa'i ngang yin pas/ /skal ldan sems kyi bu rnams shes par gyis/ /gnas pa sems kyi rgyan du ngo sprod do/ /rnam rtog spros la ji ltar 'phro tshul la/ /ltos dang stong gsal rig pa'i ngang nyid las/ /cung zad tsam yang g.yo ba med pa'i phyir/ /'phro yang stong pa rig pa'i ngang yin pas/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams shes par gyis/ /'gro ba sems kyi rol par ngo sprod do/ /dper na rgya mtshor rba rlabs ci shar yang / /rgya mtsho nyid las cung zad ma g.yos ltar/ /sems ni gnas sam 'gyu yang rig stong dang / /cung zad tsam yang g.yo ba med pa'i phyir/ /gang ltar gnas kyang rig pa'i ngang yin zhog /gang ltar shar yang rig pa'i gdangs yin zhog /sems ni gnas na sgom ni yin par 'dod/ /'phro na sgom ni min par 'dod pa de/ /gnas 'gyu gnyis kyi rang mtshang ma shes par / /gnas 'gyu rig gsum gcig tu ma 'dres rtags/ /de phyir skal ldan sems kyi bu mchog kun/ /gnas rung 'gyu rung rig pa'i ngang yin pas/ /'di rnams sngon la thugs su chud nas kyang / /gnas 'gyu rig gsum gcig tu nyams su longs/ /'phro gnas 514

gnyis su med par ngo sprod do/ /༈ye ma ho/ skal par ldan pa'i sems kyi bu gcig po/ /khyed rnams ma yengs dal le rna bas nyon/ /glu ba bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /glu dbyangs snyan mos gangs dkar sems la 'jog /chos rnams thams cad ro gcig stong pa ru/ /gtan la phebs na 'khor 'das spang blang bral/ /dgra dang gnyen du 'dzin pa'i 'khrul pa 'jig /bdag gzhan gnyis su 'dzin pa'i snang ba med / /thams cad ro gcig stong par rtogs phyir ro/ /rgyas bshad mdo 'gag bsdu na 'di yin te/ /theg pa'i yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po ru/ /'khor ba myang 'das thams cad gzhi rtsa bral/ /ye nas sangs rgyas chos skur ro gcig go/ /rdzogs chen ngang la lha 'dre gnyis su med/ /rdzogs chen yul la sangs rgyas sems can med/ /rdzogs chen gzhi la bzang dang ngan pa med/ /rdzogs chen lam la nye dang ring ba med/ /rdzogs chen 'bras bur thob dang ma thob med/ /rdzogs chen chos la spyod dang mi spyod med/ /rdzogs chen don la sgom dang mi bsgom med/ /rdzogs chen rgyal po'i lta ba de bzhin gnas/ /de 'dra'i rdzogs chen lta ba rtogs pa'i tshe/ /sgo gsum phra rags rtog pa kun zhi nas/ /dper na bal la chu btab ji bzhin du/ /sgo gsum zhi zhing dul ba'i ngang la gnas/ /bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin skye 515

ba dang / /de ltar ma rtogs 'khor 'khyams 'gro kun la/ /ma yis bu gcig dag la brtse ba ltar/ /bcos min snying rje skye ba rdzogs chen gyi / /lta ba'i khyad chos yin pa'ang shes par gyis/ /thams cad stong pa nyid du thag bcad nas/ /dge spangs sdig la 'dzem med spyad gyur na/ /nag po kha 'byams bdud kyi lta ba ste/ /de 'dra'i bdud lta'i dbang du ma shor gces/ /'di rnams rdzogs pa chen po'i ngo sprod do/ /ngo sprod 'di rnams shin tu gal che ste/ /phyi rol kun rdzob snang grags chos rnams kun/ /thams cad stong pa nyid du ma rtogs par / /lta ba sgom na snyam yang ci zhig bsgom/ /de yi phyir na dang po 'di ltar du/ /res 'ga' bla mar gsol ba 'debs kyin ltos/ /res 'ga' glod kyin bsgrims kyin legs par ltos/ /de ltar bltas tshe sems la dga' ba dang / /thams cad stong pa nyid du lam lam du/ /shar nas phyi rol snang ba'i yul rnams la/ /lag pas reg kyang 'dzin rgyu med snyam dang / /lta ba 'di nyid nges par yin par 'dug /snyam pa'i nges shes gting tshugs skye bar nges/ /de dus lta ba'i nges shes rnyed pa yin/ /'dzin pas ma bslad 'dzin med ngang la glod/ /ngo sprod thebs nas nyams su ma lon kyang / /'chi tshe bar dor 'jigs skrag ci byung yang / /thams cad rang snang stong pa'i rang gzugs su/ /shes nas ka dag gzhi la 'tshang rgya'o/ /ngo 516

sprod ma thebs nyams su len pa de/ /dper na tshes pa gcig nas 'phyugs pa na/ /bco lnga'i bar du 'phyugs pa ji bzhin no/ /kun rdzob chos rnams thams cad bden med du/ /ma rtogs stong nyid rtogs zer rdzun chen yin/ /des na ngo sprod 'di bzhin dang po'i dus / /bla ma'i drung du sdod la gnas lugs kyi/ /steng du gtan la phobs dang gol sa med/ /de'i phyir skal ldan bu rnams snying la chongs / /༈ye ma ho/ da yang skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams nyon/ /de ltar lta ba'i gnas lugs khong chud nas/ /'khor yul chags sdang 'bral thag rbad kyis chod/ /gcig pur nags kyi gseb dang ri sul du/ /lus kyi bya rtsol thongs la rnal mar sdod/ /ngag gis smra brjod chod la brjod med kyis/ /sems ni nam mkha' bsam pa'i yul las 'das / /de yi ngang la btang bzhag med par glod/ /sems la gtad so med na lta ba yin/ /bsgom du med pa'i ngang la gnas par gyis/ /thom med rdzogs chen 'bras bu 'thob par mdzod/ /de yang lta bar mnyam par 'jog pa'i tshe/ /'di ltar rig pa'i ngang la 'jog snyam dang / /bying rgod dbang du shor 'gro snyam byed kyi/ /rtog pa'i drwa ba gang gis mi bcings par/ /dmigs gtad chos med har sang rgya yan ngang / /zang thal kha yan nyid du glod la zhog /blo 517

yi chos kyis blo 'das don mi mthong / /byas pa'i chos kyi byar med sar mi slebs/ /blo 'das byar med don de thob 'dod na/ /bcos bslad ma byed rig pa gcer bur zhog /gzung 'dzin kun bral lta ba'i mchog yin no/ /spang blang med pa bsgom pa'i mchog yin no/ /bya rtsol las 'das spyod pa'i mchog yin no/ /re med rang gnas 'bras bu'i mchog yin no/ /bltas pas mi mthong lta ba'i 'tshol 'phro zhog /bsgoms pas mi rnyed dran 'dzin dmigs gtad dor/ /spyod pas mi 'grub sgyu mar 'dzin pa thongs/ /btsal bas mi rnyed 'bras bu'i re ba bor/ /da lta'i shes pa bzo med lhug pa la/ /phyogs ris ma byed 'dzin pas ma bslad cig /da lta'i rig pa dngos med gsal ba 'di/ /'di ka lta ba kun gyi yang rtse yin/ /dmigs gtad khyab gdal blo dang bral ba 'di/ /'di ka sgom pa kun gyi yang rtse yin / /ma bcos 'dzin med lhug par bzhag pa 'di/ /'di ka spyod pa kun gyi yang rtse yin/ /ma btsal ye nas lhun gyis grub pa 'di/ /'di ka 'bras bu kun gyi yang rtse yin/ /lta ba'i snying po stong gsal 'dzin med ltos/ /sgom pa'i snying po rang grol 'dzin med skyong / /spyod pa'i snying po tshogs drug lhug par zhog /'bras bu'i snying po re dogs zhig pa yin/ /mu mtha' bral na lta ba'i rgyal po mchog /gza' gtad bral na sgom pa'i rgyal po mchog /blang dor bral na 518

spyod pa'i rgyal po mchog /re dogs bral na 'bras bu'i rgyal po mchog /blta ru med kyis lta ba'i dmigs gtad dor/ /bsgom du med kyis gang byung gang bder thongs/ /spyad du med kyis dgag sgrub spang blang khrol/ /'thob rgyu med kyis 'bras bu'i re ba bor /gang yin yin gyis ched 'dzin ma byed cig /'di yin med kyis dgag sgrub ma byed cig /gza' gtad med kyis phyogs ris ma byed cig /gdod nas dag pa'i rang rig rang gsal la/ /bsam yul blo las 'das pas blta ru med/ /ngo bo gzhi nas bral bas bsgom du med/ /rang grol mtha' las 'das pas spyad du med/ /rtsol sgrub zhen pa las 'das 'bras bu med/ /ngo bo stong nyid yin pas spang thob med/ /rang bzhin gsal stong yin pas rtsol sgrub zhig /thams cad 'gag med yin pas phyogs ris med/ /gang ltar shar yang de ltar ma 'dzin cig /rnal 'byor shes pa nam mkha'i bya lam 'dra/ /bya rjes snga ma 'gags nas mi mthong ltar/ /dran bsam snga ma 'gag cing mthong ba med/ /de la rjes bsnyegs 'dzin pas ma mthud cig /bya rjes phyi ma ma 'ongs dngos med ltar/ /dran bsam phyi mas bsu ma ma byed cig /bya rjes da lta kha dog dbyibs med ltar / /da lta'i dran bsam tha mal rang 'gros la/ /'di zhes gnyen pos bcos bslad ma byed cig /ji ltar shar yang de ltar ma 'dzin 519

cig /'di ni mthar thug snying po'i lam khyer yin/ /gang ltar shar yang de ltar ma bzung na/ /nyon mongs rang yal ye shes chen po yin / /skye med bsam 'das ye grol lta ba ste/ /nan tan byas na lta rgyu med pa lags/ /rang babs lhod chags rang gnas bsgom pa ste//nan tan byas na bsgom rgyu med pa lags/ /spang blang gnyis med sgyu ma'i spyod pa ste/ /nan tan byas na spyod rgyu med pa lags/ /re dogs gnyis med 'bras bu'i rang bzhin ste/ /nan tan byas na 'bras bu med pa lags/ /dus gsum rtsa ba bral ba'i sems nyid 'di/ /ma bsgom mngon sum snang ba blo re bde/ /thog ma tha ma rang bzhin dag pa'i chos/ /ye grol yongs grol 'bad rtsol zhig pa mtshar/ /tha mal shes pa bzo med lhug pa 'di/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mtha' bral klong yangs yin/ /de yang 'bad pas dpyad cing bsgoms pa yis / /sems nyid gnas lugs gnyug ma mthong mi 'gyur/ /ma bsams ma dpyad tha mal chos nyid la/ /bsgom dang mi bsgom yengs dang ma yengs med/ /ma bsgoms lhug pas mang po grol ba yin / /grol dang ma grol don la gnyis su med/ /gnas lugs shes na rtsol med blo bde'o/ /rtog med 'dod pa'i rtog pas bcings pa na / /rnam rtog langs nas phyogs bcur 'gro bar brtson/ /'gro 'ong med pa'i rig pa'i gshis thog tu/ /kha yan glod nas rang yan 520

bzhag pa na/ /mi g.yo ri bo bzhin du brtan par gnas/ /go ldog 'gros 'di bu rnams shes par gyis/ /'di la bsgom rgyu rdul tsam mi dmigs kyang / /yengs med dran pas zin pa rab tu gces/ /myu/e ma ho/ da yang skal ldan bu rnams tshur nyon dang / /phyi yul med snang stong pa'i rang gzugs 'di/ /ye stong chu zla 'dra bas sbyang mi dgos/ /nang gi dran rtog rang yal rjes med pas/ /'bad rtsol gnyen po de la 'jug mi dgos/ /snang sems ye grol lhug pa'i ye shes la/ /spang blang re dogs gang gi'ang sgro mi 'dogs/ /rig pa zang ka gcer bu 'di nyid la/ /yid dpyod spros pa'i gon pa ma bskon par/ /shigs se khros se bun ne rjes med du/ /ris med mnyam pa chen por glod la zhog /de yi ngang la dran bsam ci shar yang / /ris med rang byung rig pa'i rang gdangs su/ /shes par gyis la rjes ni mi bsnyegs par/ /snang sems khral ma khrol dang sangs ma sangs/ /'al ma 'ol gyi chos nyid yo langs su/ /rgya phyam nyid du btang na kun bzang gi/ /dgongs pa'i klong du da lta slebs pa yin/ /rdzogs pa chen po ye grol lhun grub kyi/ /sna tshogs rang grol rnal 'byor de la zer/ /ma phyin na yang sangs rgyas sa ru slebs/ /ma bsgrubs na yang 'bras bu lhun gyis grub/ /ma spangs bzhin du nyon mongs rang sar dag /bla ma dam pa'i dgongs pa dang mnyam mo/ /521

rjes su snyogs so las rnams zin pa'o/ /gnad 'di yin pas bu rnams shes par gyis/ /pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' drin gyis/ /bya bral lhun gyis grub pa'i dgongs pa ru/ /tshogs drug rang grol da res slebs pa'o/ /gnad 'di yin kyang la las ma go 'dug /thams cad ye zin 'dug ste yang byed do/ /ye grol nyid du 'dug ste yang dgrol lo/ /ye bzhag nyid du 'dug ste yang 'jog go/ /ye sgom nyid du 'dug ste yang bsgom mo/ /ye ltos nyid du 'dug ste yang blta'o/ /ye bgrod nyid du 'dug ste yang bgrod do/ /zer nas yid dpyod lta bar re ba'i mis/ /thos kyang tshig ro go yang rnam rtog go/ /rtogs kyang pho tshod bsgoms kyang blos byas so/ /dpyad kyang gnyis 'dzin bsgrubs kyang 'khor ba'o/ /chos nyid yid dpyod mkhan gyi mi de la//rdzogs chen snying thig las 'brel med par nges/ /bya byed mi dgos byas pas zin pa med/ /bya dang mi bya'i rtsis las 'das pa'o/ /bsgom med bsgom pa las 'das bsgoms kyang 'phung / /bltar med lta ba las 'das gang la blta/ /btsal med btsal ba las 'das rnyed pa med/ /'di ltar rig pa zang ma thal byung du/ /'dug ste bshad kyang mi nyan mi de la/ /rdzogs chen las 'brel med pa dgod re bro/ /gang la bltas kyang ka dag klong chen gyi/ /dgongs par shar bas 'khor 'das gnyis su med/ /de 'dra'i dgongs pa 522

glu ru blangs pa la/ /dus gsum rgyal ba dgyes par gdon mi za/ /'o na phyi rol 'khrul pa'i snang yul du/ /rang sar yan du bcug nas slar la yang / /'khrul bar mi 'gro'am zhes brjod gyur na/ /tha mal mi yis bdag tu bzung bas 'khrul/ /rnal 'byor pa yis gzhi med rtsa bral du/ /shes pas bcos bslad blang dor mi byed par/ /rang babs 'dzin med bzhag pas mi 'khrul lo/ /'di la gol sa e yod brjod gyur na/ /'di la gol sa nor sa gcig kyang med/ /gol sa zhen cing chags na yod pa yin/ /gang shar nyid la 'dzin pa med pa ni/ /gol sar ltung rgyu zhig ni ga la 'ongs/ /'on kyang rig pa yul la 'char dus su/ /gang shar rnam par rtog pa'i ngo bo la lta ba de nyid bsgom du 'dod pa min/ /de yi dus kyi rig pa sa le ba/ /rjen pa'i cha de phyal le skyong ba'o/ /de yang rig pa 'phro 'du med pa ru / /gnas pa'i dus kyi gnas cha'i mi rtog pa/ /de nyid sgom gyi dngos gzhi ma yin te/ /de yi dus kyi hrig ge sang nge ba'i/ /gsal dwangs ngar cha de nyid skyong ba'o/ /gnad 'di ma go 'char gnas gnyis ka la/ /blta ba de nyid sgom pa'i ngo bo yin/ /snyam na 'khrul par 'gyur ro snying gi bu/ /gnas pa tsam ni bsam gtan lha dag 'dra / /'char ba tsam ni tha mal rtog pa 'dra/ /de la bsgoms kyang sangs rgyas 'thob mi 'gyur/ /mdor na gang gi dus su'ang rig 523

pa'i cha/ /rjen pa zang thal shel gong 'dra ba de/ /klong du ma gyur bar du sa ler skyongs/ /gyur nas de yi ngang la 'bral med gyis/ /khregs chod lta ba'i gnad 'gag rig pa ni/ /rjen la phud nas sa ler skyong ba la/ /zer bas gnad 'di kho na gal che ste/ /'di ni tshig brgya'i mdo 'gags yin pas na/ /skal ldan snying gi bu rnams shes par gyis/ /༈ye ma ho/ da yang sems kyi bu rnams gus pas nyon/ /nor sa med pa'i thig chen bzhi bstan pa/ /lta ba nor sa med pa'i thig chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pa sa le 'di ka yin/ /gsal la mi nor bas na thig ces bya/ /sgom pa nor sa med pa'i thig chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pa sa le 'di ga yin/ /gsal la mi nor bas na thig ces bya/ /spyod pa nor sa med pa'i thig chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pa sa le 'di ka yin //gsal la mi nor bas na thig ces bya/ /'bras bu nor sa med pa'i thig chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pa sa le 'di ka yin/ /gsal la mi nor bas na thig ces bya/ /mi 'gyur ba yi gzer chen bzhi bstan pa / /lta ba 'gyur ba med pa'i gzer chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pa sa le 'di ka yin/ /dus gsum brtan pa'i phyir na gzer zhes bya/ /sgom pa 'gyur ba med pa'i gzer chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pa sa le 'di ka yin / /dus gsum brtan pa'i phyir na gzer zhes bya/ /spyod pa 524

'gyur ba med pa'i gzer chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pa sa le 'di ka yin / /dus gsum brtan pa'i phyir na gzer zhes bya/ /'bras bu 'gyur ba med pa'i gzer chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pa sa le 'di ka yin / /dus gsum brtan pa'i phyir na gzer zhes bya/ /lta ba mi mthun rgya che grangs mang yang / /da lta'i rang rig rang byung ye shes la / /blta bya dang ni lta byed gnyis su med/ /lta ba ma blta lta ba'i mkhan po 'tshol/ /lta ba'i mkhan po btsal bas ma rnyed na/ /de'i tshe lta ba zad sar 'khyol ba yin/ /lta ba blta rgyu ci yang med pa la/ /ye med stong chad had por ma song bar/ /da lta'i shes pa ma bcos sa le ba/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba de ka yin/ /sgom pa mi mthun rgya che grangs mang yang / /da lta'i tha mal shes pa zang thal la/ /bsgom bya dang ni sgom byed gnyis su med/ /bsgom pa ma sgoms sgom pa'i mkhan po 'tshol/ /sgom pa'i mkhan po btsal bas ma rnyed na/ /de'i tshe sgom pa zad sar 'khyol ba yin/ /sgom pa bsgom rgyu ci yang med pa la/ /bying rgod 'thibs rmugs dbang du ma song bar/ /da lta'i shes pa ma bcos rang gsal la/ /ma bcos mnyam par 'jog pa bsgom pa yin/ /spyod pa mi mthun rgya che grangs mang yang rang rig ye shes thig le nyag gcig la/ /spyad bya dang ni spyod byed gnyis su med / /spyod pa ma spyod spyod pa'i mkhan po 'tshol/ /spyod pa'i 'khan 525

po btsal bas ma rnyed na/ /de'i tshe spyod pa zad sar 'khyol ba yin/ /spyod pa spyod rgyu ci yang med pa la/ /bag chags 'khrul pa'i dbang du ma song bas/ /da lta'i shes pa ma bcos rang gsal la/ /bcos bslad blang dor gang yang mi byed pa/ /de ga rnam par dag pa'i spyod pa yin/ /'bras bu mi mthun rgya che grangs mang yang / /rang gi sku gsum rtsol med lhun grub la/ /bsgrub bya dang ni sgrub byed gnyis su med/ /'bras bu ma sgrubs sgrub pa'i mkhan po tshol/ /'bras bu sgrub mkhan btsal bas ma rnyed na/ /de'i tshe 'bras bu zad sar 'khyol ba yin/ /'bras bu sgrub rgyu ci yang med pa la/ /blang dor re dogs dbang du ma song bar/ /da lta'i shes rig rang gsal lhun grub nyid/ /mngon gyur sku gsum rang gsal stong pa nyid/ /ye sangs rgya ba'i 'bras bu de nyid do/ /༈ e ma ho/ /da yang rigs kyi bu rnams legs par nyon/ /de ltar dang po yengs med bskyangs pa na/ /bar du yan par btang yang don thog nas/ /tha mal btang yang 'gro 'ong med pa'o/ /snang dang stong pa gnyis ka dbyer med na/ /de'i tshe lta ba klong du gyur pa yin//rmi mal nyin par gnyis ka khyad med na/ /de'i tshe sgom pa klong du gyur pa yin/ /bde dang sdug bsngal gnyis ka khyad med na/ /de'i tshe spyod pa klong du gyur pa yin/ /'di dang phyi ma gnyis ka khyad med na//526

de'i tshe gnas lugs klong du gyur pa yin/ /sems dang nam mkha' gnyis ka khyad med na/ /de'i tshe chos sku klong du gyur pa yin/ /rang sems sangs rgyas gnyis ka khyad med na/ /de'i tshe 'bras bu klong du gyur pa yin/ /ཿe ma ho/ da dung rigs kyi bu rnams bdag la gson/ /gdos bcas lus 'di chu zla ltar du ltos/ /ngag gi smra brjod brag cha bzhin du zlos/ /sems kyi rtog tshogs rang sar sangs du chug /snang grags chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma dang / /smig rgyu rmi lam gzugs brnyan chu zla dang / /dri za'i grong khyer mig yor sprul pa dang / /chu bur brag cha bzhin du 'dzin med spyod/ /spyod lam thams cad de yi ngang nas gyis/ /thun mtshams ma gcod nyin mtshan khor yug sprod/ /dran bsam bcos bslad ma byed rang babs ngang / /rang mdangs rang grol 'dzin med gsal stong du/ /bden med bsgom med rtsol med rjes med zhog /sngar 'das rnam par rtog pa thams cad kyang //bya lam nam mkhar rjes med ltar du zhog /da lta'i shes pa rdul bral bar snang ltar/ /ma 'ongs rtog pa rang 'thag chu bcad ltar/ /khrig ger glod la bzo bcos mi byed par/ /rang babs rgya yan ngang du lhug par zhog /phra rags rtog pa dug gsum dug lnga sogs/ /khang stong rkun ma slebs pa ltar du zhig /tshogs drug yul snang thams 527

cad rjes med du/ /sgyu ma'i grong khyer zhig pa ltar du zhog /mdor na skye 'gag gnas gsum gzhi lam 'bras/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras dus gnas brjod tshig dang / /gzhag bya 'jog byed dgrol bya 'grol byed sogs/ /rang gsal res med 'dzin rtsol spang blang med/ /rgya mtsho chen por chu phran thim pa ltar/ /chos kun sems kyi dbyings su ka dag par/ /blo gdeng bca' zhing 'dzin med la bzla'o/ /de ltar bsgoms tshe rnam rtog mang 'phros kyang / /sgom ni ma 'ong snyam nas sdug mi dgos/ /sems ni 'phro yang stong la gnas kyang stong / /gang ltar shar yang rig pa'i ngang yin pas/ /dgag sgrub blang dor gang yang mi byed par/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod la zhog /de yis rnam rtog rang sar grol bar nges/ /blo dman skye bo ngang la mi gnas na/ /ngo sprod skabs bzhin dpyad 'jog spel ma gyis/ /yang na 'di bzhin rnam rtog ar la gtod/ /dgos sam mi dgos rnam rtog bslang nas kyang / /gcig rjes gcig mthud rnam pa sna tshogs pa / /rang sems sun rag bar du spros nas kyang / /de nas mi 'dod tshe na glod la zhog /yang na snying dbus mtshan ldan bla ma bsgom/ /de la sems ni yun ring bzung nas kyang / /de rjes 'dzin med rig pa'i ngang la zhog /yang na snying gi dbus su thig le bsgom/ /de nyid mar la babs nas dbang chen gyi/ /sa gzhir thug rag bar du song 528

bar bsam/ /de yi 'phro rgod rbad kyis chod par nges/ /rgod pa chod tshe rig pa'i ngang la zhog /bying ba che na lta stangs ngar bskyed la/ /rig pa rjen pa phud nas sa ler skyongs/ /yang na rang gi sems nyid thig le ru/ /dmigs la ngag nas phaṭa sgra brjod ma thag /tshangs bug nas 'thon dpag chen mda' 'phangs ltar/ /song nas mkha' la khrug gis 'dres par bsam/ /de nas nam mkha'i mtshan nyid yid la gyis/ /de yis bying ba mi sangs mi srid do/ /bying ba sangs tshe 'dzin med ngang la zhog /'di rnams zhal shes yin pas shes par gyis/ /rtog med 'dod pa'i rtog pas ma bcings par/ /rig pa rgya bskyed dpangs bstod phyal yas su/ /thongs la gu yangs yan pa blo bde gyis/ /dang po rnam rtog gtsong rong chu dang 'dra/ /bar du chu bo gaṅgā dal babs 'dra/ /tha ma chu rnams rgya mtsho ro gcig ltar/ /'od gsal ma bu mjal ba'i ngang la gnas/ /khyad par nad gdon cho 'phrul ci byung yang / /bcas bcos rim gro gang yang mi byed par/ /'di ltar ro snyoms thog brdzis spyod pa gyis/ /nags dang dur khrod mtsho gling skyed mo'i tshal/ /brag phug khang stong shing gcig drung la sogs/ /'jigs shing nyam nga'i gnas su song nas kyang / /rang lus snod bcud snang srid bdud rtsir bsgyur/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad mchod/ /de rnams 529
