mnyes nas brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /'od du zhu nas 'khor 'das thams cad kun/ /'od gsal bdud rtsis yongs su gang bar dmigs/ /yon tan mgron gyur dam can chos skyong dang / /snying rje'i zhing mchog rigs drug sems can dang / /lan chags gdon bgegs 'byung po thams cad dang / /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /myong grol bdud rtsis tshims par byas nas kyang / /'khor 'das ro gcig sems su thag bcad la/ /sems nyid ma bcos chos sku'i ngang nyid nas/ /'gro dang 'dug dang mchongs dang rgyug pa dang / /smra dang dgod dang ngu dang glu len dang / /bcags dang dkrug log smyon pa'i spyod pa bya/ /mthar ni zhi zhing bde ba'i ngang la 'dug /mtshan dus rang babs bde bar nyal nas kyang / /dran bsam 'phro 'du'i rnam rtog kun bral te / /skye med dran rdzogs gnyug ma'i ngang la nyal/ /de ltar byas na nad gdon rang zhi nas/ /lta sgom bogs 'byin rtogs pa nam mkha' 'dra/ /sgom pa rang gsal spyod pa bu chung 'dra/ /gza' gtad kun bral ngang gis smyon pa 'dra/ /bdag gzhan gnyis med 'phags pa'i gang zag 'dra/ /ci smra 'dzin med brag cha'i sgra dbyangs 'dra/ /gang la'ang chags med 'dab chags mkha' lding 'dra / /ya nga bag tsha med pa'i seng ge 'dra/ /thams cad ye grol 530

mkha' la sprin dwangs 'dra/ /de 'dra'i rnal 'byor bde gshegs rig 'dzin dngos/ /dad brgya'i spyi bos btud nas phyag bya'i 'os/ /yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang ches lhag go /༈ e ma ho/ da yang skal ldan bya btang glu la nyon/ /rnam snang phyi na med de nang na yod/ /sems nyid spros dang bral ba chos dbyings dang ske/ /gti mug rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad dngos yin no/ /rdor sems phyi na med de nang na yod / /rig rtsal 'char gzhi ma 'gags me long dang / /zhe sdang rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dngos yin no/ /rin 'byung phyi na med de nang na yod/ /blang dor dgag sgrub med pa mnyam nyid dang / /nga rgyal rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid / /bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan dngos yin no/ /'od dpag phyi na med de nang na yod/ /bde stong dbyings su nub pa sor rtog dang ske/ /'dod chags rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /bcom ldan 'od dpag med pa dngos yin no/ /don grub phyi na med de nang na yod / /rig pa thal byung rang grol bya grub dang / /phrag dog rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /bcom ldan don yod grub pa dngos yin no/ / /e ma ho/ da yang skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po/ /dga' zhing spro bas rdo rje'i glu la nyon/ /de ltar rtogs na snang srid thams cad 531

kun / /gdams ngag dpe cha don gyi dkyil 'khor yin/ /snang ba dkar dmar sna tshogs shog bu la/ /rang byung ye shes rig pa'i smyu gu yis/ /gzhi med ye grol 'dzin med yi ge bris/ /snang stong gnyis med ngang du dpe blta byas/ /stong gsum thams cad lhun grub dkyil 'khor la/ /char chu rang babs chu yis chag chag gdab/ /lam srang rang bzhin thig chen gdab pa dang / /rkang pa'i rjes ni kha dog rdul tshon ris/ /rang lus snang stong yi dam lha yi sku/ /smra brjod grags stong rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / /dran bsam 'dzin med rang grol lha yi thugs/ /yan lag 'gul bskyod thams cad phyag rgya'o / /bza' dang btung ba chos nyid mchod pa dang / /gzugs su snang ba thams cad lha yi sku/ /sgra chen brjod pa thams cad rol mo nyid / /bsrung med nyams med rang babs dam tshig go/ /de 'dra'i rnal 'byor pa yis ci byas kyang / /'od gsal chos nyid ngang la gdams ngag dang / /bskyed rim dam tshig dang bcas rdzogs pas na / /'bad rtsol rgyu 'bras chos la brten mi dgos/ /'bad med dngos grub ya mtshan rmad po che/ /myur du thob pa rdzogs pa chen po yi / /khyad chos yin no skal ldan snying gi bu/ /de ltar nges par nyams su blang gyur na/ /sprin rnams nam mkha'i ngang la yal ba bzhin/ /'khor 'das rtog tshogs gdod ma'i gzhi la dag /nyi ma'i dkyil 532

'khor sgrib med gsal ba bzhin/ /rang rig 'od gsal chos sku mngon gyur nas/ /bsad pa bso nus gsang ba go nus shing / /rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan nas 'gro ba 'dul/ /sa lam yon tan ma lus rab rdzogs nas/ /gang zag dbang po rab rnams tshe 'dir grol / /'bring ni 'chi ka tha ma bar do ru/ /ka dag gzhi la grol nas nang dbyings su/ /sku gsum ye shes 'bral med rtag bzhugs nas/ /gang la gang 'dul sprul pa bkye nas kyang / /'gro don rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad pa'o/ /tshig don 'di rnams yid la zungs shig dang / /skyid pa'i nyi ma nang nas 'char bar nges/ /de 'dra'i dgongs pa glu ru len mkhan de/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol yin par snang / /dge 'dis skal ldan gdul bya mang po yis/ /ma rig nyon mongs rtog pa'i dri ma kun/ /ka dag gdod ma'i dbyings su myur dag nas/ /'bras bu tshe 'di nyid la thob par shog / 4ces 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i khregs chod lta ba'i glu dbyangs sa lam myur du bgrod pa'i rtsal ldan mkha' lding gshog rlabs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ o rgyan rin po ches mdzad pa'i rig pa gcer mthong gi ngo sprod/ kun mkhyen mdzod bdun dang shing rta gsum / rdzogs chen rgyab chos nam mkha' skor gsum/ zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin phung / rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro'i snying thig /sangs rgyas 533

lag bcangs sogs gter kha du ma'i rdzogs chen mang po la gzhi byas / bla ma'i man ngag dang rang gi nyams myong gis zur brgyan te dad ldan gyi slob ma mang po la phan phyir 7bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig /rdo rje'i glu 'di ni thar pa don du gnyer ba'i skal ldan kun la phan phyir blangs pa yin pas/ len pa'i dus ni rnal 'byor pas lta ba skyong ba'i dus su len pa'o/ /len lugs ni rig 'dzin shrī seng ha'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs khyab gdal du gnas/ sems can gyi rig pa dum bur gnas/ nam mkha' ltar rgya bskyed pa bogs che'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rig pa nam mkha' ltar rgya cher bskyed dpangs bstod phyal yas su btang nas sems nyid khyab gda' yangs pa'i ngang nas rdo rje'i blu 'di 'then dang lta sgom bogs 'thon pa'o/ /534

༄༅/ /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lhun grub thod rgal gyi glu dbyangs ting 'dzin sgo 'phar brgya phrag gcig car 'byed pa'i lde'u mig ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /dus gsu ma rgyal ba'i mes po kun tu bzang / /rdor sems dga' rab 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang / /shrī seng ha slob dpon pad 'byung sogs/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla mar snying nas 'dud/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /stsol mdzad yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang / /phrin las thog med sgrub pa'i mthu ldan pa/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /'od gsal rdzogs chen lhun grub thod rgal gyi/ /zab lam 'chad pa'i gnang ba stsol ba dang / /skal ldan slob ma rnams kyi shes rgyud la/ /snang bzhi ye shes skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'og gsal lhun grub snang bzhi'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /sgo 'phar brgya phrag cig car 'byed mdzad pa'i/ /gnad kyi zhal gdams rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len/ /skal ldan las 'phro can rnams gus pas nyon/ /༈ ye ma ho/ shin tu spros med gsang ba chen po yi/ /lhun grub thod rgal gnad la brtson 'grus can/ /tshe 'di nyid la gdos 535

bcas 'od lus su/ /dag nas 'tshang rgya byed pa'i gdams pa 'di//thes pa gzhan la ming tsam ma grags pa'i/ /theg dgu'i yang rtse rdzogs chen khyad chos yin/ /gnad rnam bdun gyis theg pa gzhan las/ 'phags / /rig pa gcer mthong nyid du rtogs pa'i phyir/ /dbang po rnams la rno rtul med pa'i gnad/ /chos nyid dbang pos blta ru yod pas/ na/ /blo yi yid dpyod tsam la mi ltos gnad/ /blang dor 'bad pa'i rtsol sgrub las 'das pa'i/ /na so la yang rgan gzhon med pa'i gnad/ /rang rig ye nas dri ma dang bral ba'i/ /dkar nag las la bzang ngan med pa'i gnad/ /chos nyid 'od gsal mngon sum mthong bas na/ /tha snyad tshig la cung zad mi ltos gnad / /chos nyid bsam brjod yul/ las 'das pas na/ /lta sgom gzhi lam 'bras bur mi ltos gnad/ /sku gsu ma lam snang nyid du shes nas kyang / /khams gsum 'khor bar phyir mi ldog pa'i gnad//mdor na thun mong theg pa gzhan dag las/ /gnad ni bsam gyis mi khyab 'phags na yang / /brjod kyi mi langs/ pas na 'dir ma spros / /khregs chod las kyang khyad par bdun gyis 'phags/ /nyams len la ga len 'dril ba'i khyad par dang / /lus gnad rtsa yi khyad par snang byed sgo'i/ /khyad par mthong ba dbang po'i khyad par dang ཿ /rang snang mngon sum gzigs pa'i khyad par dang / /snang ba 536

'od kyi khyad par nyams snang nyid/ /gong 'phel khyad par dang bcas bdun gyis 'phags/ /'grel bshad kun mkhyen dgongs pa'i theg mchog mdzod/ /tshig don mdzod nas rgyas par bshad pa'o / /de 'dra'i gdams pa nyams su len 'dod na/ /dang po tshe 'di nyid la ma chags par/ /'jig rten bya ba thams cad blos btang nas/ /theg pa 'di la nyams len mi zhan pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bsam dang sbyor ba yis/ /lo dang zla ba'i bar du bsten pa gnad spyo /smin byed dbang zhus grol byed khrid rim rnams/ /yang yang khrid nas yid la 'byor pa dgos/ /de nas rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi med pa ru/ /thun mong sngon 'gro tshad ldan 'khrid gzhung ltar/ /sngon du btang nas thod rgal gzhi ma la/ /khregs chod lta ba gdengs su gyur pa dgos/ /de'i phyir khregs chod lta ba gnad bsnun nas/brtan pa thob nas thod rgal bsgom pa gnad/ /༈ ye ma ho/ sus thob 'tshengs pas nor bu lta bu yi/ /thod rgal nyams len khrid rim 'di lta ste/ /sgo gsum bya ba dgu phrugs gtong tshul dang / /sgo gsum gnad rnams gzir tshul gnad gsum gyis/ /ye shes mngon sum gtan la 'bebs tshul dang / /gtan la phab nas dngos gzhi'i ngo sprod dang / /rjes su rnal 'byor bzhi yis nyams blang tshul/ /nyams su blangs nas snang bzhi 'char tshul dang //537

mtha' rten man ngag dang bcas bdun yin no/ /༈ ye ma ho/ dang po sgo gsum bya ba btang tshul ni/ /chos nyid yid byed tsam du ma lus par/ /mngon sum rang thog bab nas nyams len tshe/ /sgo gsum bya ba dgu phrugs gtong dajo/sa pas/ /lus kyi phyi yi bya ba tshe 'di yi/ /dgra 'dul gnyen skyong so nam thams cad dang / /nang gi bya ba phyag dang bskor ba dang / /gsang ba lha yi gar dang phyag rgya sogs/ /spangs nas grogs med gcig pur gnas par bya/ /ngag gi phyi yi 'jig rten 'khrul gtam dang / /nang gi bya ba kha ton bzlas brjod dang / /gsang ba'i bya ba rtsa rlung bzlas pa sogs/ /spangs te smra med nyid du gnas par bya/ /sems kyi phyi yi tha mal 'khrul rtog dang / /nang gi bya ba dad dang snying rje dang / /gsang ba'i bya ba bskyed rdzogs sems 'dzin sogs/ /spangs te rtog med lhan ner gnas par bya/ /de ltar bya ba btang ba'i dgos pa ni/ /lus kyi bya ba btang bas rang lus dal/ /rang lus dal bas rtsa rnams shin tu dal/ /rtsa rnams dal bas rlung sems shin tu dal/ /rlung sems dal bas rnam rtog rang shugs kyis/ /'gags nas 'od gsal ye shes myur du 'char/ /lus kyi 'byung ba rnams ni ma 'khrugs pas/ /rnal 'byor lus la na tsha mi 'byung ngo / /ngag gi bya ba btang bas brjod med kyi/ /ting 'dzin skye zhing ka ti 538

shel sbug gi/ /rtsa yi nang du rlung gi rgyu ba ni/ /ran par rgyu bas 'od gsal 'phel che zhing / /rlung yang dal bar rgyus pa'i stabs kyis ni / /rnal 'byor pa de tshe yang ring ba yin/ /sems kyi bya ba btang bas rnam rtog gi/ /'phro 'du dus gcig nyid la 'gag pa dang / /khregs chod rang bab rgyud la skye ba yin/ /sna ye ma ho/ gnyis pa sgo gsum gnad rnams gzir tshul la/ /dang po lus gnad sku gsum bzhugs stangs kyi/ /chos sku'i bzhugs stangs seng ge lta bu ni/ /'bol stan steng du rkang mthil gnyis sprad pas/ /lus kyi 'byung ba thams cad cha snyoms shing / /lus nyams 'gying tshul lta bur bsdad pa yis/ /las rlung gnon cing ye shes rlung rnams 'phel/ /lag sor tshigs bskums brla yi phyi'am nang / /sa la btsugs pas 'phro ba las kyi rlung / /ldog cing ro stod drang por bsrang pa yis/ /nyams snang myur du 'char ba'i dgos pa yod/ /mjing pa yid tsam gyen la 'khor ba yis/ /dbyings rig gnyis dang 'du 'bral med pa'o/ /longs sku'i bzhugs stangs glang chen lta bu ni/ /'bol stan steng du kha sbubs nyal ba yis/ /lus kyi 'tshogs pa'i chos rnams bcar la gnon/ /pus mo gnyis ka brang la sbyar ba yis/ /bde drod skye zhing khams rnams rgyas pa dang / /rkang pa'i sor mo 'phongs kyis phyi rol tu/ /539

phul te bskums pas bying rgod cha snyoms so/ /lag gnyis gru mo sar btsugs lag mthil gnyis/ /ol ko brten cing sor mo 'gram sbyar bas/ /dbyings la rig pa 'dren cing mjing pa nyid/ /gyen la btegs pas dbyings rig 'du 'bral med/ /sprul sku'i bzhugs stangs drang srong lta bu ni/ /'bol stan steng du tsog pur bsdad nas kyang / /rkang pa'i long bu gnyis ni gshib pa yis/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba 'byung bar byed/ /rkang pa'i mthil gnyis sa la phab pa yis/ /gzung 'dzin las kyi rlung gnyis gnon par byed/ /pus brang sbyar bas lus kyi 'byung ba rnams/ /cha snyoms lus spyi drang por bsung ba yis/ /rtsa mi 'chus shing rlung yang ngang gis dal/ /lag gnyis bsnol bas pus mor bskor ba yis/ /dbyings dang rig pa 'dres par byed pa'o/ /de ltar bzhugs stangs byas pa'i dgos pa ni / /chos sku'i bzhugs stangs byas pas gnas skabs su/ /nang gi lus kyi 'byung ba cha snyoms shing / /mthar thug gnas lugs rig pa'i don rtogs so/ /longs sku'i bzhugs stangs byas pas gnas skabs su/ /g.yo byed rlung zin mthar thug lhun grub kyi/ /'od lnga'i ye shes myur du 'char bar byed/ /sprul sku'i bzhugs stangs byas pas gnas skabs su/ /lus la drod skye mthar thug ma dag pa'i/ /'khrul snang zhing khams nyid du 'char bar byed/ /gzhan yang chos 540

sku'i bzhugs stangs byas pa yis/ /sangs rgyas mkhyen pa tshe 'dir rdzogs par byed/ /longs sku'i bzhugs stangs byas pas 'di nyid la / /sangs rgyas zhing khams mngon sum mthong bar 'gyur/ /sprul sku 'i bzhugs stangs byas pas tshe 'di ru/ /'gro don thogs pa med par 'grub par gsungs/ /bzhugs stangs gsum las g.yo bar ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas sum stong nyid dang skal mnyam zhes/ /gsang ba spyod pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ngag gi gnad ni smra ba rnams/ /je nyung je nyung btang nas tha mal gyi/ /gtam rnams bcad la thun ni thung ngur bslab/ /de nas rim bzhin thun ni je ringagatong / /sngags dang bzlas brjod la sogs mi dgag cing / /gzhan la tshig 'bru gcig kyang mi bshad do/ /'di yi dus su dpe dang brda tsam gyis/ /ston par byed pa dag la gnas pa'o/ /de nas rim bzhin bzlas brjod je nyung gtong / /tha ma bzlas brjod thams cad phyam gyis bskyur/ /brjod du med pa'i ngang las mi 'da' zhing / /lus kyi dpe brda tsam yang mi bya'o/ /de ltar byas pa'i dgos pa pha rol gyi/ /gzhan la ngag ma 'dres pas lus 'byongs te/ /lus 'byongs rtags su sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs /lus ni sgyu ma'i sku ru grol ba'o/ /de nas bzlas brjod 541

bkag pas ngag 'byongs te/ /de yi rtags su mi ma yin rnams kyis/ /brda dang gtam rnams zer ba dag kyang 'ong / /brjod pa thams cad bkag pas yid 'byongs te/ /de yi rtags su sngon du mi ma yin/ /gzugs mthong de nas mngon shes dam dum 'char/ /khyad par gnas skabs 'khrul gtam nyon mongs rnams/ /mi 'phel mthar thug sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsung gi klong du mya ngan 'da' ba'o/ /gsum pa sems gnad nam mkha' stong sang la/ /mig shes 'gyur ba med par gtad nas kyang / /nam mkha' rang sems 'dres pa lta bu yi/ /shes pa drag tu gcun pas rang rig nyid/ /gsal stong lhag ger 'char bar 'gyur ba'o/ /de yi gnas skabs rang rig mngon sum du/ /gsal bar mthong bas mthar thug lhag med du/ /'tshang rgya'i dgos pa yod do skal ldan kun/ / | e ma ho/ gsum pa sgo yul rlung rig gnad gsum gyis/ /ye shes mngon sum gnad la 'bebs tshul ni/ /de yang dper na don snying la sogs la/ /mtshon gyis phog na cis kyang mi 'tsho ltar/ /sgo yul rlung rig gnad gsum man ngag gis/ /chos nyid 'od gsal 'gyur ba'i sa med de/ /sgo yi gnad kyis mngon sum mthong bar byed / /yul gyi gnad kyis 'gyur ba med par byed/ /rlung rig gnad kyis tshad la phebs par byed/ /de yang sgo'i gnad dper na 542

so/ ba 'dra/ /yul gyi gnad ni mgron khang mgron po 'dra/ /rlung gi gnad ni jag pa 'dra ba yin/ /so bas theb tshe jag pa mi 'khyu ltar//dbang po'i sgo rnams ma 'gul rlung dal te/ /mgron po mgron khang phyin nas sdod pa ltar/ /ye shes yul du mngon sum mthong ba'o /dang po 'char byed sgo yi gnad nyid ni/ /tha mal pa ltar bltas pas 'od gsal gyi/ /ye shes mi 'char cung zad 'char na yang / /gong nas gong du 'phel bar mi 'gyur bas/ /sgo gnad gzigs stangs gsum la bslab pa gnad/ /de yang rig pa'i ye shes tsit+ta yi / /sbubs na bum nang mar me ltar gsal ba'i/ /rang gdangs ka ti shel sbug 'od kyi rtsa/ /dar skud brkyangs pa lta bu'i lam brgyud nas / /mig gi sgo ru 'char bas chos sku yi/ /gzigs stangs gyen du ldog nas gtsug tor gyi/ /rnam par blta zhing longs sku'i gzigs stangs kyis/ /g.yas g.yon zur khrid mda' smyug srong ltar blta/ /sprul sku'i gzigs stangs mig gnyis phyed btsums te/ /cung zad thur la phab na drang srong gis/ /bsam gtan bsgoms pa bzhin du blta bar bya/ /chos sku gyen la ldog nas bltas pa yis/ /bag chags thur la sel ba'i dgos pa yod/ /longs sku zur la mnyam por bltas pa yis/ /'khor 'das ro mnyam nyid du bsre bar byed/ /sprul sku thur la phab nas bltas pa yis/ /ye shes snang ba dngos su 543

'phel ba'o/ /gnyis pa yul gyi gnad ni rang rig gi/ /rang gdangs nang nas phyi rol 'char ba la/ /phyi yi dngos po rags pa sa dang chu/ /me dang rlung la gtad pas mi 'ong bas/ /gnas ni rkyen bral dwangs shing mtho ba'i sar/ /yul rkyen bral ba nam mkha' g.ya' dag dus/ /dbang po rkyen dang bral ba mig gnyis kyis/ /snga dro nub dang phyi dro shar du'am/ /'od gsal 'char snang bde phyir zer gnyis sbyar/ /snga dro shar dang phyi dro nub tu blta/ /de yang nyi ma las ni khru gang gi/ /'og gi nam mkha' stong sang de la blta/ /de ltar phyi yi nam mkha' stong pa la/ /rig pa stong pas gtad pas stong gsal nyams/ /'phro 'du dang bcas phyal yas pa gcig 'char / /dngos po mtshan ma bral ba'i dgos pa yod/ /gsum pa rlung rig gnad ni dal ba la/ /brten nas rig pa btson du bzung bar bya/ /rlung gnad sna nas mi gtong kha nas gtong / /so dang mchu gnyis bag tsam ma reg par/ /shin tu dal bu'i 'byung 'jug byed pa ni/ /theg pa 'di yi rang lugs yin pa'i phyir/ /'di nyid rlung gnad gal po che zhig yin/ /de ltar byas pas rlung yang rab tu dal / /phyi ltar rnal 'byor tshe rgyas grogs su 'gro/ /nang du rnam rtog nub pa'i rkyen byed cing / /gsang ba nyams snang 'phel ba'i gzhi byas nas/ /zag bcas mi snang 'tshang rgya nus par byed/ /rig pa'i 544

gnad ni rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /dbyings kyi rwa bar bzhag nas 'bral mi bya/ /de ltar lus rgyud ar la gtad pa yis/ /rnam rtog zad nas 'khrul pa gzhi la sangs/ /ye shes ma bu 'phrad cing rig pa nyid/ /rlung dang bral nas 'gro 'ong med pa yi/ /rig pa rang byan tshud pa'i dgos pa yod/ /de ltar bzhugs stangs sgo yul rlung rig gnad / /bcings nas nyi 'og khru gang mtshams bltas pas/ /phyi yi dbyings ni nam mkha' stong pa la/ /nang dbyings rnam dag sgron ma zhes bya ba/ /smin mtshams las kyang mched de lnga ldan gyi/ /'ja' tshon lta bur shin tu gsal bar 'char/ /de'i nang thig le stong pa'i sgron ma ni/ /dper na rdzing nang rdo 'phangs ri mo bzhin/ /thog mar 'al 'ol dag tu snang ba las/ /tha mar thig le gsal mdangs can du 'char/ /rig pa rdo rje lug rgyud ces bya ba/ /rta rnga mdud pa btab 'dra gser skud dang / /mu tig phreng ba me tog chun po dang //lcags thag lta bu thog mar smig rgyu ltar/ /'al 'ol 'gul 'khrigs byed cing 'char ba'o/ /lta stangs kyis 'khrid dbyings kyi ra ba ru/ /bcug nas g.yo med blta ba gnad yin no/ /shes rab rang byung sgron ma zhes bya ba/ /ka dag lhun grub gnyis med ye shes kyi/ /shes pa gsal stong 'dzin med de la zer/ /de ltar sgron ma bzhi yi nyams blangs pas/ /dbyings rig 'dzin mtshams dag las bral 545

nas kyang / /gsal 'grib med par 'char ba'i nyams snang ni/ /rim gyis skye bar 'gyur ro skal ldan kun/ /de yis gnas skabs rig pa'i ye shes nyid/ /mngon sum mthong bas ma rig pa dang bral / /tshe dus byas kyang bden pa mthong ba yis/ /rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du skye ba len/ /nyams su blangs na snang bzhi mthar phyin nas / /lhag ma med par 'tshang rgya'i dgos pa yod/ /༈ ye ma ho/ bzhi pa dngos gzhi ngo sprod tshul la gnyis/ /dang po rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur ba ni/ /de yang yar ngo'i tshes bcu dge ba la/ /ri rtse dben zhing nam mkha' mthong rgya che/ /sprin dang na bun med cing shin tu dwangs/ /mngon sum 'od gsal 'char snang bde gnas su/ /snga dro nyi ma rtse shar zer gyi dus/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /bla ma mtho ba'i khri la legs par 'khod / /gser gyi maṇ+ḍal la sogs phul nas kyang / /slob mas bla mar gsol ba 'di ltar gdab/ /e ma bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa che/ /bdag ni 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i gsang lam che/ /don dam rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur du gsol / /zhes pa lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su gzhug /de nas slob dpon thugs kur yi ge a/ /mthing ka shin tu gsal ba zhig bkod la/ /slob ma rnams la sems ni ma yengs par/ /mig gis 546

'di la ltos zhes brda sprad la/ /bla mas ḍā ma ru yi sgra dang bcas/ /brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs snyan pa'i gsu nga dbyangs kyis/ /slob ma'i snang ba ma 'gyur bar du brjod/ /brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin ni phab pa'i mthar/ /dpon slob kun gyi shes pa glod la bzhag/yid la med pa zhig tu phaṭa kyi sgra/ /drag po brjod de sems nyid gang yin zhes/ /lan gsum bar du bla mas brjod pa yis/ /slob ma rnams kyang ci zer gtad pa dang / /bral nas had de phyad de lus pa'i tshe/ /rig pa ma bcos lhag ger shar ba ni/ /ma mthong pa yi mthong ba chen po ste/ /chos sku'i ngang du ye shes phab pa yin/ /de nas 'jug pa dngos ni slob ma rnams/ /sprul sku'i bzhugs stangs drang srong tsog pur 'dug /mig gis rim pa bzhin du phyogs bzhir blta/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams yid la byar gzhug cing / /bla mas slob ma nyid la 'di skad brjod/ /e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon/ /'di nas shar gyi phyogs kyi 'jig rten khams/ /grangs med mang po 'das pa'i pha rol gyi/ /cung zad steng du 'phags pa'i yul sa na/ /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams zhes bya ba/ /bde 'jam yangs shing yon tan du mas brgyan/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong blta bas chog mi shes/ /shin tu nyams dga' sangs rgyas zhing khams yod/ /sprul pa sku yi zhing khams de nyid na/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 547

sems dpa' zhes bya ba/ /sku mdog dkar po dar dang rin po che/ /longs sku 'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig bzhugs so/ /'khor yang byang chub sems dpa' grangs med bzhugs/ /de rnams ston pa nyid la chos gsan zhing / /rang sga nye 'khor rnams la chos ston te/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing khams de nyid na/ /ngo mtshar ma bris pa yi dkyil 'khor yod/ /rdzogs chen lha yi dkyil 'khor zhing khams yod / /skal ldan bu khyod shar phyogs zhing khams der/ /glang po che yi sta stangs kyis ltos la/ /seng ge'i mchongs stangs bzang pos mchongs shig bu/ /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams bstan pa yin / /skal ldan bu khyod sangs rgyas sa de zungs/ /sems nyid 'gyu ba slar la ma ldog cig /phaṭa dang pra be sha ya a a zhes/ /mjug tu stong pa nyid kyi rgyas gdab bo/ /e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon / /'di nas lho yi phyogs kyi 'jig rten khams/ /grangs med mang po 'das pa'i pha rol gyi/ /cung zad steng du 'phags pa'i yul sa na/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams zhes bya ba/ /bde 'jam yangs shing yon tan du ma ldan/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong blta bas chog mi shes/ /shin tu nyams dga' sangs rgyas zhing khams yod/ /sprul pa skul yi zhing khams de nyid na/ /bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bya ba/ /sku mdog ser po dar dang rin po che/ /longs sku'i 548

rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig bzhugs so/ /'khor yang byang chub sems dpa' grangs med bzhugs/ /de rnams ston pa nyid la chos nyan zhing / /rang gi nye 'khor rnams la chos ston te/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing khams de nyid na/ /ngo mtshar ma bris pa yi dkyil 'khor yod / /rdzogs chen lha yi dkyil 'khor zhing khams yod/ /skal ldan bu khyod lho phyogs zhing khams der/ /seng ge'i lta stangs nyid kyis bltas nas kyang / /stag mo'i mchongs stangs bzang pos mchongs shig bu/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams bstan pa yin/ /skal ldan bu khyod sangs rgyas sa de zungs/ /sems nyid 'gyu ba slar la ma ldog cig /phaṭa dang pra be sha ya a a zhes/ /mjug tu stong pa nyid kyi rgyas gdab bo/ /e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon/ /'di nas nub kyi phyogs kyi 'jig rten khams/ /grangs med mang po 'das pa'i pha rol na/ /cung zad steng du 'phags pa'i yul sa na/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams zhes bya ba/ /bde 'jam yangs shing yon tan du ma ldan/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong blta bas chog mi shes/ /shin tu nyams dga' sangs rgyas zhing khams yod/ /sprul pa sku yi zhing khams de nyid na/ /bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas zhes bya ba/ /sku mdog dmar po dar dang rin po che/ /longs sku'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig bzhugs so/ /'khor yang byang chub sems dpa' grangs 549

med bzhugs/ /de rnams ston pa nyid la chos nyan zhing / /rang gi nye 'khor rnams la chos ston te/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing khams de nyid na/ /ngo mtshar ma bris pa yi dkyil 'khor yod/ /rdzogs chen lha yi dkyil 'khor zhing khams yod/ /skal ldan bu khyod nub phyogs zhing khams der/ /dpal gyi rngams stabs nyid kyis bltas nas kyang / /khyung gi 'phur lding bzang pos 'phur zhig bu/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams bstan pa yin/ /skal ldan bu khyod sangs rgyas sa de zungs / /sems nyid 'gyu ba slar la ma ldog cig /phaṭa dang pra be sha ya a a zhes/ /mjug tu stong pa nyid kyi rgyas gdab bo/ /e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon/ /'di nas byang gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten khams / /grangs med mang po 'das pa'i pha rol gyi/ /cung zad steng du 'phags pa'i yul sa na/ /las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams zhes bya ba/ /bde 'jam yangs shing yon tan du ma ldan/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong blta bas chog mi shes/ /shin tu nyams dga' sangs rgyas zhing khams yod/ /sprul pa sku yi zhing khams de nyid na/ /bcom ldan don yod grub pa zhes bya ba/ /sku mdog ljang gu dar dang rin po che//longs sku'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig bzhugs so/ /'khor yang byang chub sems dpa' grangs med bzhugs/ /de rnams ston pa nyid la chos nyan zhing / /rang gi nye 'khor rnams la chos ston te/ /phun sum 550

tshogs pa'i zhing khams de nyid na/ /ngo mtshar ma bris pa yi dkyil 'khor yod/ /rdzogs chen lha yi dkyil 'khor zhing khams yod/ /skal ldan bu khyod byang phyogs zhing khams der/ /rdo rje 'chang gi lta stangs kyis ltos la/ /glog dmar 'khyug stangs bzang pos song zhig bu/ /las rab grub pa'i zhing khams bstan pa yin/ /skal ldan bu khyod sangs rgyas sa de zungs/ /sems nyid 'gyu ba slar la ma ldog cig /phaṭa dang pra be sha ya a a zhes/ /mjug tu stong pa nyid kyi rgyas gdab bo/ /de nas slob ma skyil mo krung gis 'dug /mig gnyis gyen du ldog nas mkha' la blta/ /dbus phyogs dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i zhing / /yid la byar gzhug bla mas 'di skad brjod/ /e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon/ /'di nas steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten na/ /dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i zhing khams zhes/ /nyin par rlung 'tshub mtshan mo me 'bar zhing / /mi mgo skam rlon rnyid pa'i gzhal yas brtsegs/ /zhing lpags sgo khebs nyi zla'i skar khung gsal / /zhing chen zhing chung 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /shin tu 'jigs rung skyi g.ya'i zhing khams yod/ /rab 'jigs zhing khams de na rigs kyi bdag /bcom ldan gzhon nu dpa' bo stobs ldan zhes/ /thugs ni zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /khro bo'i cha byad bstan pa zhig bzhugs so/ /'khor yang rig 'dzin 551

dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bzhugs shing thams cad ni/ /khro bo'i gnyer ma ldan pa sha stag go/ /de rnams rigs kyi bdag por chos nyan zhing / /rang gi nye 'khor rnams la gsang sngags kyi/ /chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i chos ston te/ /'jigs rung bzod par dka' ba'i gzhal yas na/ /ngo mtshar ma bris pa yi dkyil 'khor yod/ /rdzogs chen lha yi dkyil 'khor zhing khams yod / /bu khyod 'jigs snang rnam rtog ma skye bar/ /dbus phyogs me ri 'bar ba'i zhing khams der/ /glang po che yi lta stangs kyis ltos la / /seng ge'i mchongs stangs bzang pos mchongs shig bu/ /me ri 'bar ba'i zhing khams bstan pa yin/ /skal ldan bu khyod sangs rgyas sa de zungs/ /sems nyid 'gyu ba slar la ma ldog cig /phaṭa dang pra be sha ya a a zhes/ /mjug tu stong pa nyid kyi rgyas gdab bo / /de ltar rang snang rig pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sgo lnga so sor bcug pa'i dgos pa ni/ /slob dpon lta dgongs can dang slob ma nyid / /dad pa dam tshig can gnyis 'dzom pa na/ /tshe 'di nyid la nyams su ma lon kyang / /rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs 'byin pa/ /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i khyad chos so/ /de nas slob ma seng ge 'dug stangs bya/ /sangs rgyas sa na yod pa'i ye shes kyi/ /spyan lnga tshe 'dir 'thob pa'i rten 'bral du/ /mig gis 552

gyen thur g.yas g.yon thad drang blta/ /rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes gsal gdab la/ /e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig nyon/ /zhing khams de rnams 'char gzhir gyur pa yi/ /rang gi rig pa bsam ngo dang bral ba'i/ /ngo bo ye shes thim la ma rmugs pa/ /gang du'ang ma phye chos nyid tshad med cing / /dpag med dmigs med rang rig khyab gdal zhing / /skye med klong yangs ka dag chos kyi sku/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i 'gro 'ong med gshis la/ /'gro mkhan sems nyid rtsad brdar chod la zhog /zhing khams de rnams rang gi rig rtsal las / /logs nas grub pa rdul tsam med pa'o/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas zhing khams grangs med kyang / /rang gi rig pa'i rtsal las logs na med/ /rig stong nyid du shes pas gnas tshugs shig /ye shes bsal ba nyid la lam sbyongs shig /sna tshogs 'char ba nyid la ma zhen zhig /chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab klong du a/ /zhes pas stong pa nyid kyi ngang la bzhag /'di ltar rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob pa yis/ /ma rig nyon mongs thams cad gzhi la sangs/ /rig pa'i ye shes rgyas shing mngon sum gyi/ /chos nyid 'og gsal bsgom la dbang ba dang / /gang zag mchog rnams tshe 'dir grol ba thob/ /goms shugs chung rnams bar dor grol ba'o/ // e ma ho/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ngo sprod tshul la brgyad/ /dang po 553

slob ma'i bzhugs stangs gzigs stangs kyis/ /'od gsal thod rgal snang bar blta bar bya/ /de nas bla mas ngo sprod 'di ltar gdab / /kyai/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams tshur nyon dang / /de yang 'o skol rnams kyi tsit+ta yi/ /gsang ba'i sbubs nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs dang dbyer med rig pa'i ye shes nyid/ /'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis 'grub pa yi/ /gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba zhes/ /ngo bo'i cha nas stong zhing bdag med pa/ /rang bzhin cha nas 'gag pa med par gsal/ /thugs rje'i rtsal las sku dang ye shes su/ /dbyer med nang gsal bum nang mar me ltar / /gsal ba'i 'od gdangs ka ti shel spug gi/ /'od rtsi'i nang brgyud rgyang zhags chu'i sgron ma/ /mig gnyis sgo ru 'thon nas nam mkha' la/ /'ja' tshon lta bur shar ba de nyid ni/ /dbyings ni rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma yin/ /de yi nang du dper na ko mog gi/ /chu la rdo bskyur ri mo lta bu'am/ /rma bya'i mdongs ltar kha dog lnga ldan gyi / /thig le zlum po thig phran bcas pa 'char/ /de gnyis thig le stong pa'i sgron ma yin/ /dbyings dang thig le'i nang du rta rnga la/ /mdud pa btab 'dra me tog chun po dang / /mu tig drwa ba lcags thag 'dra ba sogs/ kha dog sngon po sbrang char 'bab bzhin 'char/ /de nyid rdo rje lug rgyud ces bya yin/ /klong chen mdzod bdun ngo 554

sprod skabs shig tu/ /'od gsal spyi la rdo rje lug rgyud ces/ /spyi sdom tshigs su bshad pa'ang yod pa yin/ /de dag rnams la ma yengs bltas pa'i tshe/ /ka dag lhun grub gnyis su med pa yi/ /shes pa gsal stong mi rtog ye shes de/ /shes rab rang byung sgron ma zhes bya yin / / ཿ e ma ho/ dang po sku lnga'i ngo sprod rim pa ni/ /'od gsal snang ba 'di rnams thams cad ni/ /sku lngar mtshon te rig pa'i ye shes nyid / /'od gsal chen por gsal bas rnam snang sku/ /'pho 'gyur med pas mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku/ /de nyid 'phel dang bcas pa rin 'byung sku/ /'od gsal mtha' dbus med pas snang mtha'i sku/ /'od lnga lhun grub shar ba don grub sku/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas lha zhal mthong ba'o/ /de nyid gzung 'dzin zhen pas mi bcings par/ /gsal stong 'dzin med nyid du bsgom pa lam/ /rigs lnga'i sku rnams mthong dus 'bras bu'o/ /gnyis pa ye shes lnga yi ngo sprod ni/ /'od gsal de nyid dri ma dang bral zhing / /sku rnams kun gyi 'char gzhi byed pas na/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes zhes bya'o/ /gang du'ang dbyer med mnyam nyid ye shes so / /so sor 'char bas sor rtog ye shes so/ /lhun gyis grub pas bya grub ye shes so/ /de rnams gzhi med ye stong rtsa ba dang / /bral bas 555

chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /rig pa ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin du//ye nas 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa'o/ /de yi ngang la sa ler bsgom pa lam/ /stong nyid 'od du gsal ba 'bras bu'o/ /gsum pa rigs lnga'i ngo sprod rim pa ni/ /'od gsal de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /gshegs lam yin pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ /'od gsal 'pho 'gyur med pa rdo rje'i rigs / /yon tan du ma 'byung bas rin chen rigs/ /snang ba skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma'i rigs/ /de la goms na lhag med 'grub pas na/ /las kyi rigs te wa ler bsgom pa lam/ /mthar phyin phyir mi ldog pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /bzhi pa 'od lnga'i ngo sprod rim pa ni/ /'od gsal de rnams dri ma med pas dkar/ /rtsal ma 'gag pas ser po rang bzhin du/ /rang gsal snang bas dmar po bya ba dang / /bral bas ljang gu 'gyur ba med pas mthing / kha dog snang 'dzin bral ba bsgom pa lam /'byung khams dbyings su dag pa 'bras bu'o/ /lnga pa rlung lnga'i ngo sprod rim pa ni/ /'od gsal snang ba 'di rnams thams cad ni/ /ye shes drod dang ma bral me mnyam rlung / /'khor 'das snang cha 'dzin pa srog 'dzin rlung / /de la goms pas 'khor ba myang 'das gnyis/ /so sor 'byed pas dwangs snyigs 556

'byed pa'i rlung / /dag dang ma dag kun la ye shes kyi/ /'od lnga de yis khyab pa'i khyab byed rlung / /de nyid nyams blangs 'khor ba'i srog bcad nas/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i sa ru skyel bas na/ /snying rje med pa bskal pa las kyi rlung / /de yi ngang la ma bcos bsgom pa lam / /mtha' ru phyin dus mthar thug 'bras bu'o/ /drug pa shes rab lnga yi ngo sprod ni/ /'od gsal rtogs dang ma rtogs khyad par las/ /'khor ba myang 'das gnyis su 'byed pas na / /'byed pa'i shes rab 'od gsal ye shes kyi/ /rtsal snang sdud pa sdud pa'i shes rab dang / /'od snang 'gro 'ong dang bcas bskyod pas na/ /bskyod pa'i shes rab de nyid don rtogs na/ /'khor ba las sgrol sgrol ba'i shes rab ste/ /de yi ngang la rgyun du bsgom pa lam / /mtha' ru phyin dus mthar thug 'bras bu'o/ /bdun pa mkha' 'gro lnga yi ngo sprod ni/ /'od gsal mthing ka sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dang / /dkar po rdo rje mkha' 'gro ser po ni / /rin chen mkha' 'gro dmar po pad+ma yi/ /mkha' 'gro ljang gu las kyi mkha' 'gro ste/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yi lha zhal mthong ba yin/ /de yi ngang la ma yengs bsgom pa lam/ /snang ba mtha' ru phyin dus 'bras bu'o/ / —brgyad pa mchog gsum sku gsum ngo spyod ni/ /'od gsal ngo bo 557

stong pa chos kyi sku/ /'od dang thig le 'char ba longs spyod rdzogs/ /sna tshogs 'char zhing 'phro ba sprul pa'i sku/ /ye nas sku gsum 'bral med rang nyid la/ /gnas pa da lta rang ngo shes pa yin/ /de la goms nas sku gsum lam snang du/ /shar nas mthar thug gzhon nu bum pa'i sku/ /brnyes dus don gyi 'bras bu thob pa'o/ /dkon mchog gsum yang rang la ye nas gnas/ /chos nyid ma 'khrul gzhi yi sangs rgyas dang / /sgra tshig las 'das don gyi dam pa'i chos /'gyur med gnas pa snying po'i dge 'dun te/ /gnas lugs don dam rdo rje'i skyabs 'gro dang / /'bral med ngang nas snang ba bzhi po la/ /spyod pa yin no skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /'od gsal ye shes snang cha 'di nyid ni/ /blo yis btags shing rtsa rlung 'dzin rtsol gyi/ /rkyen las byung ba'i shes nyams stong gzugs kyi/ /'khrul snang rab rib ma de ma yin par/ /gdod nas grub pa'i chos nyid mngon sum gyi / /nyams snang mi bslu ba de mthong ba yin/ /dkyil 'khor 'di yin bskyed bzlas rdzogs rim 'di/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'di yin no/ /dbang dang sdom pa dam tshig 'di nyid yin/ /'di nyid nyams su len pa skal pa bzang / /de ltar snang ba de rnams kun rdzob kyi/ /snang tshul 'jig pa'i chos su ye med de/ /don dam 'dus ma byas kyi chos nyid do/ /'di nyid byas shing goms pas byung ba 558

min / /ye nyid nas ni rang la gnas pa yin/ /rig gdangs sgron ma'i snang ba 'di nyid la/ /sa chu me rlung 'byung bzhi'i dgra yis kyang —/ /'di nyid gzhig cing gzhom du nus ma yin/ /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug gnyid kyis kyang / /'di nyid ye nas sgrib pa ma yin no/ /ye nas ma byas rang byung rang shar ba'i/ /sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i 'od gsal gyi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba yin pas bsgom pa la/ /brtson par gyis shig skal ldan snying gi bu/ /de nas slob ma spro ba bskyed pa ni/ /skal ldan bu rnams 'di ltar mthong ba ni / /rang byung rig pa thig le nyag gcig gi/ /chos nyid mngon sum snang ba zhes bya yin/ /bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam dang / /mkha' 'gro sogs kyi lha zhal mngon sum du/ /mthong ba zhes kyang bya ste bsod nams dang / /ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa zhes bya'o/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyi/ /dbang rnams dus gcig thob pa zhes bya'o/ /rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob pa zhes bya'o/ /chos sku longs sku sprul sku ye shes lnga/ /mngon du gyur pa zhes kyang bya ba'o / /las dang bag chags sdig sgrib ma rig pa/ /thams cad dag pa zhes kyang bya ba'o/ /las dang skal par ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /de ring nyid nas kun bzang rigs lnga dang / /skal pa mnyam pa zhes kyang bya ba'o/ /bu khyod de ring rnyed pa chen po rnyed/ /rig pa'i rtsal gyi 559

dbang chen 'di thob pas/ /sangs rgyas sum stong mang po'i zhal mthong ngo / /da nas mngal gyi grong khyer rgyun chad nas/ /thar pa'i lam sna zin pa yin no bu/ /de lta na'ang byang chub sems dpa' nyid / /sa bcu rim gyis bgrod pa rnams kyis kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams kyi yon tan kun/ /mtha' dag mngon sum mthong ba ma yin phyir/ khyod kyis da lta mngon sum mthong ba yin/ /nyams su blangs nas sngar nas bshad pa yi/ /zhing khams lnga po tshe 'dir mngon sum du/ /mthong nas sangs rgyas zhing la spyod nus pa'i / /de ring nas bzung snang bzhi'i yon tan kun/ /mthar thug bar du nyams len byas nas kyang / /chos zad byang chub sa la reg par mdzod/ /ces pa la sogs spro ba bskyed pa dang / /bkra shis rin chen phreng ba'i shis pa brjod/ /༈ ye ma ho/ lnga pa rjes su rnal 'byor bzhi yis kyang / /nyams su len tshul lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhi'i/ /dang po lta ba lhun grub 'od gsal gyi/ /ngo bo stong pa rang bzhin gsal ba dang / /thugs rje 'gag pa med par 'char ba nyid/ /mnyam gzhag lta ba rnam pa sna tshogs su/ /ji ltar snang yang rang bzhin ma grub par/ /chu zla ltar du rtogs pa rjes thob kyi/ /lta ba yin te bsgom pa'i tshul la gnyis/ /spros pa can gyis thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor slob/ /tho rengs dang po bla 560

ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms/ /bar pa khregs chod bskyangs shing tha ma la / /bde stong gtum mo bsgom zhing nam langs nas/ /nyi shar bar la kha ton sgom bzlas dang / /dpe blta la sogs byas nas nyi shar nas / /dgung gi bar la thod rgal nyid la bslab/ /gung la phyag bskor chos spyod ci rigs bya/ /phyi dro la'ang thod rgal bsgom pa dang —/ /dgongs mo gtor ma rlung 'dzin la sogs bya/ /srod thun dang po 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ /bar pa bskyed rim bsgom zhing bzlas pa bya/ /nam dgung thun la gnyid ni 'od gsal sba/ /thams cad la'ang thun 'gor sems bskyed bya/ /dngos gzhi dmigs med rjes su bsngo ba yi/ /rgyas 'debs byed pa dam pa gsum dang ni/ /'brel ba zhes bya yin pas med thabs med/ /spros med rnams kyis nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ /'od gsal thod rgal nyag gcig bslab pa yin / /de ltar byas na 'od gsal 'phel che zhing / /myur du tshad la phebs pas shin tu zab/ /srod la dbang po gnad du bsdu ba ni/ /bde ba'i mal du drang srong 'dug stangs bya/ /rang lus rdor sems skur gsal sku dbus su/ /dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan lte ba ru/ /pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i steng / /a thung dmar po reg bya tsha ba las/ /me 'bar dbu ma'i nang du yar song ste/ /spyi bo'i haṃ la log pas byang sems nyid/ /'o ma'i rgyun ltar dkar nar mar 561

babs pas/ /dper na me la mar khu bsnun pa bzhin/ /me gsos byas te ches cher rab 'bar nas/ /las nyon bag chags bcas pa bsreg par bsam/ /bde drod skyes tshe bde stong ngang la bzhag /'di'i dus thog mar rlung ro lan gsum bsal / /bum can ci mang 'dzin pa zhal shes so/ /nam dgung shes pa bum par gzhug pa ni/ /lus kyi gnad ni seng ge'i nyal lugs bca'/ /gzhogs g.yas phab la srin mdzub sna g.yas bkag /yid gzhan ma yengs rang lus rdor sems kyi/ /skur gsal sku dbus dbu ma mda' smyag tsam//snying ga'i thad ku'i dbu ma'i nang nyid du/ /pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i lte ba ru/ /a yig dkar po bkrag mdangs can gcig dang / /tshangs pa'i bu gar de 'dra'i a dkar gcig /de gnyis bar gyi dbu ma'i nang nyid du/ /a dkar phra mo shel phreng brgyus pa ltar / /yod par bsam la gnyid du 'gro kha ru/ /gcig la gcig thim tshul du snying ga yi/ /a la thim nas a de 'od zer gyis/ /dbu ma'i nang kun rgyu skar nyi zhur ltar/ /gsal bar bsgom bzhin ngang du gnyid log go/ /sad pa'i dus su sngar bzhin bsgom par bya/ /gnyid ni 'od gsal sbubs su sba ba yi/ /gnad kyi gdams pa zab mo yin no bu/ /de ltar byas pas gnyid kyi gnas skabs su/ /stong pa'i 'od gsal rtog med ting 'dzin dang / /snang ba'i 'od gsal 562

thod rgal nyams shar nas/ /nyin par ji bzhin nyin mtshan dbyer med 'byung / /tho rengs rig pa rang gsal gtod pa ni/ /tho rengs langs ma thag tu ha zhes pas/ /dbugs ring lan gsum bus la seng ge yi/ /'dug stangs bcas te spyi bo'i nam mkha' yi/ /gzhu gang thad du snying ga'i a de las/ /a yig rang 'dra gnyis pa gcig mched de/ /ling nger 'dug par bsgoms la sems bzung ngo / /de nas je mthor song nas yal bar bsam/ /de ltar byas pas gsal stong gnyis med kyi/ /ye shes ka dag gnas lugs shes par 'gyur / /de dag rnams ni nyin mtshan kha sbyor gyi/ /sgom pa'i rim pa mthar thug yin par gsungs/ /gsu ma pa spyod pa'i rim pa 'di yin gyi/ /dang po chos kyi sgo mo kun bsdur nas/ /rang gi nyams su len pa'i don tshol phyir/ /bung ba tshang tshol lta bu'i spyod pa dgos / /dper na bung bas tshang de tshol ba'i tshe/ /rtsig khung gar yod de la 'gro ba ltar/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mang po'i zhabs bsten nas/ /thos pas chos dang chos min blang dor 'byed/ /bsam pas de don rtogs nas nyon mongs gnon/ /bsgom pas don thog bzhag pas nyon mongs rnams/ /rtsad nas 'byin te de yi grogs su yang / /thi bya tshang 'jug lta bu'i spyod pa dgos/ /dper na thi bya'i tshang de bca' ba'i tshe/ /mi yi sgro 'dogs sngon du spyad nas kyang / /tshang de btsan 563

sar bcas nas mjug tu yang / /'jal 'jol med par ched du 'jug pa ltar/ /thos bsam sgro 'dogs bcad nas rang nyid ni/ /gang la yid ches rnyed pa'i man ngag la/ /the tshom med par 'jug ste de'i grogs su/ /kun gyi spyod yul nyid kyang ma yin pa'i/ /ri dwags rmas ma lta bu'i spyod pa dbos/ /dper na ri dwags rmas ma de nyid ni/ /rma yi gnong sgas mi la bros nas kyang / /lung phug ri rtse sogs la 'gro ba ltar/ /rnal 'byor de yang khams gsum 'khor ba ru / /ltung gis dogs pa'i gnong gis mi med kyi/ /ri la gcig pur gnas nas nyams su len/ /de yi grogs su lkugs pa lta bu yi/ /spyod pa bya dgos skye bo gzhan dag la/ /smra ba tshig 'bru bcig kyang mi bya'o / /de ltar byas pas dran pa rengs pa yi/ /smyon pa lta bur 'brel pa med pa'i gtam/ /rang rdol smra ba la sogs lus ngag gi/ /spyod pa gza' gtad med pa shugs la 'byung / /'di yi dus na gtsang dme med pa yi/ /khyi phag lta bu'i spyod pa zhor la 'byung / /zas gos gang la'ang bzang ngan gdam kha rnams/ /med par 'jol nyog spyod pa 'byung ba'o/ /de ltar drug po rdzogs pa'i dus de ru/ /gzhan gyis tshur la zil gyis mi non zhing / /phar la gnon pa seng ge lta bu yi/ /spyod pa 'byung ste seng ge gang la yang / /'jigs dang ya nga bag tsha med pa ltar/ /rnal 'byor de yang phyi yi snang ba dang / /mi ma yin 564

gyis gnod pa dang bral nas/ /gang la'ang dbang bsgyur nus pa 'byung ba'o/ /ming la snang ba dbang bsgyur spyod pa zer/ /gzhan gyis mi dad pa rnams bsgyur nus shing / /bsad pa gso nus gsang gtam bo bar nus/ /rdzu 'phrul thob cing chos nyid nyams 'bar nas / /chang gis myos ltar phyogs yan re dogs bral/ /snang ba'i dngos po sa chu me rlung la/ /dbang bsgyur phar thal tshur thal bgrod pa dang / /nam mkha' la yang bya bzhin 'phur ba'o/ /de ltar byung dus nyon mongs ye shes su/ /gnas 'gyur stabs kyis nyon mongs kyis mi gnod/ /dper na snam bu tshos bsgyur lta bu'o/ /spyod pa bdun po rang gi rgyud tshod la/ /dpag ste spyod pas lta sgom bogs 'don no/ /bzhi pa 'bras bu'i dbye ba gnyis su 'dus/ /gnas skabs lhun grub 'od gsal 'char tshul la/ /dgag sgrub re dogs med par spyad pa yis/ /lam rtags yon tan thams cad rtsal rdzogs shing / /mthar thug lhun grub snang bzhi mthar phyin nas/ /ka dag chos sku mngon gyur nang dbyings su/ /sku gsum ye shes 'du 'brel med par bzhugs/ /slar yang chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gzugs sku gnyis kyis gang la gang 'dul gyis/ /'gro don rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad pa'o/ /565

myu/ e ma ho/ drug pa shing rta nyi zla'i 'gros ji bzhin/ /theg pa gzhan las lam gyi myur bul gyi/ khyad par che ba'i theg mchog rgyal po yi/ /snang bzhi'i tshad rnams bdag gis bshad par bya/ /skal ldan las 'phro can rnams gus pas nyon/ /sngar bzhin bzhugs stangs gzigs stangs gnad gsum gyis/ /nyi zer la bltas 'od dang 'od khyim dang / /rig pa lu gu rgyud bcas gsal bar snang / /nyams blangs dbyings kyi ra bar rig pa tshud/ /thig le gsum 'brel tshun chad snang ba'i tshe/ /chos nyid mngon sum snang ba rdzogs pa'o / /de ltar mthong bas da lta 'di nyid la/ /yid dpyod 'dzin pa'i lta ba nyid dang bral/ /mthar thug khams gsum 'khor bar mi ldog par/ /rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs 'byin no/ / ཿ e ma ho/ gnyis pa nyams snang gong 'phel snang ba la/ /shes nyams snang nyams gnyis las dang po ni/ /shes nyams bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin dang / /shes pa mtha' 'gyur can gyi nyams rnams ni/ /srin bu me khyer sprin dang du ba dang / /smig rgyu zla ba skar ma mar me dang / /nyi ma shar 'dra phyi nang zang thal snang / /'char nub gsal 'grib can du mi brtan zhing / /tshugs mi thub cing gnas 'gyur 'gro bas na/ /mthar 'gyur can gyi nyams zhes bshad pa yin/ /de la lam gyi tshad 'dzin mi byed par/ /rang bzhin 566

rdzogs pa chen po'i snang ba'i nyams/ /mi bslu ba la tshad 'dzin byed pa yin/ /de yang sngar bzhin nyams su blangs pa yis/ /dbyings rig smin mtshams nyid nas 'brel bar gyur/ /dbyings snang 'od kyi rang bzhin de rnams ni/ /'od lnga gyen 'greng rtsib shar zlum 'khrigs dang / /mchod rten pad+ma stong ldan mkhar thabs dang / /mda' mdung rtse dang 'khor lo gri gug dang / /rgya gram yig 'bru drwa ba drwa phyed dang / /mig mang ris dang gzugs brnyan sna tshogs dang / /gos kyi ri mo la sogs mtha' gcig tu/ /ma nges sna tshogs go rim med par 'char/ /'di dus 'od gsal snang ba de rnams kyis / /rang nyid gang gnas lung pa gang ba 'byung / /de'i tshe nyin mtshan med par snang ba yin/ /nyams snang 'od gsal de dag je bkra dang / /je legs je mang nyid du 'gro bas na/ /nyams snang gong 'phel snang ba zhes bya'o/ /de yang brtson 'grus rab la zhag lnga lnga/ /'bring la bdun bdun dbang po tha ma la/ /nyer gcig nyer gcig 'phro nas gong ma rnams/ /mi snang 'og ma'i snang ba 'char bar 'gyur / /thig le'i nang du lha sku phra mo yi/ /dbu dang phyed zhal rdor sems sku rkyang re/ /mthong dus nyams snang gong 'phel rdzogs pa'o/ /phyi yi 'od gsal rtsal de 'phel ba bzhin/ /nang du rig pa'i 'od gsal ting 'dzin dang / /spyan dang mngon shes la sogs 'char 567

bar gsungs/ /de ltar nyams snang gong du 'phel ba yis/ /bar do med par 'tshang rgya'i dgos pa yod/ / 1 e ma ho/ gsum pa rig pa tshad phebs snang ba ni/ /dbyings kyi snang ba thams cad rgyas thebs pa'i/ /sa chu me rlung snang ba rang dag ste/ /'od gsal snang ba mtha' dbus med pa ru/ /rnam snang la sogs rigs kyi yab lnga dang / /dbyings phyug la sogs rigs kyi yum lnga ste/ /rigs lnga yab yum zung ldan tshom bu ni/ /lnga tshan dkyil 'khor nam mkha' gang bar 'char/ /de ltar 'od zer rang lus 'brel bar snang / /'di'i dus 'dug stangs lta stangs la sogs kyis / /ched du ma bsgoms na yang 'brel ba med/ /mi 'gyur bas na ma bsgoms na yang chog /rgyas par bshad na phyi yi snang ba'i tshad/ /nang gi lus tshad gsang ba rig pa'i tshad/ /gsum gyi dang po phyi yi snang ba'i tshad/ /snang ba gang la'ang dbang bsgyur nus pa yi/ /shes pa gang du bcug pa'i bem po nyid/ /'gul bar nus shing 'byung ba bzhi la yang / /thogs rdugs med par zang thal bgrod pa'o/ /gnyis pa nang lus tshad la phebs pa ni/ /snang ba thams cad rigs lnga'i zhing du mthong / /rigs lnga'i tshom bu'i thugs ma'i 'od gsal gyi/ /skar khung nyid nas 'od zer byung nas kyang / /rang gi lus nang snying gi yi ge a'i/ /rnam pa can la 'od gdangs zung 568

bar 'brel/ /rang la 'od zer chen po'i dbang nod cing / /rang nyid 'od kyi pad+ma chen po'i steng / /'od lus nyid du snang zhing mdzod spu nas/ /'od zer sna lnga 'dom gang gsal bar snang / /spyi bo'i gtsug na ye shes rlung nyid kyis/ /btegs pa'i thig le 'khar gzhong tsam dgu'am/ /lnga ni brtsegs mar snang zhing ye shes kyi/ /rlung rnams lag sor tshud pas sor mo rnams/ /'od lnga'i phreng ba 'khrigs shing 'od rtsa ru/ /ye shes rang gdangs gsal ba'i rang lus kyi/ /ba spu'i sgo sogs phyi nang rdul phran gyi/ /khyon las chung ba re re'i nang na yang / /zhing khams grangs med sangs rgyas tshad med dang —/ /sems can grangs med snang zhing dung khang na/ /khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha tshogs mngon sum snang / /de yi gdangs las srid zhi ma lus pa/ /khro bo'i zhing khams nyid du mthong ba'o/ /snying nang zhi ba'i lha tshogs gsal ba'i gdangs/ /phyi ru shar ba'i thad so thams cad ni / /zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du gsal ba'o/ /mdor na lus kyi cha shas kun na yang / /rang bzhin sprul pa 'gro 'dul sprul pa dang / /sna tshogs sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /lhun grub sgo brgyad 'char ba'i snang ba kun/ /'di'i dus lhag chad med par 'char bar gsungs / /gsum pa gsang ba rig pa tshad phebs ni/ /kun rtog bag chags sgrib pa dag nas kyang / /chos dbyings dri med nyid du 569

rang gsal ba'i/ /gzhan gyi sems rnams shes pa la sogs pa'i/ /mngon shes drug thob thogs reg sgrib pa yis/ /bar du chod pa'i pha rol gzhan yul dang / /sangs rgyas zhing khams tshad med mthong ba dang / /chos rnams dus gcig shes pa'i shes rab dang / /ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mo dpag med la/ /mnga' dbang bsgyur sogs yon tan brjod las 'das/ /de ltar tshad la phebs pa'i yon tan ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la zhing khams chod nas kyang / /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru grol bar 'gyur/ /de yang grub pa'i mtha' ni kha cig gi/ /bshes gnyen byi la dang mtshungs sde tshogs kyis/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i snang bzhi la/ /mu stegs nyi ma blta ba'i lugs zhes nas/ /chos la snang ba'i rtsa ltung la sogs la/ /bag tsha med par 'jug pa de dag ni/ /yang dag chos spangs dmyal ba mnar med 'gro / /chos 'di'i sgor zhugs skal ldan bu rnams kun/ /'di rnams klong chen mdzod nas gsungs pas na/ /e ma blo bde mdzod la thugs stobs bskyed/ / ༈ ye ma ho/ bzhi pa chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba ni/ /'char tshul mdor bstan rgyas par bshad par bya/ /tshad phebs zla ba nya gang lta bu de/ /rang gdangs ka dag dbyings su thim tshul ni/ /zla ba mar 'grib bzhin du sku yal nas/ /thig le la thim rim par nang 570

dbyings su/ /thim nas ci yi ngo bor grub pa med/ /chos nyid zad pa zhes bya don gyi 'bras/ /gzhon nu bum sku de dus brnyes pa'o/ /tshad phebs sku dang ye shes ka dag ni/ /dbyings su thim dus bri gang ye med de/ /dper na mar ngo'i gnam stong dus su yang / /zla ba'i snang ba bri bar snang na yang / /dang po las ni che dang chung ngu ru/ /song ba med ltar rig pa'i snang cha rnams/ /yar la 'phel dus che ru ma song zhing / /mar la zad dus chung ngur ma song ngo / /rang gdangs gzhi la rang thim la song zhing / /shel 'od nang du nub pa ji bzhin du / /gang ba med cing bri ba med pa'o/ /de yang phyir snang nang dbyings la thim nas/ /chos nyid gang du'ang bsam brjod med pa la / /gnas dus chos zad brda ru btags pa ste/ /snang ba med pa nyid la bltas nas kyang / /zad dang stong zhes tha snyad btags pa yin / /zad lugs rim gyis cig car gnyis yod pa'i/ /rim gyis pa ni snang ba bzhi po yang / /tshad du phyin pa'i dus su zad pa'o/ /cig char pa ni chos nyid mngon sum gyi/ /snang ba mthong nas goms par byas pa yis/ /nyams snang gong 'phel snang ba ma skyes bar/ /zad pa yod de sngon gyi las 'phro can/ /re re ma gtogs srid pa tsam yin no/ /snang ba zhes pa de sngar lhun grub kyi/ /snang cha thams cad nang du thim dus su/ /ka dag sprin med nam mkha' lta bu'i 571

ngang / /dar gcig gnas pa de la snang ba zer/ /dngos po mtshanam kha dog la sogs kyi/ /snang ba'i snang ba lta bu ma yin no/ /gnyis pa rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa ni/ /de yang phyi yi nyams snang 'phel rnams zad/ /nang gi sgyu lus chos zad gsang ba yi/ /rtog tshogs sems zad 'khrul pa'i snang ba dag /'khor 'das 'du shes bral zhing dran bsam kyang / /rjes med song nas 'gro 'dug 'du shes med/ /phyi yi 'byung bzhi nyi zla'i snang ba sogs/ /rang yal rjes med song nas 'di yin no/ /zhes pa'i chos kyi ming tsam mi dmigs so/ /chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba zhes kyang bya/ /gzugs snang mya ngan 'das pa zhes bya'o/ /'di dus rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ /rtag tu chos nyid ngang las mi 'da' zhing / /spyan dang mngon shes chen por dbang bsgyur nas/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal tshab tu/ /de dus mnga' dbang bsgyur ba zhes kyang bya / /kun gzhi shes bya'i sgrib pa phra mo ni/ /dar dkar yol ba tsam gyis bar chod pa/ /ma gtogs sgrib pa med pa'i lam dus kyi/ /chos nyid zad pa'i 'bras bu zhes kyang bya/ /'di dus rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /mthu yis shes sgrib phra mo bsal ba'i tshe/ /sgrib pa mtha' dag bral nas nang dbyings su/ /ka dag chos sku'i sa la 'tshang rgya'o / /ka dag nyid la sku dang ye shes nyid/ /med par 'dod pa'i 572

sngar dus rdzogs chen pa/ /kha cig byung ba'i nor sa chen po ste/ /phyir snang gdangs kyi sku dang ye shes nyid/ /shel 'od nang du log pa lta bu'i char/ /de skad gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ma lon nges/ /min na 'gal ba du ma 'byung ba'i phyir/ /nyes cha de 'dra khas blangs mi 'os so/ /de ltar zad dus thob pa gnyis 'byung ste/ /skye 'jug gnyis la dbang thob skad cig la/ /'tshang rgyar 'dod na 'tshang ni rgyar yod la/ /'gro don 'khor ba ma stongs bar du ni/ /mdzad par 'dod kyang rang dbang thob pa'o/ /skye bar dbang thob 'pho ba chen po'i skur/ /bzhengs te 'gro don dpag med mdzad pa yin/ /'pho ba chen po'i sku yi bzhengs lugs ni/ /snang ba thams cad rim gyis zad pa'i tshe/ /lag pa'i sor mo lnga po 'od dkyil na/ /bkram bkram snang bar shes pa gtad pa'i tshe/ /snang ba de las tshur log snod bcud kyi/ /rten dang brten pa chu zla lta bur mthong / /rang lus me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i sku ru rang snang zhing glu/ /phyi nang zang thal 'byung bzhis gnod pa dang / /bral zhing rdo rje lta bu'i sku thob bo/ /lus de rang gis phyi nang zang thal mthong /gzhan gyis mig ma dag pas sngar dus kyi/ /lus tsam ma gtogs zang thal du mi mthong / /dper na slob dpon pad 'byung sku nyid la / /mu khri btsan po'i phyag gis reg pa'i tshe/ /stan la thug pa'i lo 573

rgyus ji bzhin no/ /gzhan yang sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /dngos su bkye nas rig drug so so ru/ /'gro don dpag tu med pa mdzad pa dang / /gzhan yang gang la gang 'dod sprul nas kyang / /'gro don lhun grub dpag med byed pa dang / /de'i tshe bem por rig pa bcug na yang / /'gul dang sgra skad 'byin zhing pad+ma dang / /dpag bsam shing dang nor bu la sogs par/ /rig pa bcug pas chos kyi sgra byung nas/ /sems can thams cad smin par mdzad pa dang —/ /zas gos la sogs 'dod dgu'i char babs nas/ /sems can bde skyid dpal la 'god pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'jug pa nyid la dbang thob pa'i/ /ka dag gdod ma'i dbyings su 'jug kha mar/ /dus der gzhan don rlabs chenatomadzad 'dod na/ /sems can sum stong tsam la rig pa nyid/ /bcug pa'i mod la thams cad dus gcig tu/ /grol ba'i mthu chen thob ste srin bu yang / /'od du yal nas na bun nam mkha' la/ /yal ba bzhin du ka dag nang dbyings su / /mi snang skad cig nyid la gshegs nas kyang / /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med par bzhugs/ /de yang skye 'jug du mas 'jig rten khams/ /rdul gyi grangs mnyam 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /don la skad cig tsam yang mi g.yel bar/ /'gro don rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar rdul phran dengs nas 'od du gsal/ /skye 574

'jug gnyis la rang dbang thob pa rnams/ /lhun grub thod rgal kho na'i khyad chos yin/ /khregs chod nyid kyis lus ni rdul phran dang / /sems kyang chos nyid ngang du dengs nas kyang / /ka dag sar grol tsam las med phyir ro/ /skye dang 'jug pa gnyis la dbang ba 'di/ /chos nyid zad pa'i nang dbyings 'jug kha mar/ /'thob pa'i tshul ni kun mkhyen mdzod nas gsungs/ /de ltar lhun grub snang bzhi mthar phyin nas/ /brtson 'grus rab rnams tshe 'di nyid la yang / /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba/ /phung po lhag ma med par 'tshang rgya'o/ /de'i phyir thun mong theg pa gzhan dag las/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i zab lam 'di nyid la/ /phrad pa'i dus 'dir brtson pa'i nyams len la/ /'bad par gyis shig skal ldan snying gi bu/ /sangs rgyas 'thob par 'dod na 'di la 'bod/ /'di 'dra bskal pa bye bar rnyed par dka'/ /skal dman log lta can la ma ston par/ /rtag tu tsit+ta rin chen gter du sbos/ / / e ma ho/ bdun pa mtha' brten man ngag rnam bzhi yi/ /dang po mi 'gul gsum la bzhi bca' ba/ /lus ni bzhugs stangs gsum las mi 'gul bar/ /byas pas rgyu byed dran rtog rgyun chad nas / /rig pa g.yo med gnas pa'i dgos pa yod/ /mig gnyis gzigs stangs gsum las mi 'gul bar/ /byas pas dbyings rig 575

'du 'bral med pa'o/ /rlung rig mi 'gul rab tu dal bar bya/ /'od gsal je 'phel je brtan 'gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa sdod pa gsum gyis tshad bzung ba/ /dbyings rig gnyis la yun ring bar gnas pa'i/ /brtan pa'i tshad ni sdod pa gsum byung ste/ /phyi yi snang ba skyod byed rlung zad pa'i/ /dbyings rig 'gro 'ong med par sdod pa dang / /nang gi phung po skyod byed rlung zad pa'i/ /rang lus g.yo 'gul med par sdod pa dang / /gsang ba rtog pa skyod byed rlung zad pa'i/ /rnam rtog 'gyu mi srid par sdod pa'o/ /skabs 'dir tshad kyang rmi lam nyid kyis 'dzin/ /dbang po rnon po brtson 'grus rab rnams ni/ /las dang bag chags 'brel ba chod nas kyang / /tshe 'di nyid la grol ba'i rtags su yang / /rmi lam dbyings su thim nas rgyun chad de/ /gnyid kyang 'od gsal bde ba chen por 'char//'bring gi rmi lam gang mis rmi lam du/ /shes pas bar dor mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /tha ma rmi lam ngan pa rgyun chad nas/ /dkar phyogs bzang po sha stag rmi ba ni/ /rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du 'tshang rgya'o/ /rtags kyang sgo gsum nyid la 'char ba ni/ /snang ba bzhi la gsum gsum bcu gnyis las/ /dang po chos nyid mngon sum rtags gsum ni/ /lus ni dper na 'khar gzhong 'jam po ru//rus sbal bzhag nas 'gul med sdod pa ltar/ /bya byed g.yo 'gul 576

med par sdod tshugs so/ /ngag ni lkugs pa bzhin du smra mi 'dod/ /sems ni bya rnams rnyi yis zin pa ltar/ /shes pa gar gtan nyid du sdod pa'o/ /gnyis pa nyams snang song 'phel rtags gsum ni/ /lus ni skyes bu nad kyis gdung ba ltar/ /byi dor rgyan gyi spros pa bral ba'o/ /ngag ni smyon pa rang tshig rdol ba ltar/ /gang la'ang ltos med byung rgyal smra ba'o/ /sems ni dper na lan bdun rtsi dug gis/ /zin pa'i shes pa myos pa'i skyes bu bzhin/ /'khor ba'i bya bar gtan nas mi 'jug go/ /gsum pa rig pa tshad phebs rtags gsum ni/ /lus ni dper na glang chen 'dam nang du/ /tshud kyang rang gi stobs kyis 'thon pa ltar / /'byung ba bzhi la thogs rdugs med pa ru/ /zang thal phar thal tshur thar bgrod pa'o/ /ngag ni dper na grul bum phrug gu yi/ /skad gdangs snyan pas glu dbyangs blangs pa na/ /pha rol gzhan yid dbang med 'phrog pa ltar/ /ci smras thams cad gzhan yid la 'jug cing / /dad pa'i rgyu byed 'gro la phan thog go/ /sems ni skyes ba 'bram nad byang ba ltar/ /phyin chad 'khor bar mi ldog thag chod /bye// / /ra mi sa bzhi pa chos nyid zad pa'i rtags gsum ni/ /lus ni dper na 577

dur khrod mi ro bzhin/ /gshed ma lnga brgyas bskor yang bag tsha med / /ngag ni dper na brag cha'i sgra dbyangs bzhin/ /pha rol gzhan gyi rjes su zlo ba'o/ /sems ni nam mkhar na bun yal ba ltar / /skad cig nyid la bag chags phung po yang / /mi snang 'tshang rgya nus so skal ldan kun/ /༈ ye ma ho/ gsum pa thob pa gsum gyis gzer gdab pa/ /skye bar dbang thob 'pho chen skur bzhengs nas/ /'gro ba'i don kyang dngos su byed par nus/ /gzhan yang gang la gang 'dod sprul nas kyang / /'gro don dpag tu med par mdzad pa dang / /de'i tshe mi la sogs pa'i 'gro gzhan la/ /rig pa bcug na mi des mi dge'i las / /ci tsam spyad kyang de la rang byung gi/ /rig pa'i ye shes gnas pa'i gnad nyid kyis/ /'byung ba rang sar dag nas 'tshang rgya nus//bem po sogs la rig pa bcug na yang / /'gul zhing chos kyi sgra 'byin la sogs pa'i/ /phul du phyin pa'i yon tan ston nus so/ /'jug par rang dbang thob pas nang dbyings su/ /zag bcas mi snang 'tshang rgya nus pa'o/ /rlung sems gnyis la rang dbang thob nas kyang / /rlung gi yon tan thams cad 'byung ba dang / /de yang sems can gzhan rnams tshe 'pho'i tshe/ /de la rang sga shes pa bcug nas kyang / /rig pa ka dag chen por bzhag pa'i tshe/ /las la bzang 578

ngan med par rang nyid dang / /mnyam du 'tshang rgya nus pa'i mthu chen 'thob/ /ri brag rnams la thal byung 'gro ba dang / /nam mkha'i khams la bya bzhin 'phur ba dang / /'byung bzhi'i gnod pa gang gi'ang mi tshugs shing / /mngon par shes pa phyogs med 'char ba'o//'pho ba 'debs pa'i zab gnad nyid la yang / /'di'i don rang gi rgyud la khel ba zhig /dgos pa 'dra yang lam mchog 'di nyid la/ /ma goms zhal 'dris tsam yang ma thob pa'i/ /mkhas rlom rnams kyi thugs la mi 'char ro/ / ༈ ye ma ho/ bzhi pa gdeng bzhi'i drod tshad bstan pa ni/ /yar gyi gdeng gnyis rang byung rig pa las/ /gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas med par rtogs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi yon tan mthong na yang / /sangs rgyas yon tan thob tu re ba dang / /mi thob snyam pa'i dogs pa med pa'i gdeng / /mar gyi gdeng gnyis rang byung rig pa la/ /'khrul pa ye nas bral bar rtogs pa yis/ /'gro ba rigs drug sdug bsngal mthong na yang / /'khor ba'i gnas su mi ltung re ba dang / /ltung gis snyam pa'i dogs pa med pa'i gdeng / /mdor na seng ges gangs ri zin pa ltar/ /gdod ma'i grol gzhir phyin pas ya nga bral / /kun bzang chos sku'i rgyal sa de dus su/ /zin pa'i dus yin skal ldan slob bu tsho/ /579

༈ ye ma ho/ lhun grub snang ba bzhi yi nyams de rnams/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar la phyi'i sa bcu/ /don la rdzogs shing nang gi 'bras bu yi/ /bcu drug sa rnams rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ /dang po phyi yi sa bcu rdzogs pa'i tshul/ /dang po mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yis/ /ngo sprod btab pa'i dus su gang zag des/ /don dam chos nyid bden pa mthong ba'i tshe/ /de la dga' ba skyes pa sa dang po/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa de thob pa'o/ /de rnams thams cad rang gi rig pa'i gdangs / /rang snang yin par rang ngo shes pa ni/ /gnyis pa dri ma med pa'i sa thob bo/ /de nas de la goms par byed pa ni/ /gsum pa 'od byed pa yang thob pa'o/ /de nas de la goms nas 'od gsal gyi/ /snang ba sna tshogs mthong ba de nyid dus/ /bzhi pa 'od 'phro'i sa yang thob pa'o/ /de nas ye shes snang ba mthong de la/ /goms nas nyon mongs thams cad rang bzhin gyis/ /sbyangs nas 'od gsal rgya cher mthong ba ni/ /lnga pa sbyang dka'i sa yang thob pa'o / /de nas 'od las thal ba'i sku mthong dus/ /drug pa mngon du gyur pa'i sa thob bo/ /de nas rab tu goms pa mthar phyin nas/ /nyon mongs pa las ring du song ba ni/ /bdun pa ring du song ba'i sa thob bo/ /de nas 'od gsal g.yo ba med pa ni/ /brgyad pa mi g.yo ba yi sa thob bo/ /de nas dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ /580

dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros sa thob bo/ /de nas ye shes snang ba de nyid la/ /shes pa zin nas snang ba lhug par shar/ /chos kyi sprin ltar mthong ba de nyid ni/ /bcu pa chos kyi sprin gyi sa thob bo/ /phyi yi sa bcu thob tshul de nyid ni/ /don gyis thob phyir dod thub sbyar ba yin / /byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu dngos ma yin/ /gnyis pa nang gi 'bras bu snang bzhi yi/ /bcu drug sa rnams rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ /chos nyid mngon sum snang ba mched pa mig /nye bar mched pa mig gi de kho na/ /nyid dang thob pa lug rgyud mthong ba dang / /nyer thob de la goms pa rnyed pa'o/ /nyams snang gong 'phel snang ba mched pa 'od/ /nye bar mched pa thig le mthong ba dang / /thob pa kha dog lngar gsal nyer thob ni/ /'gul 'khrigs byed cing sna tshogs 'char ba'o/ /tshad phebs snang ba mched pa rku rkyang dang / /nye bar mched pa yab yum zung 'brel dang / /thob pa tshom bu lnga lngar gsal ba dang / /nye bar thob pa dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'o/ /chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba mched pa ni/ /'od gsal sku dang ye shes mi gnas shing / /nye bar mched pa stong pa gtad pa med/ /thob pa brjod du med cing nyer thob ni/ /bltar med chos nyid gang du'ang ma grub bo/ /de ltar snang bzhi sa ni bcu drug po/ /rdzogs nas ka dag sa la gshegs pa ni/ /mgon po rdo rje 'chang gi sa zhes bya/ /sa 581

'di rnams kyang rtsa ba rig pa yi/ /'od gsal sbyangs bgrod med pa'i sa gcig gis/ /snang cha gcig las so sor dbye ba yin/ /don la rig pa'i sa gcig 'di yin gyi/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen thob pa la/ /rgyu yi sa ni sgos su sbyangs mi dgos/ /theg pa thun mong ba ltar rgyu 'bras kyi/ /rim pas sa re thob pa'i tshul nyid dang / /gsang sngags phyi nang ji bzhin bskyed rdzogs kyis/ /rtsol sgrub byas pas sa thob lta bu yi/ /'di la sbyangs shing bgrod du med pa ste/ /don la rang rig rnam dag sa gcig la/ /theg pa kun 'dus sa lam rdzogs pa'o/ / cha ma ma ho/ mthar thug don gyi 'bras bu 'thob tshul ni/ /snang bzhi gong ma gnyis kyi sprul sku dang / /tshad phebs longs sku zad pa'i chos sku yi/ /snang ba mthong nas slar yang nang dbyings su/ /shel 'od nang du nub ltar thim nas kyang / /sku gsum ye shes 'du 'bral med par bzhugs/ /slar yang chos sku'i dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gzugs sku gnyis kyis gang la gang 'dul gyis/ /'gro ba'i don ni 'khor ba ma stong par/ /bum bzang dpag bsam shing dang nor bu ltar/ /rtag par rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad pa'o/ /theg mchog rgyal po 'od gsal thod rgal gyi/ /shin tu rtogs par dka' ba'i gnad 'gag rnams/ /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i 582

rnal 'byor ba/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol zhes bya ngas/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir bshad pa yin/ /'di yis snying po'i bstan pa la phan nas/ /ri sul 'khrul zhig bya bral gyis khengs shing —/ /skra sen snyigs ma'i lhag mar bzhag nas kyang / /dga' rab 'jam dpal bshes gnyen ltar 'gyur shog /rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin tshogs kyi zhabs pad bstan pa dang / /'gro kun lam bzang 'di yi sgor zhugs nas/ /sku gsum dgongs pa myur du mngon gyur shog /ces 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lhun grub thod rgal gyi glu dbyangs ting 'dzin sgo 'phar brgya phrag cig car 'byed pa'i lde'u mig ces bya ba 'di ni/ dad gtong tshul khrims nor gyis phyug cing zab lam 'di la shin tu mos pa'i dad ldan gyi slob ma mang pos bskul ngor/ kun mkhyen chen po'i mdzod bdun dang zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin phung / rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying thig /mkhyen brtse rin po ches mdzad pa'i yon tan mdzod dang / rdzogs chen ye shes bla ma/ rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i rdzogs chen rig 'dzin zhal lung / rdzogs chen yang tig nag po gser gyi 'bru gcig /'ol kha rin po che'i gsung gi rdzogs chen/ nyi grags rdzogs chen/ rdzogs chen kun bzang snying thig /rdzogs chen kun bzang thugs kyi snying byang / rdzogs chen a ti 583

zab don/ rdzogs chen yang zab shel gyi me long la sogs pa'i rdzogs chen du ma'i thod rgal gyi gdams pa rnams la gzhi byas/mtshan ldan gyi bla ma mang po'i zhal shes dang / rang la nyams myong cung zad yod pa rnams kyis zur brgyan te rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa bya btang 7tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /'dis kyang rgyal bas bsngags pa'i lam bzang rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa phyogs rnams kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang /skal ldan gdul bya mang po la phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig /sarba maṅga lo/ /584

༄/ /thod rgal gnad kyi zhal shes mgur dbyangs bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yang mes po/ /thog ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang —/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /gus pas 'dud do byin gyis rlobs / /rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /dang po gnas kyi mtshan nyid bshad/ /skal ldan las 'phro can rnams nyon/ /zab mo mthar thug thod rgal gyi/ /gdams pa nyams su len pa'i mi/ /'du 'dzi'i nang du mi 'dug par / /ri dwags bzhin du dben pa ru/ /bsdad nas nyams su len pa gnad/ /spyir gyi dam chos bsgrub pa'i gnas/ /yid mthun ri yi brgyud bzang zhing / /chom rkun la sogs 'tshe med cing / /mthun rkyen sgrub sla rnam g.yeng chung / /yul phyogs rang bzhin dge ba dang / /sa dgra lam dgra med pa dang / /grub thob gong ma'i zhabs kyis bcags/ /grub pa brnyes pa'i dben pa'i gnas/ /gangs ri mtsho gling ri sul lam/ /nags khrod lung stong brag rdzong sogs/ /bzang zhing yid mthun gnas bsten no/ /khyad par thod rgal sgom 585

pa'i gnas/ /sa phyogs mtho zhing nyi ma'i zer/ /snga mar 'char zhing phyi dro'i dus/ /nyi tshe ring zhing chu skad 'jam/ /'dug sa sdod bde 'gal rkyen med/ /mthun rkyen tshang ba'i lung stong ngam/ /gangs ri ri rtse dur khrod dam/ /brag rdzong la sogs bzang ba yin/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i yon tan dang / /mkhas grub gong ma'i yon tan yang / /ri khrod bsten las byung bar gsungs/ /de'i phyir dben pa bsten pa gnad / /lung stong dge sbyor 'phel pa'o/ /gangs khrod rig pa dwangs pa'o / /ri rtse dbyings rig gsal ba'o/ /dur khrod skyo shas skye ba'o/ /shin tu dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /nyams snang myur du 'phel ba'o / / nga e ma ho/ sngon gyi las 'phro bzang po yis/ /bla mas rjes bzung skal ldan ngas/ /dus kyi mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /las 'phro can gyi bu rnams nyon/ /dbyar dus ri rtse gangs 'dabs sogs/ /dwangs shing mtho ba'i sa ru bsgom/ /dgun dus sa phug brag phug sogs/ /dro zhing 'thib pa'i sa ru bsgom/ /dpyid dus ri ngogs mtsho gling sogs / /dga' zhing spro ba'i sa ru bsgom/ /ston dus sman ljongs chu klung 'gram/ /yid dang mthun pa'i sa ru bsgom/ /dbyar ma ston dang dgun chung dang / /dpyid dus 'od gsal bsgom pa'i mchog /gzhan yang 'tshub dang ser bu med/ /nam mkha' shin tu dwangs 586

pa'i dus/ /dbyings rig rgya cher gsal ba'o/ /ston ser 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe/ /sgrub pa 'phel che bsgrub na sla/ /ston kha 'bras bu bcud sdud dus/ /snying po'i sand don rtogs pa sla/ /dgun chung bsil drod snyoms pa'i dus/ /khams bde bsgom na sgom snying 'dod / /sos ka rtsi shing kha 'bus tshe/ /yon tan gsar du skye ba yin / /de 'dra'i dus dang gnas rnams su/ /bsam gtan bsgom pa'i khang pa ni/ /dbyar dus rtsa yi spyil po'am/ /smyug ma'i bsil khang tsog pu dang / /dgun dus sa phug brag phug sogs/ /shin tu dro ba'i gnas khang dang / /ston dpyid bsil drod snyoms pa yi rdo khang la sogs yid mthun par/ /rab kyis grogs med gcig pur bsgom / /'bring gis mtshams dang 'dag 'byar bya/ /tha mas zab lam 'dir bzhugs pa'i/ /grogs bzang nyon mongs shugs chung ba / /'grogs nas nyams su len pa'o/ /myu/ e ma ho/ da yang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /thod rgal gnad kyi zhal shes rnams/ /sba gsang med par bstan par bya/ /skal ldan snying gi bu rnams nyon/ /'od gsal bsgom pa'i dang po ru/ /rang lus rdor sems skur gsal ba'i/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' gur klong / /bla ma kun bzang rnam par bskyed/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bor bsam/ /'od gsal snang bzhi'i ye shes nyid/ /myur 587

du 'char ba'i gsol ba gdab/ /de ltar rtse gcig gsol btab mthus / /bla ma'i gnas gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'phros/ /de'i nang thig le gsum 'brel dang / /thig phran rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /mchod rten pad+ma gri gug sogs/ /phyag mtshan yig 'bru sna tshogs dang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i sku rkyang dang / /rigs lnga yab yum zung 'brel sogs/ /zhi khro'i lha tshogs dpag med rnams/ /byung nas rang gi gnas gsum du/ /mtsho la kha ba babs pa bzhin/ /sib sib thim nas lus kyi nang / /'ja' 'od kha dog lnga ldan dang //lha sku yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyis/ /gang nas shig shig 'gul bar bsam / /mthar ni rtsa ba'i bla ma yang / /dgyes bzhin spyi bo nas zhugs te/ /snying khar pad zla'i steng bzhugs nas/ /snang bzhi'i ye shes rang rgyud la/ /bla mas myur du sbar bar bsam/ /de nas 'dug stangs gsum po yi/ /gang rung byas nas rlung ro nyid/ /hur sgra dang bcas shugs drag gis/ /lan gsum phyi ru 'phangs pa'o/ /de byas rlung gegs sems mi dga'/ /nyon mongs rtog pa g.yo ba dang / /snying kha gzer ba rnams sel lo/ /de nas dbugs rgyu nyer gcig gam / /bcu'am bdun gyi bar dag tu/ /rlung sems cham la phab nas kyang / /'od gsal nyams la blta ba gnad/ /dgun zla gsum dang dpyid kyi zla/ /dang po bzhi la glang chen gyi/ /'dug stangs gtso 588

bor bya ba yin/ /dpyid kyi zla ba 'bring po nas/ /dbyar zla 'bring po'i bar dag tu/ /drang srong 'dug stangs gtso bor bya/ /dbyar zla tha ma ston zla gsum/ /seng ge'i 'dug stangs gtso bor bya/ /nyin zhag gcig gi dbang byas na/ /snga dro glang po'i 'dug stangs bya/ /dgung la seng ge'i 'dug stangs bya/ /phyi dro drang srong 'dug stangs bya / /srod la drang srong 'dug stangs bya/ /nam dgung glang po'i 'dug stangs bya/ /tho reng seng ge'i 'dug stangs bya/ /lan re yan lag bdun gyis kyang / /'dug stangs dag la bslab kyang mchog /rgyun du sku gsum 'dug stangs gyis/ /gzhan yang lus kyi 'byung ba ni / /grang shas che bas sprul sku yi/ /bzhugs stangs byas na grang dro snyoms / /tsha ba shas ches chos sku yi/ /bzhugs stangs byas na tsha grang snyoms / /snyoms pas longs sku'i bzhugs stangs dang / /bstun na shin tu shis pa yin/ /khyad par snang ba'i 'phel myur ro/ /lus gnad bzhugs stangs ma gcun na/ /rang gi lus kyi rtsa 'dab na/ /ye shes rang gdangs yod pa rnams/ /mi slong de nyid ma bslangs na / /phyi rol dbyings kyi nam mkha' ru/ /ye shes snang ba mi 'char bas / /bzhugs stangs 'di nyid shin tu gces/ /tha mal pa ltar bsdad pa yis/ /ye shes dngos su 'char mi srid/ /gal te cung zad shar na yang / /gong nas gong du 'phel mi srid/ /dper na sprul gyi 589

rkang lag rnams/ /lus la yod pa mi mngon par/ /gcus na phyi ru mngon pa bzhin/ /lus kyi bzhugs stangs gnad las kyang / /ye shes 'char ba de bzhin no/ /gzhan yang ngag gis smra ba dga'/ /brjod bya gtso bor byed pa dang / /'dod pa che zhing 'dod chags la / /dga' ba'i 'gro ba de lta bus/ /mchog tu longs sku'i bzhugs stangs nyid/ /rtag tu byas na chos nyid kyi/ /don la mchog tu mkhas pa'o / /sems la 'gyur ldog che ba dang / /rnam rtog shin tu mang ba dang —/ /rtag tu gnyid la dga' ba'i mis/ /rgyun du chos sku'i bzhugs stangs kyis/ /gnas na chos nyid 'od gsal la/ /rtag tu nges par gnas pa yin/ /lus kyi bya ba la dga' zhing / /'gro 'dod lus stobs che ba dang / /lus por rags shing rang lus kyi/ /byi dor rgyan la dga' ba'i mis/ /sprul pa sku yi bzhugs stangs la/ /rtag tu gnas na 'tshang rgya nges/ /lus gnad gsum po gang bca' yang / /ched du bsdams na rtsa 'chus dang / /rlung gi log 'byams 'byung ba'i phyir/ /ha cang bsgrims pa ma yin dang / /lus gnad 'chol ba ma yin par/ /lhod cha che ba'i bde lugs btsal/ /de ltar byas pas rtsa 'chus dang / /rlung gi log 'byams nyes pa sel/ /rtsa rlung bde lugs su gnas pa'i/ /gegs mi 'jug pa'i gnad yin no/ /gzigs stangs gsum po gang byed kyang / /rtsol bas gcun pa ma 590

yin par/ /lus sems khong glod rang babs su/ /byas la rgyang zhags mi 'gul bar/ /nyi ma'i 'og nas khru gang gi/ /sa der blta ba gnad gcig yin/ /gzhan yang pho yi mig g.yas dang / /mo yi g.yon gyis blta bar bshad/ /dbyings rig snang ba ma mthong na/ /mig gnyis mnyam pararibalta ba gnad/ /dkar shas che na g.yas su blta / /dmar shas che na g.yon du blta/ /ljang shas che na thur du blta / /ser shas che na gyen du blta/ /mthing shas che na dbus su blta / /lnga ldan blta stangs der mi g.yo/ /de byas ye shes myur du 'phel / /dbyings rig smin mtshams dag nas kyang / /bral nas ye shes mkhar thabs dang / /lnga ldan 'od kyi pad+ma stong / /rtsibs rgyud rin chen drwa ba dang / /'od lnga'i mchod rten la sogs dus/ /'dug stangs blta stangs mi 'gyur gnad/ /'od lnga gyen bsgreng mang ba na//mig ni mdun du dril la blta/ /zla gam shar na steng du blta/ /gru bzhi shar na g.yas su blta/ /zlum po shar na g.yon du blta/ /gru gsum shar na thur du blta/ /'od lnga mkhar thabs gsal ba na/ /mig gnyis mnyam par blta ba gnad/ /de byas tshad la myur du phebs / /sku phyed zhal phyag mthong ba'i tshe/ /yongs rdzogs 'char bar byed pa'i gnad/ /de la 'gyur med blta ba gnad/ /rlung ni drag tu 'phangs pa yis/ /ji tsam bsgoms kyang 'od gsal nyams/ /gtan 591

nas 'char ba mi 'gyur bas/ /so dang mchu gnyis ma reg par/ /kha nas dal bus 'byung 'jug bya/ /rlung rig dal bas ye shes 'grub//'di nyid rlung gi gnad yin no/ /'khrid pa dbyings kyi gnad gsum ni/ /mig gis dal bus zur dang steng / /'og tu dbyings snang 'khrid la blta/ /mig mi 'gul dang rnam rtog sems/ /ma 'gyu'i shes pa gsal stong du/ /shigs se bzhag pa gnad yin no/ /snang ba yul gyi gnad nyid ni/ /phyi yul nam mkha' sprin bral la/ /rig pa dwangs sang phyes bzhag pas/ /snang ba'i 'phel ni myur ba yin / /nyin bar nyi ma la bltas pas/ /mig la tsha ba skyes pa na/ /nub mo zla bar blta ba ni/ /mig gi tsha ba sel ba'i sman/ /mar me'i 'od la bltas pa yis/ /mig gi tsha grang snyoms pa dang / /'od rtsa ka ti shel sbug gi/ /lam byang gzigs stangs bde ba dang / /'od gsal snang ba 'phel bar gsungs/ /gzhan yang chos sku'i bzhugs stangs kyis/ /nyi mar blta zhing longs sku yis/ /zla bar blta zhing sprul sku yis/ /mar mer blta ba sogs kyang bshad/ /rgyang zhags sgron ma mi gsal na/ /sman dang sngags kyis bcos par bya/ /dbyings kyi sgron ma mi gsal na/ /nyi ma'i 'og gi khru gang gi/ /ma rig pa yi mkha' la blta/ /thig le'i sgron ma mi gsal na/ /dbyings la 'gyur med blta ba gnad/ /shes rab sgron ma mi gsal na/ /rlung 592

ni rab tu dal bar bya/ /rdo rje lug rgyud btson du bzung / /shes pa dwangs sang phye bar bzhag /mig shas ngan pas sprul sku yi/ /gzigs stangs byas na mig mi bsgribs/ /mig skyon can gyis longs sku yi/ /gzigs stangs byas na mig gsal gsungs/ /mig shes bzang pos chos sku yi/ /gzigs stangs byas na snang ba nyid/ /myur du tshad la phebs pa'o/ /dmigs pa dag la brten nas kyang / /dmigs med 'od gsal 'char ba'i phyir/ /lan re 'di 'dra'i dmigs pa bya/ /rang lus rdor sems skur bskyed de/ /snying khar bla ma kun bzang bsgom / /'od 'phros lus kyi phyi nang kun/ /gang nas gdos bcas 'od lus su/ /dag nas snang stong 'od skur bsam/ /yang na snying khar 'od lnga'i klong / /zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dang / /klad pa dung khang gzhal yas su/ khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha tshogs dang / /lus kyi phyi nang bar gsum rnams/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs ni/ /til gyi gang bu kha phye ltar/ /gang bar bsam la de dag las/ /'od zer kha dog lnga ldan dang / /thig le cha lang lta bur 'phros/ /lus kyi phyi nang thams cad du/ /phar thal tshur thal ling por 'gro/ /cha lang lta bur brdegs par bsam/ /phyir 'phros snod bcud rnams la phog /snod rnams 'ja' 'od thig le dang / /bcud rnams zhi khro'i skur gyur bsam/ /yang na rang lus ye shes kyi/ /spyan gyis gang zhing spyan 593

thams cad/ /yom yom shig shig 'gul bar bsam/ /yang na snying khar a yig bsgom/ /de las sngon la 'od sngon po/ /'phros nas rang lus khyab par bsam/ /de nas rim bzhin mdun g.yas rgyab/ /g.yon du dkar ser dmar ljang gi/ /'od zer rim bzhin 'phro bar bsgom/ /de nas a hrīḥthig le'i tshogs/ /dpag med 'phros nas rang lus kyi/ /ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad kun/ /'ja' 'od thig ler 'khrigs par bsam/ /phyir 'phros snod bcud kun la phog /snod bcud 'ja' 'od thig le ru/ /'bar bar bsam pa rtsol bcas kyis/ /'od gsal 'char ba'i gnad rnams yin/ /skabs re 'jam rlung bum pa can/ /bzung nas 'od gsal bsgom par bya/ /mdor na las ni dang po pas/ /nyin par dus su dkar 'khrid dang —/ /nub mo mun pa'i dus su yang / /rgya mtsho ar gtad byed pa dang / /mun pa'i nang du mig bsgrad nas/ /g.yo 'gul med par blta ba dang / /zla ba dang ni sgron me dang / /'ja' shel sogs la blta bar bya/ /'od gsal rim gyis 'phel bar 'gyur/ /mngon sum snang ba 'di la ni/ /'od mdangs zer dang thig le dang / /sku dang zhing khams gang shar yang / /dga' brod zhen pas mi 'ching bar/ /chags med lta ba'i gdengs la bzhag /de ltar byas na gol sa med//chos nyid btsan sa zin par 'gyur/ /zab lam rdzogs pa chen po 594

yi / /yang zab thod rgal zhal shes 'di/ /skal ldan slob mas bskul ba'i ngor/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /sba gsang med par bstan pa yin/ /dge 'dis gdul bya mang po yis/ /lhun grub thod rgal bsgom pa'i tshe/ /myur du snang bzhi mthar phyin nas/ /tshe gcig sku gsum mngon gyur shog /rgyal bas bsngags pa'i lam bzang mchog /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa 'di/ /mkha' la nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /rgyal khams yongs la dar rgyas shog /ces thod rgal gnad kyi zhal shes mgur dbyangs bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes bya ba 'di ni skal ldan gyi slob ma mang pos bskul ngor/ kun mkhyen mdzod bdun sogs rdzogs chen mang po nas bshad pa dang / bla ma'i zhal shes sogs thod rgal la nye bar mkho ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus te / rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig sarba mab lo// ༈ mchog dngos grub brgya yi ded dpon mi la rje'i/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i zlos gar zhabs dkar ba/ /tshogs drug rang grol mchog gi rdo rje'i glu/ /theg mchog snying po'i dmar khrid byin rlabs can/ /mkha' lding gshogs rlabs thod rgal zhal shes bcas/ /snyigs dus dwags rnying bstan pa'i bshad sgrub dpal/ /thugs bskyed go chas 'dzin la zla bral ba/ /mdo khams brgyad pa'i gdan sa rmad byung bar/ /dpar gyi mthun sbyor zla med thugs smon can/ /rnal 'byor rig 595
rngordo snyi/thar 'a da nga da phrin las khyab brdal pesne/ grong sngags pa dil mgo ma

༄ga /'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i smon lam bzhugs so/ /'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhi lam 'bras bu dbyer med pa'i don la smon pa rig stong rdo rje'i rang gdangs zhes bya ba bzhugs / phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bde gshegs sras bcas kyi/ /ye shes skur gyur gnyis med tshul 'chang ba/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang / /byar med don la lhun gyis grub gyur cig /gdod ma'i mgon po dpal ldan bla ma la/ /mnyam nyid chos skur lta ba'i mos gus kyis/ /don brgyud dgongs pa'i byin rlabs snying la 'phos / /rig pa rtsal gyi dbang chen thob par shog /ye nas gnas phyir rtsol bas bsgrub pa dang / /dbang po'i khyad par sogs la mi ltos kyang / /sla bas yid ma ches pa sems kyi gsang / /bla ma'i man ngag stobs kyis mthong gyur cig /spros shing dpyad pa kun rtog snon ma ste/ /btsal zhing sgrub pa rang nyid ngal ba'i rgyu/ /dmigs shing bsgom pa phyir zhing 'ching ba'i gzeb/ /zug rngu'i spros pa nang nas chod par shog /bsam brjod bral la mthong ba gang med kyang //ma mthong lhag mar gyur ba gang yang med/ /rang sems kho thag chod 597
